title: 要问吉凶，但看财福

rule.yi: 占财以妻财为用神，子孙为原神（财的来源）；吉凶先看这两爻。
rule.en: For money, the Wealth line is the Subject and Output is its Support, the source of money; judge the outcome from these two lines first.

dispute.yi: 财、福各指什么，两家注说得相反：旧注说妻财是利润、子孙是财源；王洪绪说妻财是本钱、子孙是利润。野鹤只说子孙是生财的原神。三家都以妻财为用神、子孙为最要紧的帮手。
dispute.en: The two commentaries gloss the pair oppositely: the old commentary makes Wealth the profit and Output its source; Wang Hongxu makes Wealth the capital and Output the profit. Yehe only says Output is the Support that generates Wealth. All three take Wealth as the Subject and Output as its chief help.

zh: 居货曰贾，行货曰商，总为资生之计；
蓍所以筮，龟所以卜，莫非就利之谋。
要问吉凶，但看财福。
yi: 坐店卖货叫「贾」，贩运货物叫「商」，说到底都是谋生的办法；
人们用蓍草来筮、用龟甲来卜，问的无非是怎么得利。
要问求财的吉凶，只看妻财和子孙（福）。
en: Keeping goods in a shop is called gu, carrying goods to trade is called shang; both are ways of making a living;
we divine with yarrow stalks and with the tortoise shell, and what we ask is how to profit.
To know whether it turns out well or badly, look only at Wealth and its source, Output (fu).

hits.text: 居货曰贾，行货曰商，总为资生之计
蓍所以筮，龟所以卜，莫非就利之谋
居货曰贾，行货曰商。总为资生之计
蓍所以筮，龟所以卜，莫非就利之谋

zh: 财为利息，福为财源。
二者占财用神。
yi: 妻财代表利润，子孙（福）代表财的来源。
这两爻是占财时要取的用神。
en: Wealth is the profit; Output (fu) is the source of the money.
These two are the Subject lines of a money question.

zh: 财为本，福为利，
二者不可损坏。
卦中子孙之爻，称曰福神。
yi: 妻财是本钱，子孙是利润，
两者都不能受损。
卦里的子孙爻，叫作「福神」。
en: Wealth is the capital, Output is the profit;
neither may be damaged.
The Output line in a hexagram is called the spirit of fortune (fushen).

zh: 上至国课，下至营谋，无不以财为用，
公占私卜，皆以财为用神。
子孙者，乃生助财爻之元神也，
yi: 大到国家赋税，小到个人生意，没有不以财为用的；
无论为公事还是私事占问，都以妻财为用神。
子孙是生助财爻的原神。
en: From the state's taxes down to a private venture, everything turns on money;
whether the question is public or private, Wealth is the Subject.
Output is the Support that generates and helps the Wealth line.

title: 财旺福兴，财空福绝

rule.yi: 财爻旺相、子孙发动：公事私事求财都如意。财、福落空、临墓绝（或受伤克而无救）：做什么营生都不如意。野鹤另加两条：宜动而化吉、宜生合世爻；忌动而变凶、忌日月冲破。
rule.en: Wealth thriving and Output moving: money comes as wished, public or private. Wealth and Output void, in tomb or extinction (or harmed with no rescue): no business goes as wished. Yehe adds: they should turn into something favourable and generate or combine with the Self line; bad if they turn into something harmful or are clashed and broken by the Day or Month.

note.yi: 野鹤把经文「总违心」改成了「上下连心」。两个本子（合集本、殆知阁本）都作「连心」；这里按上下文读作「揪心、忧心」，是整理者的读法。
note.en: Yehe replaced the classic's 'goes against your wishes' with 'high and low alike lian xin'. Both editions (the owner's collection and the Daizhige text) read lian xin; taking it as 'sick at heart' from the context is our reading.

zh: 财旺福兴，不问公私皆称意；
财空福绝，不拘营运总违心。
yi: 妻财旺相、子孙兴旺，不论公事私事都能如意；
妻财落空、子孙衰绝，不论做什么营生都不如意。
en: When Wealth is thriving and Output flourishing, things go as wished, public or private;
when Wealth is void and Output extinguished, whatever the business, it goes against your wishes.

hits.text: 财旺福兴，无问公私皆称意
财空福绝，不拘营运总违心
财旺福兴，无问公私皆称意
财空福绝，不拘营运总违心

zh: 凡遇财爻旺相，子孙发动，便是吉卦。
不拘公私，财皆得称意。
二者若财空爻，或临墓绝，即是凶卦。
不拘作何买卖，皆违心愿也。
yi: 凡是财爻旺相、子孙发动，就是吉卦。
不管公事私事，求财都能如意。
这两爻如果落空，或临墓、绝，就是凶卦。
不管做什么买卖，都不能如愿。
en: Whenever the Wealth line is thriving and Output is moving, the hexagram is auspicious.
Public or private, the money comes as wished.
If these two are void, or sit in tomb or extinction, the hexagram is inauspicious.
Whatever the trade, it goes against your wishes.

zh: 财爻旺相，子孙发动，不拘公私之谋，皆能称意；
或伤克，或临墓绝无救，不拘买卖皆违心所愿。
yi: 财爻旺相、子孙发动，不论为公为私谋划，都能如意；
如果受伤克，或临墓、绝又没有救，不论什么买卖都不遂心。
en: With the Wealth line thriving and Output moving, any plan, public or private, goes as wished;
if they are harmed and controlled, or sit in tomb or extinction with no rescue, every trade goes against your wishes.

zh: 财旺福兴，公私称意；
财空福绝，上下连心。
yi: 财旺福兴，公事私事都如意；
财空福绝，上上下下都揪心。
en: Wealth thriving and Output flourishing: public and private matters go as wished;
Wealth void and Output extinguished: high and low alike are sick at heart.

zh: 俱宜旺而化吉，又宜生合世爻，公私皆得如意。
若逢衰墓绝空、刑冲克害、动而变凶、日月冲破者，上下皆连心矣。
yi: 财、福都宜旺相而且化吉，又宜生合世爻，这样公事私事都能如意。
如果遇到衰、墓、绝、空，受刑冲克害，动而变凶，或被日月冲破，上上下下都要揪心了。
en: Both should be strong and turn into something favourable, and should generate or combine with the Self line; then public and private matters go as wished.

If they are weak, entombed, extinguished or void, punished, clashed, controlled or harmed, turn into something harmful when they move, or are clashed and broken by the Day or Month, high and low alike are sick at heart.

title: 有福无财，兄弟交重偏有望

rule.yi: 妻财不上卦（或不动）而子孙在，兄弟发动反而有望：兄弟生子孙，子孙生财，只是来得慢。财爻空而兄动叫「避空」，过旬、到财爻生旺之日可得。财爻不空不伏却被兄弟劫，是下等卦。王洪绪、野鹤都要求子孙也动。
rule.en: With Wealth absent (or still) but Output present, a moving Peer line actually gives hope: Peer feeds Output and Output feeds Wealth, only slowly. Wealth void while Peer moves is called 'hiding in the void': the money comes after the ten-day cycle, on a day that births or empowers Wealth. Wealth neither void nor hidden yet robbed by Peer is the lowest grade. Wang Hongxu and Yehe both require Output to be moving too.

dispute.yi: 「有福无财」怎么读：旧注读作「财不上卦」，只要兄弟发动去生子孙就有望；王洪绪把「有、无」读成「动、伏」，而且认为有望全靠子孙也在动；野鹤也要子孙和兄弟同动，并说财、兄同动主阻隔。
dispute.en: How to read 'Output present, no Wealth': the old commentary takes it as Wealth absent from the hexagram, with hope as long as the moving Peer feeds Output; Wang Hongxu reads 'present/absent' as 'moving/hidden' and says the hope depends on Output moving as well; Yehe also wants Output and Peer moving together, and says Wealth and Peer moving together means obstruction.

note.yi: 野鹤那句「若财爻、动爻、子孙爻俱动」，按下文「兄动生子、子动生财」，「动爻」应是「兄爻」；两个本子都作「动爻」，这里不改原文，只在译文里注明。
note.en: In Yehe's 'if the Wealth line, the moving line and the Output line all move', the next clause ('Peer feeds Output, Output feeds Wealth') shows 'the moving line' should be 'the Peer line'. Both editions read 'moving line'; we leave the text as it is and flag it in the translation.

zh: 有福无财，
兄弟交重偏有望；
yi: 子孙在、妻财不在，
兄弟发动反而有希望；
en: With Output present but no Wealth,
a moving Peer line actually gives hope;

zh: 财为用神，而不上卦，必无可望。
若得兄弟发动，无财可劫，则反生扶福德，财源有气，仍旧有望，但主迟滞耳。
兄动而财空，谓之避空。
过旬生旺日，财亦可得。
财若不空不伏，而遇兄劫，则为下卦。
yi: 妻财是用神，它不在卦上，本来没有指望。
但如果兄弟发动，卦里没有财可劫，它反而去生扶子孙，财源有了力量，仍然有希望，只是来得慢。
兄弟动而财爻落空，叫作「避空」（财在空里，兄弟劫不着）。
过了这一旬，到财爻生旺的日子，财也能得到。
财爻如果既不空也不伏，却被兄弟劫，就是下等卦。
en: Wealth is the Subject; if it is absent from the hexagram there should be nothing to hope for.
But if the Peer line moves and finds no Wealth to rob, it generates and supports Output instead; the source of money gains force and there is still hope, only slow.
When Peer moves and Wealth is void, this is called 'hiding in the void' (the robber cannot reach it).
After the ten-day cycle passes, on a day that births or empowers Wealth, the money can still be had.
If Wealth is neither void nor hidden and yet Peer robs it, the hexagram is of the lowest grade.

zh: 有者言其发动之意，无者言其伏藏之意。
凡卜求财，卦中子孙爻动而无伤，则财源丰厚固吉。
如再见兄弟爻发动，生扶子孙，则财愈加根深蒂固，
故曰“兄弟爻交重偏有望”，皆为子孙亦动也。
yi: 「有」是说它发动，「无」是说它伏藏。
凡是卜求财，卦里子孙爻发动而不受伤，财源丰厚，本来就吉。
如果再见到兄弟爻发动，去生扶子孙，财就更加根深蒂固，
所以说「兄弟交重偏有望」，都是因为子孙也在动。
en: 'Present' here means moving; 'absent' means hidden.
In any money question, if the Output line moves and is unharmed, the source of money is rich and the outlook is good.
If a Peer line also moves and feeds Output, the money is rooted all the deeper;
that is why it says 'a moving Peer line gives hope': it is always because Output is moving too.

zh: 有福无财，兄弟交重偏有望。
兄弟乃劫财之神，占财之最忌也。
财兄同动，必主阻隔破耗。
假设财静及不现者，倘得子孙与兄弟同动，又为可喜，以兄动生子孙也，故曰有望。
若财爻、动爻、子孙爻俱动于卦中者，更为可喜，
盖兄动生子、子动生财，其利甚厚，且主财有根源，利能久远也。
yi: 有福无财，兄弟发动反而有望。
兄弟是劫财之神，是占财最忌的。
财和兄弟一起动，一定有阻隔、破耗。
假如财爻安静或不在卦上，而子孙和兄弟一起动，又是可喜的，因为兄弟动去生子孙，所以说有望。
如果财爻、兄爻（原文作「动爻」）、子孙爻都在卦中发动，更可喜，
因为兄弟动生子孙、子孙动生财，利益很厚，而且财有根源，利能长久。
en: With Output present but no Wealth, a moving Peer line gives hope.
Peer is the robber of wealth, the thing most feared in a money question.
If Wealth and Peer move together there will be obstruction and loss.
But if Wealth is still or absent and Output moves together with Peer, that is welcome, because the moving Peer feeds Output; hence 'gives hope'.
If the Wealth line, the Peer line (the text says 'the moving line') and the Output line all move in the hexagram, better still,
for Peer feeds Output and Output feeds Wealth: the profit is rich, the money has a root, and the gain lasts.

title: 有财无福，官爻发动亦堪求

rule.yi: 卦有财而子孙不现，本来一见兄弟就被劫；此时官鬼发动（或日辰为官鬼）克住兄弟，仍可求财，在官鬼生旺日得。卦中若有子孙，官鬼动反成阻滞。野鹤把条件改成「兄、财同动」时官鬼动可制兄。
rule.en: If Wealth is present but Output is not, any Peer line would rob it; a moving Pressure line (or a Pressure Day branch) that holds Peer down still makes the money obtainable, arriving on a day that births or empowers Pressure. If Output is present, a moving Pressure line becomes an obstruction instead. Yehe restates the condition as Peer and Wealth moving together, with a moving Pressure line restraining Peer.

dispute.yi: 野鹤把经文前半句「有财无福」改成「兄兴财振」：适用的卦从「子孙不现」换成了「兄、财同动」。两种说法的理由一样——官鬼克兄弟、护住财——但管的是不同的卦。
dispute.en: Yehe rewrote the first half: 'Wealth present, no Output' became 'Peer and Wealth both stirring'. The reason is the same in both (Pressure controls Peer and so shields the money), but they apply to different hexagrams.

zh: 有财无福，
官爻发动亦堪求。
yi: 妻财在、子孙不在，
官鬼发动也还可以求。
en: With Wealth present but no Output,
a moving Pressure line still makes it worth pursuing.

zh: 子孙藏伏，财无生气，一遇兄弟，便被劫尽。
须得卦有官动，或日辰是鬼克制兄爻，则用神无损，亦可求谋。
卦有子孙而官鬼动，则有阻节，反不易矣。
此象鬼爻生旺日得财。
yi: 子孙伏藏不现，财就没有生气，一碰上兄弟，就被劫光。
必须卦里有官鬼发动，或者日辰就是官鬼、克住兄弟，用神才不受损，也可以去求。
如果卦里有子孙，官鬼再动，反而会有阻滞，不容易了。
这种卦象，在官鬼生旺的日子得财。
en: With Output hidden, Wealth has no living source, and the first Peer line it meets robs it bare.
It needs a moving Pressure line in the hexagram, or a Day branch of the Pressure element holding the Peer line down; then the Subject is unharmed and the venture can be tried.
If Output is present and Pressure moves, there will be obstruction instead, and it becomes harder.
In this pattern the money comes on a day that births or empowers the Pressure line.

zh: 子孙藏伏，财无生气，一遇兄弟便被劫夺，
须得卦中官爻发动，或日辰是鬼克制兄弟，亦可求谋。
如有子孙，而官鬼动则有阻滞，又不易矣。
yi: 子孙伏藏，财没有生气，一碰上兄弟就被劫走；
必须卦里官鬼发动，或者日辰是官鬼、克制兄弟，才可以求。
如果有子孙，官鬼再动就有阻滞，又不容易了。
en: With Output hidden, Wealth has no living source and the first Peer line robs it;
it needs a moving Pressure line, or a Pressure Day branch holding the Peer line down, before it can be pursued.
If Output is present, a moving Pressure line brings obstruction and makes it hard again.

zh: 兄兴财振，官爻发动亦堪求。
兄财同动，而官鬼亦动者，亦许得财，以官鬼克制兄爻之故耳。
yi: 兄弟和妻财同时发动，官鬼也动，也还可以求。
兄弟、妻财一起动，官鬼也动，也可以断得财，因为官鬼克住了兄弟。
en: When Peer and Wealth both stir, a moving Pressure line still makes it worth pursuing.
If Peer and Wealth move together and Pressure moves too, money may still be granted, because Pressure holds the Peer line down.

title: 财福俱无，何异守株而待兔

rule.yi: 妻财、子孙都不上卦，或上卦而休囚、空破、墓绝、受克冲：求财无望，不如按兵不动。例外（觉子）：日辰或月建本身是财，或财爻伏藏而旺，仍可求。
rule.en: If neither Wealth nor Output is in the hexagram, or they are there but weak, void, broken, entombed, extinguished, controlled or clashed, there is no hope in pursuing money; better to hold still. Exception (Juezi): the Day or Month is Wealth itself, or the hidden Wealth line is strong.

note.yi: 野鹤把「何异守株而待兔」改成「莫若守株而待兔」：经文说这是空想，野鹤借同一个典故劝人按兵不动。觉子另补了两种还能求的情形。
note.en: Yehe changed 'no different from waiting by the stump' to 'better to wait by the stump': the classic calls it wishful thinking, while Yehe uses the same image to advise staying put. Juezi adds two cases in which it can still be pursued.

zh: 财福俱无，
何异守株而待兔；
yi: 妻财、子孙都没有，
和守着树桩等兔子撞上来有什么两样；
en: With neither Wealth nor Output,
it is no different from waiting by a tree stump for a hare to run into it;

zh: 财福二爻，占财主象。
有财无福，财必有限；有福无财，财必不实；
财福俱无，焉能有望？
守株待兔，喻妄想也，空亡亦然。
yi: 妻财、子孙两爻，是占财的主要象。
有财无子孙，财一定有限；有子孙无财，财一定不实在；
两样都没有，哪来的指望？
守株待兔比喻空想；两爻落空亡也一样。
en: Wealth and Output are the two main signs in a money question.
Wealth without Output: the money will be limited; Output without Wealth: the money will not be solid;
with neither, what hope can there be?
Waiting by the stump for a hare is a figure for wishful thinking; the same holds if both are void.

zh: 有财无福，财必艰难，岂可财福俱无？
守株待兔，喻妄想也。
yi: 有财无子孙，求财已经艰难，哪能财、福都没有？
守株待兔，比喻空想。
en: With Wealth but no Output the money is already hard to get; how could one do with neither?
Waiting by the stump for a hare is a figure for wishful thinking.

zh: 财福俱无，莫若守株而待兔。
财与子孙爻俱不现，或现而又值休囚、空破、墓绝，或被克害刑冲，
须宜株守，图则无益。
yi: 妻财、子孙都没有，不如守着树桩等兔子（安守不动）。
财爻和子孙爻都不在卦上，或者在卦上却休囚、空亡、月破、入墓、临绝，或者受克、害、刑、冲，
就该守着不动，去谋求也没有用。
en: With neither Wealth nor Output, better to sit by the stump and wait for the hare (that is, stay put).
If neither the Wealth line nor the Output line appears, or they appear but are resting or trapped, void or broken, in tomb or extinction, or are controlled, harmed, punished or clashed,
one should hold still; pursuing it brings nothing.

zh: 觉子曰：倘得日月为财，或伏而旺者，亦可求也。
yi: 觉子说：如果日辰或月建就是财，或者财爻伏藏而旺，也还可以求。
en: Juezi says: if the Day or the Month is itself Wealth, or the Wealth line is hidden but strong, it can still be pursued.

title: 父兄皆动，无殊缘木以求鱼

rule.yi: 父母、兄弟同时发动：父母克子孙（断财源），兄弟克妻财（劫财），求财必不可得；父化兄、兄化父同论。
rule.en: If Resource and Peer both move, Resource cuts off Output (the source of money) and Peer robs Wealth: the money cannot be had. Resource turning into Peer, or Peer into Resource, is judged the same.

zh: 父兄皆动，
无殊缘木以求鱼。
yi: 父母、兄弟都发动，
和爬到树上去捉鱼没有两样。
en: When Resource and Peer both move,
it is like climbing a tree to catch fish.

zh: 父母为绝源杀，兄弟为劫财神。
二者发动，财福俱伤。
用神既损，求之必如缘木求鱼，必不可得。
父化兄，兄化父，亦然。
yi: 父母是断绝财源的煞，兄弟是劫财的神。
这两爻发动，妻财和子孙都受伤。
用神已经受损，去求就像缘木求鱼，一定得不到。
父母化兄弟、兄弟化父母，也一样。
en: Resource is the killer of the source; Peer is the robber of wealth.
When both move, Wealth and Output are both harmed.
With the Subject damaged, seeking the money is climbing a tree for fish: it cannot be had.
Resource turning into Peer, or Peer into Resource, is the same.

zh: 父母能克子孙，能生兄弟，
父兄皆动，犹如缘木求鱼，言必不可得也。
yi: 父母能克子孙，又能生兄弟，
父母、兄弟都动，就像缘木求鱼，意思是一定得不到。
en: Resource controls Output and generates Peer;
so when Resource and Peer both move it is like climbing a tree for fish, meaning the money cannot be had.

zh: 父兄爻动，无殊缘木以求鱼。
父动克福神，兄动克财爻，此二爻动于卦中，凡图无济。
yi: 父母、兄弟爻发动，和缘木求鱼没有两样。
父母动克子孙，兄弟动克财爻，这两爻在卦中发动，凡是谋求都没用。
en: When the Resource and Peer lines move, it is like climbing a tree for fish.
Resource moving controls Output, Peer moving controls the Wealth line; when these two move in the hexagram, no plan succeeds.

title: 月带财神，卦虽无而月中必有

rule.yi: 卦中无财而月建是财：这个月内必有财，月建旺财纵遇兄弟也不怕；财再出现在卦上更好。王洪绪：月建扶起伏藏的财，到那一爻值日可得。
rule.en: If the hexagram has no Wealth but the Month is Wealth, money will come within the month, and a Wealth this strong fears no Peer line; better still if Wealth also shows in the hexagram. Wang Hongxu: the Month lifts the hidden Wealth line, and the money arrives on the day that branch comes round.

zh: 月带财神，
卦虽无，而月中必有；
yi: 月建带着财，
卦里虽然没有财，这个月里一定会有；
en: When the Month carries Wealth,
even if the hexagram has none, it will come within the month;

zh: 月建为提纲。
若带财爻得时有气，纵遇兄弟，衰不敌旺，必主财利厚。
虽卦中无财，月中必然有。
得出现尤妙。
yi: 月建是总纲。
月建若是财爻，当令有力，即使碰上兄弟，弱的敌不过旺的，一定财利丰厚。
即使卦里没有财，这个月里也一定会有。
财爻再出现在卦上就更好。
en: The Month is the master key.
If the Month carries the Wealth line, in season and full of force, then even against a Peer line the weak cannot beat the strong, and the profit will be rich.
Even with no Wealth in the hexagram, it will come within the month.
Better still if Wealth also appears in the hexagram.

zh: 月建为提纲，若带财爻，虽正卦无财，而伏财亦明，
月建拱扶所伏之神，值日必有得也。
yi: 月建是总纲，月建若是财，即使本卦没有财，伏藏的财也显明了，
因为月建扶起了伏着的那一爻，到它值日的那天一定能得。
en: The Month is the master key; if it carries the Wealth line, then even though the main hexagram shows none, the hidden Wealth is brought to light;
the Month props up the hidden line, and on the day its branch comes round the money will be had.

title: 日伤妻位，财虽旺而当日应无

rule.yi: 财爻旺相、生合世爻或持世，本是必得；若日辰克财，当天得不到，要过了这一天才得。
rule.en: A thriving Wealth line that generates, combines with or holds the Self line means certain gain; if the Day controls it, nothing comes that day; it comes after the day has passed.

zh: 日伤妻位，
财虽旺，而当日应无。
yi: 日辰克伤财爻，
财即使旺，当天也得不到。
en: When the Day harms the Wealth line,
even a thriving Wealth brings nothing that day.

zh: 财爻旺相，生合持世，乃是必得之象。
若被日辰克制其财，纵现，必然无有。
须过此日，然后有得。
yi: 财爻旺相，又生合世爻或持世，本是一定能得的象。
如果日辰克制财爻，财即使出现，也一定拿不到。
要过了这一天，才会得到。
en: A thriving Wealth line that generates, combines with or sits on the Self line is a sign of certain gain.
But if the Day controls it, the money will not come, even though it shows.
Only after that day passes will it be had.

zh: 财爻旺相生合持世，乃是必得之象，
若被日神克制，须过此日然后可得。
yi: 财爻旺相、生合世爻或持世，本是必得之象，
如果被日辰克制，要过了这一天才能得。
en: A thriving Wealth line that generates or combines with the Self line, or sits on it, is a sign of certain gain;
if the Day controls it, the money comes only after that day.

title: 多财反复，必须墓库以收藏

rule.yi: 财爻太多（三五重，或临日月、动变俱是财）为太过，反复难求；要有财的墓库来收：见财的墓库爻发动或持世（旧注、王洪绪），或等财爻入墓之日（野鹤）。财化财也主反复。
rule.en: Too much Wealth (three to five lines, or coinciding with Day and Month, or moving and changed lines all Wealth) is excess and goes back and forth; it needs Wealth's tomb to gather it in: Wealth's tomb line moving or on the Self line (old commentary, Wang Hongxu), or the day Wealth enters its tomb (Yehe). Wealth turning into Wealth also means back and forth.

dispute.yi: 「墓库收藏」三家读法不同：旧注要卦里有财的墓库爻发动；王洪绪要财的库爻持世或临卦身；野鹤不看卦里有没有库爻，改成应期——等财爻入墓的那一天。
dispute.en: They read 'gathered in by the tomb' three ways: the old commentary wants Wealth's tomb line moving in the hexagram; Wang Hongxu wants that tomb line on the Self or Body line; Yehe ignores whether the hexagram has one and turns it into timing: the money comes on the day Wealth enters its tomb.

zh: 多财反复，
必须墓库以收藏；
yi: 财爻太多就反复不定，
一定要有墓库把它收起来；
en: Too much Wealth goes back and forth;
it needs a tomb (storehouse) to gather it in;

zh: 卦中财只一位，有气不空，生合持世皆美。
若三五重太过，其财反复难求。
必须卦中有财库爻发动，谓财有库藏，必得厚利。
财化财，亦主反复不定。
yi: 卦里财爻只有一个，有气、不空，生合世爻或持世，都好。
如果有三五个，太多了，这财就反复不定，难求。
一定要卦里有财的墓库爻发动，叫作财有库藏，才会得厚利。
财化财，也主反复不定。
en: One Wealth line in the hexagram, with force and not void, generating, combining with or sitting on the Self line, is good in every way.
Three to five of them is too much: the money goes back and forth and is hard to get.
It needs Wealth's tomb line moving in the hexagram; that is called Wealth having a storehouse, and the profit will be rich.
Wealth turning into Wealth also means back-and-forth uncertainty.

zh: 卦中财现三五重为太过，其财反复难求，
须有财之库爻持世身，谓之财有收藏，必得厚利也。
yi: 卦里财现三五个是太过，这财反复难求，
要有财的库爻持世或临卦身，叫作财有收藏，才一定得厚利。
en: Three to five Wealth lines showing is too much; the money goes back and forth and is hard to get;
it needs Wealth's tomb line to sit on the Self or the Body line; that is called the money being stored, and the profit will be rich.

zh: 多财反覆，必须墓库以收藏。
卦中财临日月，谓之太旺，
或动变俱是财爻，日月又作财星，谓之重叠，
若要求谋遂心，须待财爻入墓。
且如水作财神，辰日而得，余仿此。
yi: 财太多就反复，一定要等墓库把它收起来。
卦里财爻临日辰或月建，叫作太旺；
或者动爻、变爻都是财爻，日月又是财，叫作重叠；
要想求得如愿，要等到财爻入墓的时候。
比如财属水，就在辰日得（辰是水的墓），其余照此类推。
en: Too much Wealth goes back and forth; it must be gathered in by its tomb.
When the Wealth line in the hexagram coincides with the Day or Month, it is called over-strong;
or when moving and changed lines are all Wealth lines and the Day and Month are Wealth as well, it is called piled up;
to get what you seek, wait until the Wealth line enters its tomb.
For instance, if Wealth is Water, the money comes on a Chen day (Water's tomb); the rest by analogy.

title: 无鬼分争，又怕交重而阻滞

rule.yi: 官鬼能制兄弟：卦中无官鬼则兄弟专权、有人分争；官鬼发动又主阻隔。兄弟动时喜官鬼动来制；兄弟静时官鬼不宜动，动则泄财气、有口舌（觉子）。官鬼被克、冲散或合住，阻而无妨。
rule.en: Pressure keeps Peer in check: without Pressure, Peer takes over and there is fighting over shares; yet a moving Pressure line means obstruction. When Peer moves, a moving Pressure line is welcome to restrain it; when Peer is still, Pressure should not move, since it drains Wealth and brings quarrels (Juezi). If the Pressure line is controlled, clashed apart or combined, its obstruction does no harm.

zh: 无鬼分争，
又怕交重而阻滞。
yi: 卦里没有官鬼，就会有人分争；
官鬼发动又怕它带来阻滞。
en: Without Pressure there will be squabbling over shares;
yet a moving Pressure line is feared for the obstruction it brings.

zh: 无鬼之卦，兄必专权，财虽有气，亦多虚耗。
兄更发动，必有争夺买卖，分散财物之患。
然虽不可无，官又不宜动，动则必有阻隔。
若有克制，或被冲散，或被合住，虽阻不妨。
yi: 没有官鬼的卦，兄弟一定专权，财即使有气，也多虚耗。
兄弟再发动，一定有人争夺买卖、分走财物。
官鬼虽然不能没有，却又不宜发动，动了一定有阻隔。
如果官鬼被克制，或被冲散、被合住，即使有阻也不要紧。
en: In a hexagram without Pressure, Peer is sure to take control; even a Wealth with force is largely wasted.
If Peer also moves, there will be rivals fighting over the trade and splitting up the goods.
So although Pressure must not be absent, it should not move either; if it moves there will be obstruction.
If the Pressure line is controlled, clashed apart or held by a combination, the obstruction does no harm.

zh: 无鬼兄必专权，财虽有气亦多虚耗，
兄更发动，必有争夺分散财物之患；
官鬼又不宜动，动则必有阻隔。
yi: 没有官鬼，兄弟一定专权，财虽有气也多虚耗；
兄弟再发动，一定有争夺、分散财物的祸患；
官鬼又不宜发动，动了一定有阻隔。
en: Without Pressure, Peer takes control and even a Wealth with force is largely wasted;
if Peer moves as well there will be fighting over and scattering of the goods;
yet Pressure should not move either, for then there will be obstruction.

zh: 无鬼分争，又怕交重而阻滞。
兄弟，乃争夺、阻隔、耗财之神，宜鬼动而制之，以免分争之患。
yi: 没有官鬼就有分争，官鬼发动又怕阻滞。
兄弟是争夺、阻隔、耗财的神，宜官鬼发动去制它，免得有分争的祸患。
en: Without Pressure there is squabbling; a moving Pressure line is feared for obstruction.
Peer is the spirit of contention, obstruction and spending; Pressure should move to hold it down and spare you the quarrel.

zh: 觉子曰：兄爻发动，喜鬼动以制之，
倘兄爻安静，又不宜鬼动，鬼动反泄财爻之气也，且有口舌。
yi: 觉子说：兄弟发动，喜欢官鬼发动去制它；
如果兄弟安静，就不宜官鬼发动，官鬼动反而泄了财爻的气，还有口舌。
en: Juezi says: when the Peer line moves, a moving Pressure line is welcome to hold it down;
but if the Peer line is still, Pressure should not move, for then it drains the Wealth line and brings quarrels.

title: 兄如太过，反不克财

rule.yi: 一个兄弟旺动最不利。兄弟重叠太过（月日动变俱兄）时，经文说反不克财：旧注说到财爻生旺日可得；王洪绪说须见子孙发动；觉子不同意，认为到兄弟入墓或受损克之日仍会劫财。
rule.en: A single strong moving Peer line is the worst case. When Peer is in excess (Month, Day, moving and changed lines all Peer) the classic says it does not rob after all: the old commentary says the money comes on a day that births or empowers Wealth; Wang Hongxu says only if Output moves; Juezi disagrees: excessive Peer still robs on the day it enters its tomb or is cut down.

dispute.yi: 兄弟太过劫不劫财，三家说法不同：旧注说太过反而不劫，到财生旺日可得；王洪绪说要见子孙发动才不劫、利无穷，子孙静则不吉；觉子说太过的兄弟到入墓或受损克之日照样劫财，并举了一个九月兄弟入墓破财的例子。
dispute.en: Does excessive Peer rob or not? The old commentary: excess means it does not rob, and the money comes on a day that births or empowers Wealth. Wang Hongxu: it does not rob only if Output moves, and then the profit is endless; with Output still it is unlucky. Juezi: excessive Peer still robs on the day it enters its tomb or is cut down, and gives a case where the loss came in the ninth month when Peer entered its tomb.

zh: 兄如太过，
反不克财；
yi: 兄弟如果太多太旺，
反而不克财；
en: If Peer is in excess,
it does not rob Wealth after all;

zh: 兄弟乃占财忌杀，若有一位旺动，最为不利。
若月日动变，俱带兄弟，重叠太过，则不专一，反不克劫。
至财爻生旺日可得。
yi: 兄弟是占财的忌神，如果有一个旺而发动，最不利。
如果月建、日辰、动爻、变爻都是兄弟，重叠太过，力量就不专一，反而不去劫财。
到财爻生旺的日子就能得。
en: Peer is the adversary in a money question; a single strong moving Peer line is the worst case.
If the Month, the Day, and the moving and changed lines all carry Peer, the excess scatters its aim and it does not rob after all.
The money comes on a day that births or empowers the Wealth line.

zh: 兄弟乃占财之忌杀，日月动变俱带兄弟，重叠太过，
一见子孙发动，反不克财，其利无穷；
子孙安静多不吉。
yi: 兄弟是占财的忌神，日、月、动爻、变爻都带兄弟，重叠太过，
只要见到子孙发动，就反而不克财，利益无穷；
子孙安静，多半不吉。
en: Peer is the adversary in a money question; when Day, Month, moving and changed lines all carry Peer, in excess,
then as soon as Output moves, it does not control Wealth after all, and the profit is endless;
if Output is still, it is mostly unlucky.

zh: 兄如太过，反不克财。
旧注，卦中一位兄动最忌，若兄弟多动者，反不劫财。
yi: 兄弟太过，反而不克财。
旧注说：卦里一个兄弟发动最忌，如果兄弟多个发动，反而不劫财。
en: If Peer is in excess, it does not rob Wealth after all.
The old commentary: one moving Peer line is the thing most feared; if many Peer lines move, they do not rob after all.

zh: 觉子曰：余以为兄爻多者，待兄爻入墓之日，及损克兄爻之日，必劫其财，
谓之太旺者，损之斯成。
yi: 觉子说：我认为兄弟多的，到兄弟入墓的那天，以及兄弟受损、受克的那天，一定会劫财，
这就是「太旺的，要减损它才成事」。
en: Juezi says: I hold that where Peer lines are many, on the day Peer enters its tomb and on the day it is cut down or controlled, it will certainly rob the money;
this is what 'the over-strong come into effect when cut down' means.

zh: 如：巳月 丙辰日 (旬空：子丑)，占放印子钱，得“未济之归妹”
yi: 例：巳月丙辰日（旬空子、丑），占放高利贷，得未济卦变归妹卦。
en: Case: Si month, Bingchen day (void: Zi and Chou); the question was lending money at interest; the hexagram Weiji changing to Guimei.

zh: 断曰：此卦月建世爻，动变之爻，俱是兄弟，
占时顺遂，至九月，兄爻入墓，因奸破耗，
岂可谓之兄爻太过反不劫其财耶？！
yi: 断语：这一卦月建、世爻、动爻、变爻都是兄弟，
占的时候顺利，到九月兄弟入墓，因为奸情破财耗损，
怎么能说兄弟太多反而不劫财呢？！
en: Judgment: in this hexagram the Month, the Self line, and the moving and changed lines are all Peer;
at the time of casting things went smoothly, but in the ninth month, when the Peer line entered its tomb, he lost money through an illicit affair;
how can one say that too much Peer does not rob the money?!

title: 身或兄临，必难求望

rule.yi: 兄弟临卦身或持世，求财难有指望（卦身临财福吉、临父辛劳、临官利公门之财）。野鹤只看世爻，并认为兄弟持世而世逢月破、旬空、化墓，或日月为财冲克世爻，或世上兄弟化出财爻，仍可得财。
rule.en: Peer on the Body line or the Self line makes the money hard to get (Wealth or Output on the Body line is good, Resource means toil, Pressure favours official money). Yehe reads only the Self line, and holds that Peer on the Self line still gets the money if the Self line is under a Month-break, void, or turns into its tomb, if the Day or Month is Wealth and clashes with or controls the Self line, or if the Peer on the Self line turns into Wealth.

dispute.yi: 看卦身还是看世爻：旧注、王洪绪看卦身（兄临卦身难求，持世亦然）；野鹤认为卦身不验，只看世爻，并列出兄弟持世仍能得财的几种情形。
dispute.en: Body line or Self line? The old commentary and Wang Hongxu read the Body line (Peer on it means hardship, and the same on the Self line); Yehe holds the Body line unreliable, goes by the Self line alone, and lists the cases in which Peer on the Self line still gets the money.

zh: 身或兄临，
必难求望。
yi: 卦身如果临兄弟，
求财一定难有指望。
en: If the Body line carries Peer,
the money is hard to hope for.

zh: 卦身一爻，占财体统。
若持兄弟，不拘作何买卖，问何财物，皆无利益。持世亦然。
惟临财福，方为吉兆。
临父主劳禄，若占六畜血财，则有损失。
临官，大利公门求财，余皆险阻不利。
yi: 卦身这一爻，是占财的总体。
卦身若是兄弟，不管做什么买卖、问什么财物，都没有利。兄弟持世也一样。
只有临妻财、子孙，才是吉兆。
临父母主辛劳；若占六畜这类活物之财，会有损失。
临官鬼，很利于向官府求财，其余都险阻不利。
en: The Body line is the frame of the whole money question.
If it carries Peer, whatever the trade and whatever goods are asked about, there is no profit. Peer on the Self line is the same.
Only Wealth or Output on it is a good sign.
Resource on it means toil; for livestock and other living goods it means losses.
Pressure on it greatly favours money sought from official quarters; for anything else it means hazards and obstruction.

zh: 卦身一爻，占财体统，若持兄，
不拘作何买卖，问何财物，皆无利益，兄弟持世亦然。
yi: 卦身这一爻是占财的总体，如果是兄弟，
不管做什么买卖、问什么财物，都没有利益；兄弟持世也一样。
en: The Body line is the frame of the money question; if it carries Peer,
whatever the trade and whatever goods, there is no profit; Peer on the Self line is the same.

zh: 世遇兄临，必难求望。
古以卦身临兄爻，难于求望。
余因卦身不验，只以世爻为主，兄爻持世，难遂求谋。
野鹤曰：全在人之通变。兄弟而持世者，虽则为忌，亦有不当忌者。
yi: 世爻临兄弟，求财一定难有指望。
古法说卦身临兄弟，难有指望。
我因为卦身不灵验，只看世爻：兄弟持世，所求难以如愿。
野鹤说：全看人会不会变通。兄弟持世虽然是忌，也有不该忌的时候。
en: If the Self line carries Peer, the money is hard to hope for.
The old rule said: the Body line carrying the Peer line makes the money hard to hope for.
Because the Body line proved unreliable, I go by the Self line alone: the Peer line on the Self line makes the venture hard to fulfil.
Yehe says: it all depends on judging flexibly. Peer on the Self line is to be feared, yet there are cases where it should not be.

zh: 野鹤曰：余于此书，务必屡试屡验者，方存为法，非如他书，以偶合者即为式也。
故凡占得兄爻持世，而世值月破、旬空、化墓，
及日月作财冲世、克世，或世爻兄弟变出财爻，
皆许得财者，俱屡占得验，始敢告之。
若世持兄弟，非此类，不得以此例决之也。
yi: 野鹤说：这本书里，一定是屡试屡验的才留作法则，不像别的书，碰巧对上一次就当成定式。
所以凡是兄弟持世，而世爻逢月破、旬空、化入墓，
以及日辰月建是财、来冲世克世，或者世爻兄弟变出财爻，
这些都断能得财，都是屡次占验过，才敢告诉人。
如果兄弟持世而不属于这几类，不能拿这些例子来断。
en: Yehe says: in this book I keep as a rule only what has been tested and proved again and again, unlike other books that make a formula out of one lucky hit.
So whenever the Peer line sits on the Self line but the Self line is under a Month-break, is void, or turns into its tomb,
or the Day or Month is Wealth and clashes with or controls the Self line, or the Peer on the Self line turns into a Wealth line,
money may be granted in all these cases; each was proved in repeated readings before I dared to state it.
If Peer is on the Self line in any other way, these cases must not be used to decide it.

title: 财来就我终须易，我去寻财必是难

rule.yi: 财爻生、合、克世爻或持世，为「财来就我」，容易得；财爻虽动而与世爻无关，为「我去寻财」，难得。野鹤：不可拘泥，兄弟持世、财不生合世爻而照样得财的卦也有。
rule.en: The Wealth line generating, combining with, controlling or sitting on the Self line is 'the money coming to me': easy to get. A moving Wealth line with no tie to the Self line is 'me going after the money': hard. Yehe: do not cling to this; there are hexagrams with Peer on the Self line and no Wealth reaching it where the money came all the same.

zh: 财来就我，终须易；
我去寻财，必是难。
yi: 财来找我，终究容易；
我去找财，一定困难。
en: When the money comes to me, it is easy in the end;
when I go looking for the money, it is sure to be hard.

zh: 凡遇财爻生合世爻，克世持世，皆谓财来就我，必然易得。
若虽动出财爻，而与世爻不相干者，谓我去寻财，必难望也。
yi: 凡是财爻生合世爻，或克世、持世，都叫财来就我，一定容易得。
如果虽然动出了财爻，却和世爻没有关系，叫作我去找财，一定难有指望。
en: Whenever the Wealth line generates or combines with the Self line, controls it or sits on it, that is called the money coming to me, and it is easy to get.
If a Wealth line moves but has nothing to do with the Self line, that is called me going after the money, and there is little hope.

zh: 财爻生合世爻，持世克世，皆谓财来就我，必然易得；
若财爻而与世爻不相干者，谓我去寻财，必难望也。
yi: 财爻生合世爻，或持世、克世，都叫财来就我，一定容易得；
如果财爻和世爻不相干，叫作我去找财，一定难有指望。
en: The Wealth line generating or combining with the Self line, sitting on it or controlling it, is called the money coming to me: easy to get;
if the Wealth line has nothing to do with the Self line, that is me going after the money, with little hope.

zh: 财来就我终须易，我去求财定是难。
旧注，凡遇财爻生世、合世、克世、持世，皆谓之财来就我。
若卦中虽有财动，不来生合世爻，亦非我之财也。
yi: 财来就我终究容易，我去求财一定困难。
旧注说：凡是财爻生世、合世、克世、持世，都叫财来就我。
卦中即使有财爻发动，不来生合世爻，也不是我的财。
en: When the money comes to me it is easy in the end; when I go seeking it, it is sure to be hard.
The old commentary: whenever the Wealth line generates, combines with, controls or sits on the Self line, it is called the money coming to me.
Even if Wealth moves in the hexagram, if it does not generate or combine with the Self line, the money is not mine.

zh: 野鹤曰：亦不可拘执此说。
总之，善断者贵乎通变，以参其理，久之自能触类而悟，
即如前二卦，兄弟持世，何尝财来生合耶？
yi: 野鹤说：这个说法也不能死守。
总之，会断卦的人贵在变通，去琢磨其中的道理，久了自然能触类旁通，
就像前面两卦，兄弟持世，哪里有财来生合世爻呢？（两卦都照样得了财）
en: Yehe says: this rule must not be held rigidly either.
In short, a good reader values flexibility and weighs the reasoning; in time one learns to see the analogies,
as in the two previous cases: Peer sat on the Self line, and when did the money ever come to generate or combine with it? (Yet both got the money.)

title: 身遇旺财，似取囊中之物；世持动弟，如捞水底之针

rule.yi: 世爻持财：即使无气也容易得，旺相更好；世爻持兄弟：安静也难得，发动更难。
rule.en: Wealth on the Self line: easy to get even without force, better still if thriving. Peer on the Self line: hard even when still, harder when moving.

zh: 身遇旺财，似取囊中之物；
世持动弟，如捞水底之针。
yi: 世爻临旺相的财，像从自己口袋里拿东西；
世爻上是发动的兄弟，像在水底捞针。
en: If the Self line carries a strong Wealth, it is like taking something out of your own pocket;
if the Self line carries a moving Peer, it is like fishing a needle from the bottom of the water.

hits.text: 身遇旺财，似取囊中之物
世持动弟，如捞水底之针
身遇旺财，似取囊中之物
世持动弟，如捞水底之针

zh: 世为求财之人。
若临财爻，虽或无气，亦主易得；旺相更美。
若临兄弟，虽或安静，亦主难得；发动尤甚。
yi: 世爻是求财的人。
世爻如果临财爻，即使无气，也主容易得；旺相更好。
如果临兄弟，即使安静，也主难得；发动就更难。
en: The Self line is the person seeking the money.
If it carries the Wealth line, the money is easy to get even without seasonal force; thriving is better still.
If it carries Peer, the money is hard to get even when the line is still; moving, harder still.

zh: 世为求财之人，若临财爻，虽或无气，必主易得，旺相更美；
若临兄弟，虽或安静，亦主难得，发动尤甚。
yi: 世爻是求财的人，如果临财爻，即使无气，也一定容易得，旺相更好；
如果临兄弟，即使安静，也主难得，发动更甚。
en: The Self line is the person seeking the money; if it carries the Wealth line, the money is surely easy to get even without force, and better still if thriving;
if it carries Peer, it is hard even when still, and harder when moving.

title: 福变财生，滚滚财源不竭

rule.yi: 子孙发动（生财），利长久；子孙化财、财化子孙，而且生合世爻、卦身，财源不绝。
rule.en: A moving Output line (which feeds Wealth) means lasting profit; Output turning into Wealth, or Wealth into Output, especially generating or combining with the Self and Body lines, means money that keeps coming.

zh: 福变财生，
滚滚财源不竭；
yi: 子孙动而变出财来，
财源滚滚，用之不竭；
en: When Output turns into Wealth,
the money rolls in and never runs dry;

zh: 占财，得子孙发动，利必久远。
更化财爻，生合身世，乃绵绵不绝之象，尽求则尽有也。
财化子亦妙。
yi: 占财时，子孙发动，利一定长久。
再变出财爻，生合卦身、世爻，是绵绵不绝之象，要多少有多少。
财化子孙也好。
en: In a money question, a moving Output line means a lasting profit.
If it also turns into a Wealth line that generates or combines with the Body and Self lines, the money never stops: whatever you ask for, you get.
Wealth turning into Output is also good.

zh: 占财得子孙发动，利必久远，
更兼财爻生合世身，乃绵绵不绝之象。
遇有财化子亦然。
yi: 占财时子孙发动，利一定长久；
再加上财爻生合世爻、卦身，是绵绵不绝之象。
遇到财化子孙也一样。
en: In a money question a moving Output line means a lasting profit;
if the Wealth line also generates or combines with the Self and Body lines, the money never stops.
Wealth turning into Output is the same.

zh: 福变财生，利源滚滚。
财得子动生之，如财之有源也，其利丰厚。
倘得子动化财、财动化子者，皆同此断。
yi: 子孙变出财，利源滚滚。
财爻得到发动的子孙来生，就像财有了源头，利益丰厚。
如果是子孙动化财、财动化子孙，都这样断。
en: Output turning into Wealth: profit rolls on and on.
When a moving Output line feeds Wealth, the money has a spring, and the profit is rich.
Output moving into Wealth and Wealth moving into Output are judged the same way.

title: 兄连鬼克，纷纷口舌难逃

rule.yi: 兄弟、官鬼同时发动（王洪绪），或兄弟动而官鬼克世：主口舌是非，父母再动则成官讼。兄弟动变官鬼是回头克，兄弟被制，不能劫财克世（王洪绪、觉子驳旧注）；但野鹤举例，问财而见兄化鬼，可能应在兄弟（亲人）身上。
rule.en: Peer and Pressure moving together (Wang Hongxu), or Peer moving while Pressure controls the Self line: quarrels and trouble, and a lawsuit if Resource moves too. Peer moving into Pressure is a turn-back control that disables Peer, so it cannot rob or attack the Self line (Wang Hongxu and Juezi against the old commentary); but Yehe gives a case where Peer turning into Pressure in a money question showed up as a brother's death.

dispute.yi: 「兄连鬼克」怎么读：旧注读作兄弟变出官鬼来克世，主口舌、官讼；王洪绪和觉子都驳它——兄弟变官鬼是回头克，兄弟自身难保，不能再去克世；王洪绪改读为兄弟、官鬼同时发动才有口舌。野鹤把经文改成「兄伤鬼克」，并举例说兄化鬼虽然不劫财，却应在问卜人的弟弟身亡。
dispute.en: How to read 'Peer together with Pressure': the old commentary takes it as Peer turning into Pressure and attacking the Self line, meaning quarrels and lawsuits. Wang Hongxu and Juezi both reject this: Peer turning into Pressure is a turn-back control, Peer cannot save itself, let alone attack the Self line; Wang reads it instead as Peer and Pressure moving at the same time. Yehe rewrites the line as 'Peer harming, Pressure attacking', and gives a case where Peer turning into Pressure did not rob the money but showed up as the death of the asker's younger brother.

zh: 兄连鬼克，
纷纷口舌难逃。
yi: 兄弟连着官鬼来克，
免不了纷纷口舌。
en: When Peer comes together with Pressure to attack,
a flurry of quarrels cannot be avoided.

zh: 兄弟变出官鬼，刑冲克世，不惟无财，且有口舌。
父爻更动，必讼于官。
若有救制，庶几无害。
鬼化兄，或兄鬼皆动，亦然。
朱雀临兄鬼动变，有口舌。
yi: 兄弟变出官鬼，来刑冲克世爻，不但没有财，还有口舌。
父母再发动，一定打官司。
如果有救、有制，大概就无害。
官鬼化兄弟，或兄弟、官鬼都动，也一样。
朱雀临在动变的兄弟、官鬼上，有口舌。
en: If Peer turns into Pressure and punishes, clashes or controls the Self line, not only is there no money, there are quarrels as well.
If the Resource line also moves, it will end in court.
If there is rescue or restraint, there may be no harm.
Pressure turning into Peer, or Peer and Pressure both moving, is the same.
The Vermilion Bird on a moving or changing Peer or Pressure line means quarrels.

zh: 旧注这兄弟变官鬼来克世，是有口舌纷纷，予以为谬。
大凡卦中兄弟动克世爻，化官鬼回头克制，则不能口舌耗损矣。
予之屡验者，卦中官鬼兄弟皆发动，固有口舌是非。
兄连鬼克者，此谓兄弟与官鬼也，非谓兄弟化官鬼也。
yi: 旧注说这是兄弟变出官鬼来克世，所以口舌纷纷，我认为错了。
凡是卦中兄弟动来克世爻，变出官鬼回头克它，它就不能造成口舌耗损了。
我屡次验证的是：卦中官鬼、兄弟都发动，才有口舌是非。
「兄连鬼克」说的是兄弟和官鬼（一起），不是兄弟化官鬼。
en: The old commentary takes this as Peer turning into Pressure and attacking the Self line, hence the quarrels; I think that is wrong.
Whenever a moving Peer line attacks the Self line but turns into Pressure that turns back to control it, it can no longer cause quarrels or losses.
What I have verified again and again: when Pressure and Peer both move in the hexagram, there are quarrels and trouble.
'Peer together with Pressure' means Peer and Pressure (both), not Peer turning into Pressure.

zh: 兄伤鬼克，口舌纷纷。
财持世而兄亦动者，不独劫财，还防伤已。
若更鬼动克世者，更凶。
yi: 兄弟来伤、官鬼来克，口舌纷纷。
财持世而兄弟也动，不只劫财，还要防伤到自己。
如果再有官鬼动来克世，更凶。
en: Peer harming and Pressure attacking: quarrels on every side.
If Wealth is on the Self line and Peer moves as well, it not only robs the money but may harm you.
If Pressure also moves and controls the Self line, worse still.

zh: 觉子曰：《黄金策》云：兄连鬼克，口舌难逃。
谓兄动变鬼冲克世爻者，不独无财，还防口舌。
殊不知兄动变鬼，即是兄化回头之克，自顾不暇，又焉能冲克世爻耶？
yi: 觉子说：《黄金策》说「兄连鬼克，口舌难逃」，
旧说以为是兄弟动变官鬼、来冲克世爻，不但无财，还要防口舌。
却不知道兄弟动变官鬼，就是兄弟化出回头克，自身难保，又怎么能去冲克世爻呢？
en: Juezi says: the Golden Strategy says 'Peer together with Pressure attacking: quarrels cannot be escaped';
it is taken to mean Peer moving into Pressure and clashing with or controlling the Self line: no money, and quarrels to guard against.
They do not see that Peer moving into Pressure is Peer turning into something that turns back to control it; unable to save itself, how could it clash with or control the Self line?

zh: 如：酉月丙午日(旬空：寅卯)，占贸易有利否，得“师之坎”
yi: 例：酉月丙午日（旬空寅、卯），占做买卖有没有利，得师卦变坎卦。
en: Case: You month, Bingwu day (void: Yin and Mao); the question was whether a trading venture would profit; the hexagram Shi changing to Kan.

zh: 午财持世，兄动劫之，幸水化戌土，兄爻被克，不来劫财，
许之可行，必有利息。果得利。
后于九月，其胞弟得急症而死，乃悟此卦亥水兄弟变鬼故也。
如此问财而现丧弟者，余屡见之，后学不可不留心也。
yi: 午火财持世，兄弟动来劫它，幸好亥水化出戌土，兄弟被回头克，不来劫财，
所以断可以去做，一定有利。果然得利。
后来九月，他的亲弟弟得急病死了，才明白是这一卦亥水兄弟变出官鬼的缘故。
像这样问财却应在弟弟身亡的，我见过多次，后学不能不留心。
en: The Wu Fire Wealth sat on the Self line and a moving Peer came to rob it, but luckily the Water turned into Xu Earth, so the Peer line was controlled and did not rob the money;
so I said he could go ahead and would profit. He did.
Later, in the ninth month, his younger brother died of a sudden illness, and I understood it was because the Hai Water Peer line had turned into Pressure.
I have often seen a money question show a brother's death in this way; later students must watch for it.

title: 父化财，必辛勤而有得

rule.yi: 父化财：辛劳后得。兄化财：先散后聚（后利前不利）。官化财：利公门、谒贵、九流手艺求财；私财先惊后喜、先阻后得；若官鬼克世，为「助鬼伤身」，不吉（王洪绪）。
rule.en: Resource turning into Wealth: gain after toil. Peer turning into Wealth: first scattered, then gathered (good later, not at first). Pressure turning into Wealth: favours official money, patrons and people who live by a trade; for private money, fright then joy, obstruction then gain; if Pressure controls the Self line it is 'feeding the ghost that harms you', unlucky (Wang Hongxu).

zh: 父化财，
必辛勤而有得；
yi: 父母化出妻财，
一定要辛勤才有所得；
en: Resource turning into Wealth:
gain comes only through hard work;

zh: 父化财，不自然而得，必勤劳后得。
兄化财，先散后聚；或利于后，不利于前。
官化财，最利公门谒贵，及九流艺术之人，求财十分有望。
私财，则先惊后喜，或先阻后得。
yi: 父母化财，财不会自然到手，一定要勤劳之后才得。
兄弟化财，先散后聚；或者后面有利，前面不利。
官鬼化财，最利于在官府、拜见权贵求财，以及九流、手艺之人，求财很有希望。
如果是私人的财，就先惊后喜，或先有阻碍后得到。
en: Resource turning into Wealth: the money does not come of itself; it comes after hard work.
Peer turning into Wealth: first scattered, then gathered; or favourable later, not at first.
Pressure turning into Wealth is best for money sought in official quarters or from patrons, and for people who live by a trade or an art; the money is very likely.
For private money, first a fright and then joy, or first obstruction and then gain.

zh: 父化财不能自然而得，必勤劳可有。
兄化财先散后聚，或利于后不利于前。
官化财爻生合世身，最利公门谒贵及九流艺术之人，求财十分有望；
如官来克世，谓之助鬼伤身，公私皆不吉也。
yi: 父母化财，不能自然得到，一定要勤劳才有。
兄弟化财先散后聚，或者后面有利前面不利。
官鬼化出财爻、生合世爻卦身，最利于官府、拜见权贵以及九流手艺之人，求财很有希望；
如果官鬼来克世，叫作「助鬼伤身」（财去生鬼，鬼来伤自己），公事私事都不吉。
en: Resource turning into Wealth cannot come of itself; only hard work brings it.
Peer turning into Wealth: first scattered, then gathered, or favourable later but not at first.

Pressure turning into a Wealth line that generates or combines with the Self and Body lines is best for official quarters and patrons and for people who live by a trade or an art: the money is very likely;
if the Pressure line controls the Self line, it is called 'feeding the ghost that harms you' (the money feeds Pressure, and Pressure hurts you): public or private, it is unlucky.

title: 财化鬼，防耗折而惊忧

rule.yi: 财化官鬼最凶：损折虚耗、有惊险，伤世则因财致祸。财化兄弟：与人分利、先聚后散（王洪绪把它和财化鬼并列为最凶）。财化父母：得后艰辛或只一次。财化死墓空绝：有名无实；若生合世爻，宜抢先去取。
rule.en: Wealth turning into Pressure is the worst: losses, waste and danger, and disaster brought on by the money if it harms the Self line. Wealth turning into Peer: sharing the profit, gathered then scattered (Wang Hongxu ranks it with Wealth-into-Pressure as the worst). Wealth turning into Resource: hardship after the gain, or only once. Wealth turning into death, tomb, void or extinction: a name without substance; if it generates or combines with the Self line, act at once.

dispute.yi: 财化兄弟有多凶：旧注说是与人分利、先聚后散；王洪绪把它和财化官鬼并列为「最凶」。
dispute.en: How bad is Wealth turning into Peer? The old commentary: sharing the profit, gathered then scattered. Wang Hongxu puts it alongside Wealth turning into Pressure as 'the worst'.

zh: 财化鬼，
防耗折而惊忧。
yi: 妻财化出官鬼，
要防耗损折本，还有惊忧。
en: Wealth turning into Pressure:
beware of losses, and of fright and worry.

zh: 财化官最凶。主损折虚耗，自有惊险。
更伤世爻，切恐因财致祸。
财化兄，主与人分利；或先聚后散；或利于前，不利于后。
财化父，主得后艰辛；或只许一度。
财化死墓空绝，是有虚名，无实利之象。
若得生合世爻，则上前有功，稍迟则无也。
yi: 财化官鬼最凶，主亏损虚耗，还有惊险。
如果再伤世爻，就怕因财惹祸。
财化兄弟，主和别人分利；或先聚后散；或前面有利、后面不利。
财化父母，主得财以后很辛苦；或者只有一次。
财化入死、墓、空、绝，是有虚名、无实利之象。
如果变出的爻生合世爻，就是抢先去做有收获，稍晚就没了。
en: Wealth turning into Pressure is the worst: losses and waste, and danger besides.
If it also harms the Self line, beware of disaster brought on by the money.
Wealth turning into Peer: sharing the profit with others; or first gathered, then scattered; or favourable at first, not later.
Wealth turning into Resource: hardship after the gain; or it happens only once.
Wealth turning into death, tomb, void or extinction: a name without real profit.
If the changed line generates or combines with the Self line, going at once pays; a little later there is nothing.

zh: 财化官鬼 或化兄最凶，主损折驳耗，
更见世爻有伤，恐因财致祸。
yi: 财化官鬼或化兄弟最凶，主亏损、折耗，
再见世爻受伤，恐怕因财惹祸。
en: Wealth turning into Pressure or into Peer is the worst: losses and waste;
if the Self line is harmed as well, beware of disaster brought on by the money.

title: 财局合福神，万倍利源可取

rule.yi: 三合成财局而子孙在局中动，或成子孙局而财在局中动，并来生合世爻：财利不绝，财旺可许厚利（经文说万倍，野鹤说百倍）；野鹤要世爻在局中或局来生世。合成父局辛劳、兄局破耗、鬼局阻隔口舌，克世更凶。
rule.en: A three-harmony Wealth frame with Output moving inside it, or an Output frame with Wealth moving inside it, generating or combining with the Self line: profit without end, and with a strong Wealth a great profit (the classic says ten-thousandfold, Yehe a hundredfold); Yehe requires the Self line to be in the frame or to be generated by it. A Resource frame means toil, a Peer frame losses, a Pressure frame obstruction and quarrels, worse if it controls the Self line.

zh: 财局合福神，
万倍利源可取；
yi: 财局合着子孙，
万倍的利源可以取得；
en: A Wealth frame that includes Output:
profit ten-thousandfold is there to take;

zh: 卦有三合，会成财局，而子孙亦在合中动者，上吉之卦。
主财利绵绵不竭。更得财旺，可许万倍财利。
会成福局，而财爻又在合中，动来生合世爻者，亦然。
若会鬼局，则多阻隔。会成兄局，则主分散。会成父局，艰辛难得。
yi: 卦里有三合，会成财局，而子孙也在合局中发动，是上吉之卦。
主财利绵绵不绝。再加上财旺，可以断万倍之利。
会成子孙局，而财爻也在局中、动来生合世爻，也一样。
如果会成官鬼局，多阻隔；会成兄弟局，主分散；会成父母局，艰辛难得。
en: If three lines combine into a three-harmony frame of the Wealth element and Output moves within it, it is a first-class hexagram.
The profit never runs dry; if Wealth is also strong, a ten-thousandfold profit may be granted.
The same if the frame is of the Output element and the Wealth line is in it, moving to generate or combine with the Self line.
A Pressure frame means much obstruction; a Peer frame means dispersal; a Resource frame means hardship and little gain.

zh: 卦有三合会成财局，而在卦中动来生世，主财利绵绵不竭，
更得财旺，可许万倍财利。
会成福局动来生合世爻者亦然。
yi: 卦里三合会成财局，并且在卦中动来生世爻，主财利绵绵不绝；
再加上财旺，可以断万倍之利。
会成子孙局、动来生合世爻，也一样。
en: If three lines form a three-harmony Wealth frame that moves to generate the Self line, the profit never runs dry;
if Wealth is also strong, a ten-thousandfold profit may be granted.
The same for an Output frame that moves to generate or combine with the Self line.

zh: 财局合福德，百倍利源可许。
世与财爻，或与子孙爻三合成局，诸占物阜财丰。
野鹤曰：须要在局中，或是合成财局、子孙局生世，方为全美。
倘合成父局，辛苦劳碌；合成兄局，破耗多端；合成鬼局，灾非口舌；克世者更凶。
yi: 财局合着子孙，可以断百倍之利。
世爻和财爻，或和子孙爻三合成局，占什么都物产丰盛、财源充足。
野鹤说：世爻要在合局之中，或者合成的财局、子孙局来生世，才算完美。
如果合成父母局，辛苦劳碌；合成兄弟局，破耗很多；合成官鬼局，灾祸是非口舌；局来克世更凶。
en: A Wealth frame joined with Output: a hundredfold profit may be granted.
When the Self line forms a three-harmony frame with the Wealth line or with the Output line, every question shows goods and money in plenty.
Yehe says: the Self line must be inside the frame, or a Wealth or Output frame must generate it; only then is it perfect.
A Resource frame means toil; a Peer frame, losses of every kind; a Pressure frame, trouble and quarrels; worse still if the frame controls the Self line.

title: 岁君逢劫杀，一年生意无聊

rule.yi: 占长期买卖看太岁：太岁临兄弟（劫杀），一年无利，兄弟上卦发动必有损耗；临官鬼一年惊忧，临父母一年艰辛，临财福一年顺利。
rule.en: For long-term trade, look at the Tai Sui: on Peer (the robber), no profit all year, and losses if that Peer line shows and moves; on Pressure, a year of worry; on Resource, a year of hardship; on Wealth or Output, a smooth year.

note.yi: 这里的「劫杀」「劫煞」指兄弟爻（野鹤明说）。《天玄赋》求财章的「劫杀加临兄位」里，劫杀是另一个神煞，不是兄弟，不要混。
note.en: Here 'the robber' (jiesha) means the Peer line, as Yehe says outright. In the Tianxuan Fu's chapter on wealth, 'the robber star on the Peer line' names a separate spirit-star, not Peer; do not confuse the two.

zh: 岁君逢劫杀，
一年生意无聊。
yi: 太岁落在兄弟（劫杀）上，
这一年生意都没意思。
en: If the Tai Sui falls on the robber (Peer),
the whole year's business is dull.

zh: 凡占久远买卖，最怕太岁临持兄弟，主一年无利。
出现变动，必然损耗。
岁持官鬼，一年惊忧。持父一年艰辛。
岁持财福，生意滔滔，一年顺利也。
yi: 凡是占长期的买卖，最怕太岁临兄弟，主一年没有利。
（这个兄弟）出现在卦上又发动，一定有损耗。
太岁临官鬼，一年惊忧；临父母，一年艰辛。
太岁临妻财、子孙，生意兴隆，一年顺利。
en: In any question about long-term trade, the thing most feared is the Tai Sui falling on Peer: no profit for the year.
If that line appears in the hexagram and moves, there will certainly be losses.
The Tai Sui on Pressure: a year of fright and worry. On Resource: a year of hardship.
On Wealth or Output: business flows and the year goes smoothly.

zh: 凡占久远买卖，最怕太岁临持兄弟，主一年无利。
持官鬼一年惊忧，持父一年艰辛，财福一年顺利也。
yi: 凡是占长期的买卖，最怕太岁临兄弟，主一年没有利。
临官鬼一年惊忧，临父母一年艰辛，临财福一年顺利。
en: In any question about long-term trade, the thing most feared is the Tai Sui falling on Peer: no profit for the year.
On Pressure, a year of worry; on Resource, a year of hardship; on Wealth or Output, a smooth year.

zh: 岁君逢劫煞，一年生意无聊。
劫煞者，乃兄弟之爻也，兄临太岁，一年破耗。
yi: 太岁逢劫煞，一年生意没意思。
劫煞就是兄弟爻；兄弟临太岁，一年破耗。
en: If the Tai Sui meets the robber, the whole year's business is dull.
The robber here is the Peer line; Peer on the Tai Sui means a year of losses.

title: 世应二爻空合，虚约难凭

rule.yi: 世爻空：有财难得；应爻空：别人靠不住；世应俱空：谋事无准。空而动又相合（或化空），为「虚约」，口头答应而不实。
rule.en: Self line void: even existing money is hard to get. Other line void: others cannot be relied on. Both void: nothing certain. Void and moving yet combining (or turning void) is an 'empty promise': agreed in words, not in fact.

zh: 世应二爻空合，
虚约难凭；
yi: 世、应两爻落空又相合，
是空口的约定，靠不住；
en: If the Self and Other lines are void yet combining,
it is an empty promise that cannot be relied on;

zh: 世空，有财难得；应空，难靠他人；
世应俱空，艰辛无准实。
空动带合，谓之虚约。
化入空亡，亦是心口不相应之象。
yi: 世爻空，有财也难得；应爻空，靠不住别人；
世、应都空，辛苦而没有准头。
空而发动、又带相合，叫作「虚约」。
动而化入空亡，也是心口不一之象。
en: Self void: even existing money is hard to get; Other void: others cannot be relied on;
both void: toil with nothing certain.
Void and moving yet combining: that is called an empty promise.
Turning into the void is also a sign that words and intentions do not match.

zh: 世空有财难得，应空难靠他人，
世应俱空谋无准实，空动带合谓之虚约，化空亦然。
yi: 世空有财也难得，应空靠不住别人，
世应都空，谋事没有准头；空而动又带合，叫作虚约；化空也一样。
en: Self void: money hard to get; Other void: others unreliable;
both void: nothing certain in the plan; void, moving and combining is called an empty promise; turning void is the same.

title: 主人一位刑伤，往求不遇

rule.yi: 去求某人得财，以代表他的那一爻为「主人」（求贵人看官鬼，求妇人看妻财，不知是谁看应爻）。这一爻被日辰、动爻刑克，或空、化空：见不到，见了也无益；生合世爻、化出财爻生合世爻：最吉。
rule.en: When the money depends on someone you go to, the line standing for that person is the 'patron' (Pressure for a person of rank, Wealth for a woman, the Other line if you cannot tell). If that line is punished or controlled by the Day or a moving line, or is void or turns void, you will not find them and meeting would not help; if it generates or combines with the Self line, or turns into Wealth that does, it is best.

note.yi: 求贵人时，旧注写「财鬼为主」，王洪绪写「鬼为主」；王的写法和「求妇人财为主」一句对得更齐，但两个本子各自如此，不改原文。
note.en: For a person of rank the old commentary says 'Wealth and Pressure stand for them', Wang Hongxu says 'Pressure'. Wang's wording pairs more neatly with 'Wealth for a woman', but each edition reads as it does and we leave both as they are.

zh: 主人一位刑伤，
往求不遇。
yi: 所求之人那一爻受刑伤，
去求也见不到。
en: If the line of the person you go to is punished or harmed,
you will not find them when you go.

zh: 主人：如求贵人，财鬼为主；求妇人财，财为主类。
若主人遇动爻日辰刑克，或自空化空，皆主不遇，遇亦不利。
须得生合世爻，财为契爱，求必易得。
主人化出财爻，生合世爻，最吉。
不知主人，以应爻论之。
yi: 主人（所求的人）：比如求贵人，以财、官鬼为主；求妇女的财，以财为主，诸如此类。
如果主人那一爻被动爻、日辰刑克，或自身落空、化空，都主见不到，见到也不利。
要它生合世爻，财来得情愿，求财一定容易。
主人那一爻化出财爻、生合世爻，最吉。
不知道主人该看哪一爻，就用应爻来论。
en: The patron (the person you go to): when seeking a person of rank, Wealth and Pressure stand for them; when seeking money from a woman, Wealth does, and so on.
If that line is punished or controlled by a moving line or the Day, or is void or turns void, you will not find them, and meeting them would not help.
It should generate or combine with the Self line; then the money is given willingly and is easy to get.
If that line turns into a Wealth line that generates or combines with the Self line, it is best.
If you cannot tell which line is the patron, judge by the Other line.

zh: 主人，如求贵人则鬼为主，求妇人财为主类。
若主爻遇日辰动爻刑伤，或自空、或化空，皆主不遇，遇亦不利。
yi: 主人：比如求贵人，就以官鬼为主；求妇女，就以财为主，诸如此类。
如果主人那一爻被日辰、动爻刑伤，或者自身落空、化空，都主见不到，见到也不利。
en: The patron: when seeking a person of rank, Pressure stands for them; when seeking a woman, Wealth, and so on.
If that line is punished or harmed by the Day or a moving line, or is void or turns void, you will not find them, and meeting would not help.

title: 世持空鬼，多因自己迟疑

rule.yi: 官鬼持世，财来生鬼，本来求财容易；若世上的官鬼（或妻财）落空，是自己迟疑退缩，所以不成。
rule.en: With Pressure on the Self line, Wealth feeds it and money should come easily; if that Pressure (or a Wealth) on the Self line is void, it is your own hesitation that makes it fail.

zh: 世持空鬼，
多因自己迟疑；
yi: 世爻持官鬼而落空，
多半是因为自己迟疑；
en: If the Self line holds a void Pressure line,
it is mostly because you yourself hesitate;

zh: 鬼爻持世，财必相生，凡求必易。
若遇空亡，乃是自不上前，迟疑退懒，故无成也。
世持空财亦然。
yi: 官鬼持世，财一定来生它，凡是求财一定容易。
如果逢空亡，是自己不上前，迟疑退缩、懒散，所以不成。
世爻持财而落空，也一样。
en: With the Pressure line on the Self line, Wealth is bound to feed it, and anything sought comes easily.
If it is void, it is you who hold back, hesitating and slacking, so nothing comes of it.
A void Wealth on the Self line is the same.

zh: 鬼爻持世，财必相生，凡求必易；
若遇空亡，乃自不上前，迟疑退怯，故无成也。
世持空财亦然。
yi: 官鬼持世，财一定来生它，凡是求财一定容易；
如果逢空亡，是自己不上前，迟疑胆怯，所以不成。
世爻持财而落空，也一样。
en: With the Pressure line on the Self line, Wealth feeds it and anything sought comes easily;
if it is void, it is you who hold back, hesitant and timid, so nothing comes of it.
A void Wealth on the Self line is the same.

title: 辰合动财，却被他人把住

rule.yi: 财爻动来生合世爻本易得；若被日辰或动爻合住，财被人把持：合它的那一爻（卦无财则看财伏在哪一爻下）就是把持的人，如父母为长辈、官鬼为贵人；到冲开之日才到手（王洪绪）。
rule.en: A moving Wealth line that generates or combines with the Self line is easy money; but if the Day or a moving line combines with and holds it, someone is keeping it back. The holding line (or, if there is no Wealth, the line the hidden Wealth lies under) shows who: Resource an elder, Pressure a person of rank. It arrives on the day that clashes the combination open (Wang Hongxu).

zh: 辰合动财，
却被他人把住。
yi: 日辰合住发动的财爻，
这财就被别人把持住了。
en: When the Day combines with a moving Wealth line,
someone else has hold of the money.

zh: 要财动来生合，固是易得之兆；
若被动爻日辰合住，其财必有人把持主张，不能与我也。
要知何人把持，以合爻定之。如父母合住，为尊长把持类。
卦若无财，看伏何爻下，亦可推之。如伏官下，为贵人把持之类。
yi: 财爻动来生合世爻，本来是容易得的征兆；
如果被动爻或日辰合住，这财一定有人把持、做主，不能给我。
要知道是谁把持，看合住它的那一爻：比如父母合住，就是长辈把持，诸如此类。
卦里如果没有财，看财伏在哪一爻下面，也能推出来：比如伏在官鬼下，就是贵人把持，诸如此类。
en: Wealth moving to generate or combine with you is certainly a sign of easy gain;
but if a moving line or the Day combines with it and holds it, someone is controlling the money and it cannot come to me.
To know who holds it, look at the combining line: if Resource holds it, an elder is in control, and so on.
If the hexagram has no Wealth, see which line the hidden Wealth lies under: under Pressure, a person of rank is holding it, and so on.

zh: 财爻动来生合世，固是易得之象，
若被动爻日辰合住，其财必有人把住，不能与我。
要知何人把持，以合爻定之，如父母合住为尊长把持类。
要知何日到手，必待逢冲之日方有也。
yi: 财爻动来生合世爻，本来是容易得的象；
如果被动爻、日辰合住，这财一定有人把住，不能给我。
要知道是谁把持，看合住它的那一爻，比如父母合住，就是长辈把持，诸如此类。
要知道哪天到手，一定要等到冲开合的那一天。
en: The Wealth line moving to generate or combine with the Self line is certainly a sign of easy gain;
if a moving line or the Day combines with and holds it, someone has hold of the money and it cannot come to me.
To know who holds it, look at the combining line: Resource holding it means an elder, and so on.
As for when it arrives: only on a day that clashes the combination open.

title: 要知何日得财，不离旺衰生合

rule.yi: 定得财之日看财爻状态：有气→合日或本日；太旺、太过→墓库日；休囚、逢绝→生旺日；被合、入墓→冲开之日；逢冲→合日；动逢月破→填实或合日；静→冲日；旬空→出旬；伏藏→出现（提起）之日。财死绝而有子孙扶，按子孙断；卦无财而兄弟生子孙，按兄弟断。
rule.en: Time the money by the state of the Wealth line: with force, the day that combines with it or its own day; over-strong or in excess, its tomb day; resting, trapped or extinguished, a day that births or empowers it; combined or entombed, the day that clashes it open; clashed, the combining day; moving under a Month-break, the day that fills it in or combines with it; still, the clashing day; void, once the cycle passes; hidden, the day it appears. If Wealth is dead but propped up by Output, time it by Output; if there is no Wealth and Peer feeds Output, time it by Peer.

zh: 要知何日得财，
不离旺衰生合；
yi: 要知道哪天得财，
离不开旺、衰、生、合；
en: To know on what day the money comes,
go by strength, weakness, generation and combination;

zh: 财爻有气，合日得财；或本日得财。
太旺，墓库日得；
休囚，生旺日得；
太过，收藏日得；
合住入墓，破合破墓日得；
旺空，过旬日得；
伏藏，提起日得。
财爻死绝，而得子孙动来扶起，即以子孙爻断。
卦无财爻，而得兄弟生扶子孙财源者，即以兄弟爻断。更宜通变。
yi: 财爻有气，在合它的日子得；或者在它本身值日的那天得。
太旺的，在它入墓库的日子得；
休囚的，在生它、旺它的日子得；
太多的，在收藏（入墓）的日子得；
被合住或入墓的，在冲破合、冲开墓的日子得；
旺而落空的，过了这一旬得；
伏藏的，在它被提起（出现）的日子得。
财爻死绝，而有子孙动来扶起它，就用子孙爻来断日子。
卦里没有财爻，而有兄弟去生扶子孙这个财源，就用兄弟爻来断日子。还要灵活变通。
en: A Wealth line with force: the money comes on the day that combines with it, or on the day of its own branch.
Over-strong: on the day of its tomb;
resting or trapped: on a day that births or empowers it;
in excess: on the day it is stored away (its tomb);
held by a combination or in its tomb: on the day that breaks the combination or opens the tomb;
strong but void: once the ten-day cycle has passed;
hidden: on the day it is lifted into view.
If the Wealth line is dead or extinguished but a moving Output line props it up, time it by the Output line.
If the hexagram has no Wealth line but a Peer line feeds Output, the source of money, time it by the Peer line. Judge flexibly.

zh: 财动入墓或被合，皆待冲日得；
或动财遇绝，必待生日得；
逢冲合日得；
动逢月破，填实逢合日得；
或安静，逢冲日得；
旬空出旬得；伏藏出现日得。
yi: 财爻动而入墓或被合住，都等冲的日子得；
发动的财爻逢绝，一定等生它的日子得；
逢冲的，在合它的日子得；
动而逢月破，等填实（本支值日）或逢合的日子得；
安静的，逢冲的日子得；
旬空的出了旬得；伏藏的在出现的日子得。
en: Wealth moving into its tomb, or held by a combination: wait for the clashing day;
a moving Wealth meeting extinction: wait for the day that gives it birth;
one that is clashed: on the day that combines with it;
moving but under a Month-break: on the day that fills it in or combines with it;
still: on the clashing day;
void: once out of the void cycle; hidden: on the day it appears.

title: 欲决何时有利，但详春夏秋冬

rule.yi: 货物何时得价：旧注按财爻五行当令的季节（木春、土夏而六月更好，同类中取更旺之月）；王洪绪说不能一概按五行，还要用冲合、生绝、墓开之法并看子孙爻。两家都说：财坐日辰的长生，一天比一天贵；坐帝旺，眼下正好，迟则贱。
rule.en: When goods will fetch a price: the old commentary goes by the season of the Wealth line's element (Wood in spring, Earth in summer and best in the sixth month, choosing the stronger month within a season); Wang Hongxu says not to rely on the element alone but also on clash and combination, birth and extinction, the opening of tombs, and the Output line. Both agree: Wealth at its Birth stage under the Day gains value day by day; at its Peak, now is the time, and later it cheapens.

dispute.yi: 旧注主张按财爻五行的当令季节断得价之时；王洪绪说不能一概而论，还要用冲合、生绝、墓开的方法，并看子孙爻。
dispute.en: The old commentary times the price by the season of the Wealth line's element; Wang Hongxu says that is too simple and adds clash-and-combination, birth-and-extinction, tomb-opening and the Output line.

zh: 欲决何时有利，
但详春夏秋冬。
yi: 要断定什么时候有利，
只要细看春夏秋冬（四时的旺衰）。
en: To decide when there will be profit,
look closely at spring, summer, autumn and winter.

zh: 凡占货物何时得价，以财临五行断之。
如木财，春月得价，一阳后亦好。
土财，夏月有利，六月更美。余仿此。
又如财临辰土，二月不如三月；财临酉金，七月不如八月。余亦仿此。
又如财主日下长生之地，此货一日得价一日；
若坐帝旺，眼下正及时，稍迟则贱而无利。
yi: 凡是占货物什么时候卖得上价，看财爻的五行来断。
比如财属木，春天的月份得价，冬至（一阳生）以后也好。
财属土，夏天的月份有利，六月更好。其余照此类推。
又比如财是辰土，二月不如三月；财是酉金，七月不如八月。其余也照此类推。
再比如财爻处在日辰的长生之地，这货一天比一天值钱；
如果坐帝旺，眼下正是时候，稍晚就便宜了、没有利。
en: In asking when goods will fetch a good price, judge by the element of the Wealth line.
Wood Wealth, for instance, sells well in the spring months, and is good after the winter solstice too (when the first yang returns).
Earth Wealth profits in the summer months, best in the sixth month. The rest by analogy.
Again, Wealth on Chen Earth: the second month is not as good as the third; Wealth on You Metal: the seventh month is not as good as the eighth. The rest by analogy.
Again, if the Wealth line sits at its Birth stage under the Day, the goods gain value day by day;
if it sits at its Peak, now is exactly the time; a little later the price drops and there is no profit.

zh: 凡占货物何时得价，不可概以财临五行断之，如木财断春冬得价。
又宜以冲待合、合待冲、绝逢生、墓待开等法，又宜以子孙爻断。
又如财坐长生之地，一日得一日价，
若从帝旺，目下正及时，迟则贱而无利。
yi: 凡是占货物什么时候得价，不能一概按财爻的五行来断，比如木财就断春、冬得价。
还要用「冲等合、合等冲、绝逢生、墓等开」这些方法，也要看子孙爻来断。
又比如财爻坐长生之地，一天比一天值钱；
如果在帝旺，眼下正当时，晚了就便宜、没有利。
en: In asking when goods will fetch a price, do not simply go by the element of the Wealth line, as in judging that Wood Wealth sells in spring and winter.
Use also the methods of a clashed line waiting for its combination, a combined line waiting for its clash, extinction meeting birth, and a tomb waiting to be opened; judge by the Output line as well.
Again, Wealth at its Birth stage gains value day by day;
at its Peak, now is the time; later the price drops and there is no profit.

title: 合伙不嫌兄弟

rule.yi: 合伙：世、应都是财爻最好；兄弟安静（或临卦身而世爻静）不嫌，因为合伙本要分财；兄弟发动则不宜。世应两动或落空：合不长久；相冲克：日后不和；化出兄官：多私心；世应生合而被刑冲克害：有人挑拨。野鹤：世、应临兄弟仍不吉，只有日月为财冲克世时反吉。
rule.en: Partnership: best if both the Self and Other lines are Wealth; a still Peer (or Peer on the Body line with the Self line still) is no objection, since partners share the money anyway; a moving Peer is bad. Self and Other both moving or void: it will not last; clashing or controlling each other: they will fall out; turning into Peer or Pressure: self-interest; combining but punished, clashed or controlled by others: someone will sow discord. Yehe: Peer on the Self or Other line is still unlucky, except when the Day or Month is Wealth and clashes with or controls the Self line.

dispute.yi: 兄弟到底嫌不嫌：经文说合伙不嫌兄弟；旧注、王洪绪说兄弟静可以、动不宜；野鹤引了经文，却接着说世、应临兄弟不吉、兄弟动也不吉，只有日月为财冲克世爻时反吉。
dispute.en: Is Peer really no objection? The classic says so for partnerships; the old commentary and Wang Hongxu allow a still Peer but not a moving one; Yehe quotes the classic but then says Peer on the Self or Other line is unlucky and a moving Peer too, the only exception being a Wealth Day or Month clashing with or controlling the Self line.

zh: 合伙不嫌兄弟；
yi: 合伙做生意，不嫌有兄弟；
en: In a partnership, Peer is no objection;

zh: 凡占合伙买卖，若世应俱财爻，必然称意。
兄临卦身，世爻安静不妨。
盖合必至分财，故也。
动则不宜。
世应两动，必合不久，空亡亦然。
相冲相克，后必不睦。
化出兄官，必多私心。
世应生合，而被动爻日辰刑冲克害者，必有挑唆破说也。
yi: 凡是占合伙买卖，如果世、应都是财爻，一定如意。
兄弟临卦身，只要世爻安静，也不要紧。
因为合伙本来就一定要分财。
（兄弟）发动就不好。
世、应都动，合伙一定不长久；（世应）落空亡也一样。
世应相冲相克，日后一定不和。
（世应）化出兄弟、官鬼，一定多私心。
世应相生相合，却被动爻或日辰刑冲克害，一定有人挑拨离间。
en: In a partnership question, if both the Self and the Other lines are Wealth lines, it will go as wished.
Peer on the Body line does no harm as long as the Self line is still.
For a partnership means sharing the money anyway.
But a moving Peer is not good.
If the Self and Other lines both move, the partnership will not last; the same if they are void.
If they clash or control each other, the partners will fall out later.
If they turn into Peer or Pressure, there will be much self-interest.
If Self and Other generate or combine with each other but a moving line or the Day punishes, clashes, controls or harms them, someone will sow discord between them.

zh: 凡占合伙买卖，若世应俱财必然称意。
兄临卦身必主分财故也。
静者无嫌，动则不宜。
yi: 凡占合伙买卖，世、应都是财，一定如意。
兄弟临卦身，本来就主分财，所以不嫌。
兄弟安静不嫌，发动就不好。
en: In a partnership question, Wealth on both Self and Other means it goes as wished.
Peer on the Body line simply means sharing the money, which is why it is no objection.
Still, it is no objection; moving, it is not good.

zh: 合伙不嫌兄弟，乏本内外无财。
世应临兄不吉，兄爻发动亦不吉。
倘世临兄弟，日月作财星冲克世者，反为吉也。
yi: 合伙不嫌有兄弟；缺本钱的，卦里内外都没有财。
世、应临兄弟不吉，兄弟发动也不吉。
如果世爻临兄弟，而日辰月建是财、来冲克世爻，反而是吉。
en: A partnership does not mind Peer; lacking capital shows as no Wealth inside or out.
Yet Peer on the Self or Other line is unlucky, and so is a moving Peer line.
But if the Self line carries Peer and the Day or Month is Wealth and clashes with or controls the Self line, it becomes lucky after all.

title: 公门何虑官爻

rule.yi: 一般占财忌官鬼发动（阻隔）；求公门（官府）之财反要官鬼：无鬼或鬼空，财旺也难到手；官鬼旺相、生合世爻卦身则吉；刑克世爻主责罚、祸害立至；官鬼死绝也不济事，须财、官两全才大吉。
rule.en: Money questions usually fear a moving Pressure line (obstruction), but money from official quarters needs Pressure: with no Pressure line, or a void one, even a strong Wealth is hard to get; Pressure thriving and generating or combining with the Self and Body lines is good; Pressure punishing or controlling the Self line means punishment and immediate trouble; a dead or extinguished Pressure line is no use either; only with both Wealth and Pressure sound is it very good.

zh: 公门何虑官爻。
yi: 在官府求财，何必顾虑官鬼。
en: For money from official quarters, why worry about the Pressure line?

zh: 占财皆忌官动，主有阻隔。
惟求公门之财，必然倚托官府。
若无鬼爻，或落空亡，则虽财爻有气，亦难到手。
必得旺相，生合世身则吉。
刑克世爻，主有杖责。
死绝亦不济事，须得财鬼两全，方为大吉。
yi: 占财一般都忌官鬼发动，主有阻隔。
只有求官府的财，一定要依靠官府。
如果没有官鬼，或官鬼落空亡，那么财爻即使有气，也难到手。
官鬼一定要旺相、生合世爻卦身才吉。
官鬼刑克世爻，主受杖刑责罚。
官鬼死绝也不管用，要财、官两全，才是大吉。
en: Money questions generally fear a moving Pressure line: it means obstruction.
Only money from official quarters depends on the officials.
If there is no Pressure line, or it is void, then even a Wealth line with force is hard to get into hand.
The Pressure line must be thriving and must generate or combine with the Self and Body lines; then it is good.
If it punishes or controls the Self line, expect a beating or punishment.
A dead or extinguished Pressure line is no use either; only with both Wealth and Pressure sound is it very good.

zh: 占财皆忌官动，主有阻隔，
唯求公门之财，必然倚托官府，
必得旺相生合世身则吉，刑克世爻祸害立至。
yi: 占财一般忌官鬼动，主阻隔；
只有求官府的财，一定要依靠官府，
官鬼要旺相、生合世爻卦身才吉，刑克世爻，祸害马上就来。
en: Money questions generally fear a moving Pressure line, which means obstruction;
only money from official quarters depends on the officials,
so the Pressure line must be thriving and generate or combine with the Self and Body lines; if it punishes or controls the Self line, disaster comes at once.

title: 九流术士，偏宜鬼动生身

rule.yi: 空手求财（百工九流）以官鬼为主顾：无官鬼最不利；官鬼出现发动、生合世爻则如意，化财更有大利；官鬼刑克世爻或化兄主是非；应爻空更不吉。但仍须财爻旺相、兄弟不动，才有实利。
rule.en: Earning without capital (craftsmen and the trades) takes the Pressure line as the client: no Pressure is the worst; Pressure appearing, moving and generating or combining with the Self line goes as wished, and turning into Wealth brings a large profit; Pressure punishing or controlling the Self line, or turning into Peer, means trouble; a void Other line is worse still. Yet there is real profit only if Wealth is also thriving and Peer still.

zh: 九流术士，
偏宜鬼动生身；
yi: 靠手艺、方术吃饭的人，
偏偏宜官鬼发动来生世身；
en: For those who live by a trade or an art,
a moving Pressure line that generates the Self line is exactly what is wanted;

zh: 百工九流求财，以鬼爻为主顾，无鬼最不利。
出现发动，生合世爻，必然称意。
更化财爻，决得大利。
须忌刑克世爻，或化兄，皆主惹是招非，不能遂意。
应空尤不吉。
大抵空手求财，虽要官爻，然须财爻旺相，兄弟不动，方主有财。
否则空好看，终无财利。
yi: 百工九流求财，以官鬼为主顾（出钱的客人），没有官鬼最不利。
官鬼出现、发动，生合世爻，一定如意。
再化出财爻，一定得大利。
要忌它刑克世爻，或化出兄弟，都主招惹是非，不能如意。
应爻落空更不吉。
总之空手求财，虽然要官鬼，但还必须财爻旺相、兄弟不动，才有财。
否则只是好看，终究没有财利。
en: Craftsmen and people of the trades seek money with the Pressure line as their client; no Pressure line is the worst.
If it appears, moves and generates or combines with the Self line, it will go as wished.
If it also turns into a Wealth line, a large profit is certain.
Beware of it punishing or controlling the Self line, or turning into Peer: both mean trouble and disappointment.
A void Other line is worse still.
In short, earning without capital needs the Pressure line, but it also needs a thriving Wealth line and a still Peer before there is money.
Otherwise it only looks good, and in the end there is no profit.

zh: 九流求财，以鬼爻为主顾，
出现发动，生合世爻，必然称意，忌刑克世爻。
yi: 九流求财，以官鬼为主顾，
官鬼出现发动，生合世爻，一定如意；忌它刑克世爻。
en: The trades seek money with the Pressure line as their client;
if it appears, moves and generates or combines with the Self line, it will go as wished; beware of it punishing or controlling the Self line.

title: 六畜血财，尤喜福兴持世

rule.yi: 占六畜（贩卖或饲养）以子孙为主：子孙旺相不空、持世临身则吉；父母发动有伤损；化出土鬼防瘟死；子孙旺而财空，畜好无利。
rule.en: For livestock, bought and sold or raised, Output is the main line: Output thriving, not void, on the Self or Body line is good; a moving Resource line means losses; turning into an Earth Pressure line, beware of plague; Output strong but Wealth void, the animals do well but there is no profit.

zh: 六畜血财，
尤喜福兴持世。
yi: 牲畜这类活物的财，
尤其喜欢子孙兴旺并持世。
en: For livestock and other living goods,
an Output line flourishing on the Self line is especially welcome.

zh: 凡占贩卖牲口，蓄养六畜，皆要子孙旺相不空，则吉。持世临身尤好。
父母发动，则有伤损。
化出土鬼，须防瘟死。
福旺财空。六畜虽好而无利。
yi: 凡是占贩卖牲口、饲养六畜，都要子孙旺相不空才吉；持世、临卦身更好。
父母发动，就有伤损。
（子孙）化出属土的官鬼，要防瘟疫死亡。
子孙旺而财空：六畜虽然好，却没有利。
en: Whether dealing in animals or raising livestock, Output must be thriving and not void; then it is good, and better still on the Self or Body line.
A moving Resource line means losses.
If it turns into an Earth Pressure line, beware of the animals dying of plague.
Output strong but Wealth void: the animals do well but there is no profit.

zh: 凡卜贩卖牲口、畜养六畜，皆要子孙旺相，持世临身则吉；
父母发动则有损伤；化出土鬼须防瘟死；
福旺财空，六畜虽好而无利。
yi: 凡是卜贩卖牲口、饲养六畜，都要子孙旺相，持世、临卦身就吉；
父母发动就有损伤；化出土鬼，要防瘟死；
子孙旺而财空，六畜虽好却没有利。
en: In dealing in or raising livestock, Output must be thriving; on the Self or Body line it is good;
a moving Resource line means losses; turning into an Earth Pressure line, beware of plague;
Output strong but Wealth void: the animals do well but there is no profit.

title: 世应同人，放债必然连本失

rule.yi: 放债：世、应都是兄弟（同人），讨不回来；财爻再绝，连本俱失；世应落空亦然。应爻生合世爻、妻财有气、子孙发动则吉；间爻兄鬼发动防经手人抽分；卦无财而官鬼化出财，要打官司才讨得回。
rule.en: Lending: Peer on both the Self and Other lines means the money cannot be recovered; with Wealth extinguished as well, the principal is lost; the same if Self and Other are void. Good if the Other line generates or combines with the Self line, Wealth has force and Output moves. A moving Peer or Pressure on the between lines: the middleman skims a share. No Wealth, but Pressure turning into it: recoverable only through a lawsuit.

zh: 世应同人，
放债必然连本失；
yi: 世、应都是兄弟，
放债一定连本钱都丢掉；
en: If the Self and Other lines are both Peer,
lending money means losing even the principal;

zh: 凡放私债，最忌世应值兄弟，必无讨处。
财爻更绝，连本俱失。世应值空，亦然。
须得应爻生合世爻，妻财有气，子孙发动则吉。
间临兄鬼动，恐放头抽分财利。
卦中无财，而官爻变出者，必讼于官府而后可取。
yi: 凡是放私人债，最忌世、应都是兄弟，一定讨不回来。
财爻再临绝，连本钱都丢；世应落空也一样。
要应爻生合世爻、妻财有气、子孙发动才吉。
间爻是兄弟或官鬼而发动，怕中间经手的人抽成分利。
卦里没有财，而官鬼变出财来，一定要到官府打官司才能讨回。
en: In private lending the thing most feared is Peer on both the Self and Other lines: there will be no one to collect from.
If the Wealth line is also extinguished, the principal is lost too; the same if Self and Other are void.
It is good only if the Other line generates or combines with the Self line, Wealth has force, and Output moves.
If the between lines carry a moving Peer or Pressure, the middleman may skim off a share of the interest.
If there is no Wealth in the hexagram and a Pressure line turns into it, the money can be recovered only through a lawsuit.

zh: 凡放私债，最忌世应值兄弟，必无讨处；
财爻更绝，连本俱无，世应值空亦然。
yi: 凡是放私人债，最忌世、应都是兄弟，一定讨不回来；
财爻再临绝，连本都没了；世应落空也一样。
en: In private lending the thing most feared is Peer on both Self and Other: nowhere to collect from;
if the Wealth line is also extinguished, the principal is gone too; the same if Self and Other are void.

title: 日月相合，开行定主有人投

rule.yi: 开行（牙行、铺面）：世应不空，财福齐全，官鬼有气，父兄衰静，为上吉；再得月建、日辰、动爻生合世爻，客人远近来投。卦无财而世爻只得生合：门口热闹、无实利（鬼旺财空同）；动出兄官多是非；世应空，开不成。
rule.en: Opening a brokerage or shop: Self and Other not void, Wealth and Output both present, Pressure with force, Resource and Peer weak and still is first-class; if the Month, the Day and moving lines also generate or combine with the Self line, clients come from near and far. With no Wealth, support for the Self line is only a busy doorway without profit (the same for strong Pressure and void Wealth); Peer or Pressure moving means quarrels; Self and Other void, it will not open.

zh: 日月相合，
开行定主有人投。
yi: 日辰、月建来合世爻，
开牙行一定有客人来投。
en: When the Day and Month combine with the Self line,
a brokerage that opens will surely draw clients.

zh: 开行牙人占财，世应要不空，财福要全备，官鬼要有气，父兄要衰静，斯为上吉卦。
更得月建日辰动爻生合世爻，则近悦远来，人皆投我，财利必顺。
卦若无财，而世得月日动爻生合者，不过门头闹热，无实利。
鬼旺财空，亦然。
动出兄官，常有是非口舌，或有恶人搅扰。
世应空，开不成。
yi: 开牙行的经纪人占财，世、应要不空，妻财、子孙要齐全，官鬼要有气，父母、兄弟要衰弱安静，这是上吉卦。
再有月建、日辰、动爻来生合世爻，就近者喜欢、远者来投，人人都来找我，财利一定顺。
卦里如果没有财，只是世爻得到月、日、动爻生合，不过是门口热闹，没有实利。
官鬼旺而财空，也一样。
动出兄弟、官鬼，常有是非口舌，或有恶人来捣乱。
世应落空，开不成。
en: When a broker opening a brokerage asks about money: Self and Other not void, Wealth and Output both present, Pressure with force, Resource and Peer weak and still; that is a first-class hexagram.
If the Month, the Day and moving lines also generate or combine with the Self line, near and far will come gladly and everyone will bring business to me; the profit will flow.
If there is no Wealth, and the Self line merely gets support from Month, Day and moving lines, it is only a busy doorway with no real profit.
Pressure strong and Wealth void: the same.
Peer or Pressure moving means constant quarrels, or bad characters making trouble.
Self and Other void: it will not open.

zh: 开行人占财，世应要不空，财福要全备，官鬼要有气，父兄要衰静，斯为上吉。
更得月建、日辰、动爻生合世爻，则近悦远来，财利必顺。
动出官兄常有是非口舌，应空主开不成。
yi: 开行的人占财，世、应要不空，财福齐全，官鬼有气，父兄衰静，这是上吉。
再有月建、日辰、动爻生合世爻，近者喜欢、远者来投，财利一定顺。
动出官鬼、兄弟，常有是非口舌；应爻落空，开不成。
en: When one opening a brokerage asks about money: Self and Other not void, Wealth and Output both present, Pressure with force, Resource and Peer weak and still; that is first-class.
If the Month, the Day and moving lines also generate or combine with the Self line, near and far come gladly and the profit flows.
Pressure or Peer moving means constant quarrels; a void Other line means it will not open.

title: 应落空亡，索借者失望

rule.yi: 向人讨要、借贷：应爻空（见不到人、不实）或动（对方变卦）都不宜；应爻生合世爻则对方慷慨。代表所借之物的爻也要不空：衣服书籍看父母，六畜酒器看子孙，财物（食物）看妻财。
rule.en: Asking for something or borrowing it: the Other line should be neither void (you will not find them, nothing is real) nor moving (they change their mind); if it generates or combines with the Self line they give generously. The line for the thing itself must also not be void: Resource for clothes and books, Output for livestock and wine vessels, Wealth for money, goods and food.

zh: 应落空亡，
索借者失望。
yi: 应爻落空亡，
去讨要、去借的人要失望。
en: If the Other line is void,
whoever goes to ask or borrow will be disappointed.

zh: 求索假借，不宜应空，应动。
动则更变，空则不遇。
生合世爻，慨然不吝。
必得物爻不空为妙。
如衣服经史看父爻，六畜酒器看福爻，其余财物看财爻。
又如花果看木爻，砖瓦看土爻类，亦是。
yi: 向人讨要、借东西，不宜应爻落空，也不宜应爻发动。
动就会变卦，空就见不到人。
应爻生合世爻，对方慷慨不吝啬。
还要代表那样东西的爻不空才好。
比如衣服、书籍看父母，六畜、酒器看子孙，其余财物看妻财。
又比如花果看木爻，砖瓦看土爻，诸如此类，也可以。
en: In asking for something or borrowing it, the Other line should be neither void nor moving.
Moving, the other party changes their mind; void, you will not find them.
If it generates or combines with the Self line, they give generously.
It is best if the line for the thing itself is not void.
For clothes and books, look at the Resource line; for livestock and wine vessels, the Output line; for other goods and money, the Wealth line.
Flowers and fruit can also be read from the Wood line, bricks and tiles from the Earth line, and so on.

zh: 求索假借不宜应空，空则不实，
必得物爻不空，缓图庶可有望。
如衣服经史看父母，六畜酒器看福爻，其余财物食物皆看财爻。
yi: 讨要、借东西不宜应爻空，空就不实在；
一定要代表那样东西的爻不空，慢慢图谋才有指望。
比如衣服、书籍看父母，六畜、酒器看子孙，其余财物、食物都看妻财。
en: In asking or borrowing, the Other line should not be void; void, nothing is real;
the line for the thing itself must not be void; then, pursued patiently, there is some hope.
Clothes and books by Resource, livestock and wine vessels by Output, other goods and food by the Wealth line.

title: 世遭刑克，赌博者必输

rule.yi: 赌博：世旺应衰、世动应静为好；世克应我胜，应克世他胜。兄鬼动来刑克世爻、世临兄弟或世空：不胜；世应静空：赌不成；世坐官鬼：防合谋骗局；间爻动出兄鬼：争斗；内外无财：难胜；世应空动：赊账赌；兄鬼化财先败后胜，财化兄鬼先胜后败；卦身临兄：终是输兆。
rule.en: Gambling: best with the Self line strong and the Other weak, the Self moving and the Other still; Self controlling Other, I win; Other controlling Self, they win. Peer or Pressure moving to punish or control the Self line, Peer on the Self line, or a void Self line: no win; Self and Other still and void: no game; Pressure on the Self line: beware of a conspiracy; Peer or Pressure moving on the between lines: a fight; no Wealth in either trigram: hard to win; Self and Other void yet moving: gambling on credit; Peer or Pressure turning into Wealth, lose then win; Wealth turning into Peer or Pressure, win then lose; Peer on the Body line: a losing sign whatever you do.

zh: 世遭刑克，
赌博者必输。
yi: 世爻受刑克，
赌博一定输。
en: If the Self line is punished or controlled,
the gambler is sure to lose.

zh: 凡占赌博，要世旺应衰，世动应静。
世克应我胜，应克世他胜。
兄鬼动来刑克世爻，或临兄弟，或临自空，皆主不胜。
世应静空，赌博不成。
世坐官爻，防他合谋骗我。
间爻动出兄弟官鬼，多主争斗。
内外俱无财，亦不能胜。
更遇世应空动，必是赌赊。
兄鬼化财，先败后胜；财化兄鬼，先胜后败。
坐方宜财福之地，世变财福，更宜易换赌色。
大怕卦身临兄弟，任换赌色，终是输兆。
yi: 凡是占赌博，要世爻旺、应爻衰，世爻动、应爻静。
世克应我赢，应克世对方赢。
兄弟、官鬼动来刑克世爻，或世爻临兄弟，或世爻自己落空，都主不赢。
世应安静而落空，赌局开不成。
世爻坐官鬼，防对方合伙骗我。
间爻动出兄弟、官鬼，多半有争斗。
内外卦都没有财，也赢不了。
再遇世应空而发动，一定是赊账的赌。
兄弟、官鬼化财，先输后赢；财化兄弟、官鬼，先赢后输。
坐的方位宜在财、福所临之方；世爻变出财、福，更宜换换赌具。
最怕卦身临兄弟，怎么换赌具都是输的兆头。
en: In any gambling question, the Self line should be strong and the Other weak, the Self moving and the Other still.
Self controlling Other: I win; Other controlling Self: they win.
Peer or Pressure moving to punish or control the Self line, or the Self line carrying Peer, or the Self line void: all mean no win.
Self and Other still and void: the game does not happen.
Pressure on the Self line: beware of the others conspiring to cheat me.
Peer or Pressure moving on the between lines: most likely a fight.
No Wealth in either trigram: no win either.
If Self and Other are void yet moving, it is gambling on credit.
Peer or Pressure turning into Wealth: lose first, win later; Wealth turning into Peer or Pressure: win first, lose later.
Sit facing the direction of Wealth or Output; if the Self line turns into Wealth or Output, it is a good time to change the dice or the game.
Worst of all is the Body line carrying Peer: whatever you change, it is a losing sign.

zh: 凡占赌博，要世旺应衰，世克应我胜，应克世他胜。
兄鬼动来刑克世爻，或临兄弟，或世爻空，皆主不胜。
世应静空赌博不成；世坐官爻防他合谋骗我；
间爻动出官鬼兄弟，多致争斗。
yi: 凡占赌博，要世旺应衰；世克应我赢，应克世对方赢。
兄弟、官鬼动来刑克世爻，或世临兄弟，或世爻空，都主不赢。
世应静而空，赌不成；世爻坐官鬼，防对方合谋骗我；
间爻动出官鬼、兄弟，多半引起争斗。
en: In gambling, the Self line should be strong and the Other weak; Self controlling Other, I win; Other controlling Self, they win.
Peer or Pressure moving to punish or control the Self line, the Self line on Peer, or the Self line void: no win.
Self and Other still and void: no game; Pressure on the Self line: beware of a conspiracy to cheat me;
Pressure or Peer moving on the between lines: it usually ends in a fight.

title: 鬼克身爻，商贩者必遭盗贼

rule.yi: 外出贩货：世应生合、官鬼空伏、动爻日辰不伤世爻则平安，财旺福兴大吉。兄鬼发动又玄武发动，遇劫窃；再克世，大祸；世空可避；官鬼动在第五爻（路），途中小心。王洪绪：官临玄武动来克世，必遭盗贼。
rule.en: Travelling to trade: Self and Other generating or combining, Pressure void or hidden, and no moving line or Day harming the Self line means safety; with Wealth strong and Output flourishing, very good. Peer and Pressure moving with the Dark Tortoise moving: robbers or thieves; if they also control the Self line, disaster; a void Self line may escape; Pressure moving on the fifth line (the road): take care on the way. Wang Hongxu: Pressure on the Dark Tortoise moving to control the Self line means certain robbery.

zh: 鬼克身爻，
商贩者必遭盗贼；
yi: 官鬼克世身，
做买卖的人一定遭盗贼；
en: If Pressure controls the Self line,
the trader is sure to meet thieves;

zh: 贩卖经商，要世应生合，鬼爻空伏，动爻日辰不伤乎我，则安然无事。
更得财旺福兴，大吉之兆。
遇兄鬼发动，玄武交重，必遇劫窃之人。
更克世爻，决有大祸。
世若空亡，庶可回避。
鬼动五爻，途中仔细。
yi: 贩运经商，要世应相生相合，官鬼空或伏，动爻、日辰不伤世爻，就平安无事。
再加上财旺福兴，是大吉之兆。
遇到兄弟、官鬼发动，玄武又发动，一定遇到抢劫偷窃的人。
再来克世爻，一定有大祸。
世爻如果落空，大概能躲过。
官鬼在第五爻发动，路上要小心。
en: For a travelling trader: Self and Other generating or combining, the Pressure line void or hidden, and no moving line or Day harming me; then all is safe.
With Wealth strong and Output flourishing as well, it is a very good sign.
If Peer and Pressure move and the Dark Tortoise line moves too, you will meet robbers or thieves.
If they also control the Self line, a great disaster is certain.
If the Self line is void, you may escape it.
Pressure moving on the fifth line: be careful on the road.

zh: 买卖经商，若遇官临玄武动来克世，必遭盗贼之祸。
yi: 做买卖经商，如果官鬼临玄武、动来克世，一定遭盗贼之祸。
en: In trade, if Pressure on the Dark Tortoise moves to control the Self line, robbery is certain.

title: 间兴害世，置货者当虑牙人

rule.yi: 买货：应爻生合世爻易成，刑克世爻难买。代表货物的爻（六畜看子孙、五谷看妻财、布帛看父母）太过货多、不及货少、空伏无货。兄鬼发动防骗；兄鬼在间爻是牙人虚诈、口舌；间爻伤克世爻防牙人谋财；出门买货而应爻空，多不顺。
rule.en: Buying goods: the Other line generating or combining with the Self line makes it easy; punishing or controlling it makes it hard. The line for the goods (Output for livestock, Wealth for grain, Resource for cloth) in excess means plenty, falling short means few, void or hidden means none. Peer and Pressure moving: beware of swindlers; on the between lines, a false broker or quarrels; a between line harming or controlling the Self line: the broker is after your goods; travelling to buy with the Other line void, it mostly goes badly.

zh: 间兴害世，
置货者当虑牙人。
yi: 间爻发动来害世爻，
买货的人要提防经纪人。
en: If a between line moves and harms the Self line,
a buyer of goods should beware of the broker.

zh: 买货者，应要生合世爻，必然易成。刑克世，必难置买。
物爻太过，其货必多；物爻不及，其货必少；物爻空伏，其货必无。
物爻者，六畜看子孙，五谷看财爻，丝绵布帛看父母类。
最怕兄鬼交重，须防光棍诓骗。
在间爻，则是牙人虚诈不实，或有口舌争竞。
伤克世爻，当虑牙人谋劫财物。
出路买货，应空多不顺利。
yi: 买货的，要应爻生合世爻，一定容易成交；应爻刑克世爻，一定难买到。
代表货物的那一爻太旺太多，货一定多；不及，货一定少；空或伏，一定没有货。
货物那一爻：六畜看子孙，五谷看财爻，丝绵布匹看父母，诸如此类。
最怕兄弟、官鬼发动，要防骗子诓骗。
（兄鬼）在间爻上，就是经纪人虚假不实，或有口舌争执。
来伤克世爻，要提防经纪人图谋侵吞财物。
出门去买货，应爻落空，多半不顺利。
en: For a buyer, the Other line should generate or combine with the Self line; then the deal is easy. If it punishes or controls the Self line, it will be hard to buy.
If the line for the goods is in excess, there will be plenty of goods; if it falls short, few; if it is void or hidden, none.
The line for the goods: Output for livestock, the Wealth line for grain, Resource for silk, cotton and cloth, and so on.
The worst is Peer and Pressure moving: beware of swindlers.
On the between lines, it is the broker being false and dishonest, or quarrels and disputes.
If they harm or control the Self line, beware of the broker plotting to seize the goods.
If you travel to buy and the Other line is void, it will mostly go badly.

zh: 买货要应爻生合世位，必然易成，刑克世必难置。
物爻太过货多，物爻不及货少，空伏货无。
物爻者，六畜看子，五谷看财爻类。
最怕兄鬼交重，须防光棍谎骗。
间爻伤克世爻，当虑牙人谋劫财物。
出路买货应空，多不顺利。
yi: 买货要应爻生合世爻，一定容易成交；刑克世爻，一定难买。
货物那一爻太过货多，不及货少，空伏没货。
货物那一爻：六畜看子孙，五谷看财爻，诸如此类。
最怕兄弟、官鬼发动，要防骗子。
间爻伤克世爻，要提防经纪人图谋财物。
出门买货而应爻空，多半不顺。
en: To buy goods, the Other line should generate or combine with the Self line: easy; punishing or controlling it: hard to buy.
The goods line in excess, plenty; falling short, few; void or hidden, none.
The goods line: Output for livestock, the Wealth line for grain, and so on.
The worst is Peer and Pressure moving: beware of swindlers.
A between line harming or controlling the Self line: beware of the broker plotting to take the goods.
Travelling to buy with the Other line void: mostly it goes badly.

title: 停榻者，喜财安而鬼静

rule.yi: 囤货：财爻不宜动、不宜空，不宜被动爻日辰克劫；财坐胎、养、长生，日后得利。兄官交变或同动防盗；兄弟独发多耗折；水爻父母（王洪绪：父化官鬼）刑克世爻，货被雨水淹腐；财化死墓空绝，日后价贱。
rule.en: Holding goods in store: Wealth should neither move nor be void, nor be attacked by moving lines or the Day; Wealth at the Embryo, Nurture or Birth stage means profit later. Peer and Pressure turning into each other or moving together: beware of theft; Peer moving alone: waste and loss; a Water Resource line (Wang Hongxu: Resource turning into Pressure) punishing or controlling the Self line: the goods are spoiled by rain; Wealth turning into death, tomb, void or extinction: the price will fall.
