Wood Wealth is black carp; Metal Wealth is white minnows, silver carp and croaker.

By the method of animal signs, Guihai is fish; see which line moves strongly to generate or combine with the Self without being void, broken, dead, entombed, extinguished, embryonic, punished, harmed or controlled, and the catch is mostly of that kind.
The White Waves star moving: a false alarm; the Storm star moving: rough water;
the Capsize star moving: beware of the boat overturning; the Floating Basin star moving: beware of falling in.
Master Guan's formula: the first line is the boat's owner, the second the companions, the third baggage and rain gear,
the fourth the net (the character is described in a note), the fifth the route, the sixth the fishing ground; whichever is void or broken bodes ill.

title: 亩猎求财：金财旺动生合世，世临天罡虎杀动者获

rule.yi: 打猎：金财旺动生合世，或世临天罡煞、虎杀发动去克旺财，有获；世临虎杀动而财空破绝，无获；财旺而虎杀不动，鹰犬倦；刑刃虎杀冲伤身世，防野兽伤人。财的地支定猎物（子黄鼠、卯兔、未山羊、申猴、戌獾狗、亥野猪），演禽法以干支定鸟兽；其余内外世应与捕鱼同断。
rule.en: Hunting: a strong moving Metal Wealth generating or combining with the Self, or the Self moving with the Tiangang or Tiger star to control a strong Wealth, a kill; the Self moving with the Tiger but Wealth void, broken or extinguished, nothing; Wealth strong but the Tiger still, the hawks and hounds are tired; punishment, Blade or Tiger clashing the Self and Body, beware of wild beasts. The Wealth branch names the game (Zi weasel, Mao hare, Wei wild goat, Shen monkey, Xu badger-dog, Hai boar), the animal-sign method names birds and beasts by stem and branch; the rest is judged as for fishing.

zh: 亩猎求财者，金财旺动生合世，
世临天罡煞动，与临虎杀动，克旺财者，获也。
世临虎杀动，而财逢空破绝者，无也。
月日动来刑者，金财合世者，利也。
财旺而虎杀不动者，鹰犬倦也。
刑刃虎杀动来冲伤身世者，防狐狸野物也。
子财，黄鼠也。卯财，兔也。未财，山羊也。申财，猴也。戌财，獾狗也。亥财，野豕也。
又演禽法，丁亥为豕，丁酉为鸡，己酉为雉，癸酉为鸦，
戊午为獐，壬午为鹿，丙寅为虎，壬寅为豹，戊寅为猫。
凡遇财物动来生合世者，即知得此物也。
其余内外世应生合克冲，皆与捕鱼同断也。
yi: 打猎求财：金属的财旺动来生合世爻，
或世爻临天罡煞发动，或临虎杀发动，去克旺财，有收获。
世临虎杀发动而财空破绝，一无所获。
月、日、动爻来刑的，金财合世的，有利。
财旺而虎杀不动，是鹰犬疲倦。
刑、羊刃、虎杀动来冲伤身世，要防狐狸野兽。
财属子是黄鼠，属卯是兔，属未是山羊，属申是猴，属戌是獾狗，属亥是野猪。
又按演禽法：丁亥是猪，丁酉是鸡，己酉是野鸡，癸酉是乌鸦，
戊午是獐，壬午是鹿，丙寅是虎，壬寅是豹，戊寅是猫。
凡是遇到哪一类财物动来生合世爻，就知道能得这种东西。
其余内外、世应的生合克冲，都和捕鱼一样断。
en: Hunting: a strong Metal Wealth moving to generate or combine with the Self line,
or the Self line moving with the Tiangang star or the Tiger killing star to control a strong Wealth: a kill.
The Self moving with the Tiger star but Wealth void, broken or extinguished: nothing.
The Month, Day or moving lines punishing, or a Metal Wealth combining with the Self: profitable.
Wealth strong but the Tiger star still: the hawks and hounds are tired.
Punishment, the Blade or the Tiger star moving to clash and hurt the Self and Body: beware of foxes and wild beasts.
Wealth on Zi is a weasel; on Mao, a hare; on Wei, a wild goat; on Shen, a monkey; on Xu, a badger-dog; on Hai, a wild boar.
By the animal-sign method: Dinghai is the pig, Dingyou the chicken, Jiyou the pheasant, Guiyou the crow,
Wuwu the river deer, Renwu the deer, Bingyin the tiger, Renyin the leopard, Wuyin the cat.
Whichever of these moves as Wealth to generate or combine with the Self line, that is what you will get.
Everything else, inner and outer, Self and Other, generation, combination, control and clash, is judged as for fishing.

title: 开矿探珠淘金取藏：但取伏下金财

rule.yi: 开矿、采珠、淘金、挖宝：只看伏下的金财——生合世而得飞神动生为吉；伏财旺相多、休囚少、空绝无；入胎墓难采；逢冲动不止一处。世为己、应为工匠：世生旺持财福吉，空死墓绝胎受刑克凶；应生合世得力，刑克世被欺；应临财子有能，临兄鬼无才而诈，临父母为工头；应带六神看工匠性情（雀多嘴、勾笨拙、虎凶狠、龙灵巧、蛇虚浮、武防偷）。
rule.en: Mining, pearl-diving, panning gold or digging treasure: read the hidden Metal Wealth; generating or combining with the Self and fed by its moving flying line is good; thriving means plenty, resting little, void or extinguished none; at the Embryo stage or entombed, hard to extract; clashed into motion, in several places. The Self is you, the Other the workmen: the Self strong on Wealth or Output is good, void or hurt is bad; the Other generating the Self, they work well; attacking it, they cheat; on Wealth or Output, able; on Peer or Pressure, incompetent and crooked; on Resource, the foreman; its spirit gives their temper (Bird talkative, Hook clumsy, Tiger fierce, Dragon deft, Snake flighty, Tortoise light-fingered).

zh: 开矿探珠淘金取藏求财者，但取伏下金财。
生合世，又得上动生之者吉也。
伏财旺相者多，休囚者少，空绝者无也。
财入胎墓，难取采也。财逢冲动，不一处也。
又世为己，应为所用工匠也。
世逢生旺持财福者吉。逢空死墓绝胎，被刑害克破者凶。
应生合世者，得其力。刑害克破世者，被其欺也。
应持财子，有力而能。应持兄鬼，无才而诈。应临父母，则为众匠之班头也。
应加雀，多言招讪。勾则拙钝，虎则刚狠，龙则精巧，蛇则虚浮，武防偷取也。
yi: 开矿、采珠、淘金、挖宝求财，只取伏在下面的金属之财。
伏财生合世爻，又得上面的飞神发动来生它，吉。
伏财旺相的多，休囚的少，空绝的没有。
财入胎、墓，难开采；财逢冲而暗动，不止一处。
又：世是自己，应是雇来的工匠。
世爻逢生旺、临财福，吉；逢空死墓绝胎、受刑害克破，凶。
应生合世，得工匠之力；应刑害克破世，被工匠欺骗。
应临财、子孙，有力又能干；应临兄弟、官鬼，无才又狡诈；应临父母，是众工匠的头目。
应带朱雀，多嘴招惹闲话；带勾陈，笨拙迟钝；带白虎，刚强凶狠；带青龙，精明灵巧；带螣蛇，虚浮不实；带玄武，要防偷盗。
en: Mining, pearl-diving, panning for gold or digging for treasure: take the hidden Metal Wealth.
If it generates or combines with the Self line and the line above it moves to generate it, good.
A thriving hidden Wealth: plenty; resting or trapped: little; void or extinguished: none.
Wealth at the Embryo stage or entombed: hard to extract; Wealth clashed into motion: in more than one place.
Also, the Self is you and the Other the workmen you hire.
The Self born or strong and on Wealth or Output: good; void, dead, entombed, extinguished or embryonic, or punished, harmed, controlled or broken: bad.
The Other generating or combining with the Self: the men work well for you; punishing, harming, controlling or breaking it: they cheat you.
The Other on Wealth or Output: strong and able; on Peer or Pressure: incompetent and crooked; on Resource: the foreman.
The Other with the Bird: talkative, draws gossip; Hook: clumsy and slow; Tiger: hard and fierce; Dragon: skilled and deft; Snake: flighty; Tortoise: beware of pilfering.

title: 索债求财：外生内、应生世者还

rule.yi: 讨债：外生内、应生世、内外世应比和，还；外克内、应克冲刑害世，不还；应生合世而无财，想还没钱；应冲伤世而财旺，能还不肯；应持兄鬼动伤世，嘴甜心狠；应持兄动而财空破绝，被骗；应空，穷或逃；应入墓胎，见不到人；财化空破绝，全无；财动助应而鬼伤世，借势耍赖；鬼动化财，告状才还；世持财子旺而兄衰静，本利俱全；应持兄鬼安静不伤世，或持勾陈父母不伤世，只是拖延。
rule.en: Collecting a debt: outer generating inner, the Other generating the Self, inner and outer, Self and Other in harmony, repaid; outer controlling inner, the Other attacking the Self, not repaid; the Other generating the Self but no Wealth, willing but unable; the Other hurting the Self with Wealth strong, able but unwilling; the Other on Peer or Pressure moving against the Self, sweet words, bad heart; the Other on a moving Peer with Wealth void, swindled; Other void, too poor or hiding; entombed or embryonic, not to be found; Wealth turning void or extinguished, nothing; Wealth feeding the Other while Pressure hurts the Self, he leans on power to welsh; Pressure into Wealth, repaid only after a lawsuit; a strong Wealth or Output on the Self with Peer weak and still, principal and interest; the Other on a still Peer or Pressure, or on Hook Earth and Resource, not hurting the Self, only delay.

note.yi: 「外甥内」两个本子都这样写，按前后文（「外克内」）当是「外生内」。
note.en: Both editions write 'outer nephew inner'; by contrast with 'outer controlling inner' it means 'outer generating inner'.

zh: 索债求财者，外甥内，应生世，与内外世应比和者还。
外克内，应克冲刑害世者，不还。
应生合世而无财，欲还而力不逮。
应冲伤世而财旺，能还而心不肯。
应持兄鬼动伤世，口甜而心歹。
应持兄动，而财逢空破绝者，被其骗也。
应空者，非贫乏，则逃躲也。应入墓胎者，人不见也。
财化空破绝者，全无也。
财动助应，鬼伤身世者，假虎图赖也。
鬼动化财者，告状乃还也。
世持财子旺相，而兄衰静者，子母俱全也。
应持兄鬼安静不伤世，或持勾父不伤世者，不过迟延而已。
yi: 讨债：外卦生内卦（原文作「外甥内」）、应生世、内外世应比和，能还。
外克内，应爻克、冲、刑、害世爻，不还。
应生合世而卦中无财，想还却没能力。
应冲伤世而财旺，能还却不肯还。
应持兄弟、官鬼动来伤世，嘴甜心狠。
应持兄弟发动而财空破绝，被他骗了。
应空，不是穷得还不起，就是躲起来了；应入墓、胎，见不到人。
财化空破绝，一点都讨不回。
财动去生助应爻，官鬼伤世身，是借势耍赖。
官鬼动化财，要告状才还。
世持财、子孙旺相，而兄弟衰静，本钱利息都能讨回。
应持兄弟、官鬼而安静不伤世，或持勾陈父母不伤世，只是拖延罢了。
en: Collecting a debt: outer generating inner (the text writes the wrong character), the Other generating the Self, inner and outer, Self and Other in harmony: it will be repaid.
Outer controlling inner, the Other controlling, clashing, punishing or harming the Self: not repaid.
The Other generating or combining with the Self but no Wealth: willing but unable.
The Other clashing and hurting the Self with Wealth strong: able but unwilling.
The Other on Peer or Pressure moving to hurt the Self: sweet words, bad heart.
The Other on a moving Peer with Wealth void, broken or extinguished: you have been swindled.
Other void: either too poor or hiding; Other entombed or embryonic: you cannot find him.
Wealth turning void, broken or extinguished: nothing at all.
Wealth moving to help the Other while Pressure hurts the Self and Body: he borrows power to welsh on you.
Pressure moving into Wealth: repaid only after you sue.
The Self on a thriving Wealth or Output with Peer weak and still: principal and interest both recovered.
The Other on a still Peer or Pressure that does not hurt the Self, or on Hook Earth and Resource that does not, only means delay.

title: 世下伏财者，彼先有物欲抵此债

rule.yi: 讨债时世爻下伏财：对方有东西想拿来抵债；按财所在的卦宫和地支推是什么东西（乾马金银杯镜冠玉、兑羊五金缸坛、离绸缎书画帘屏、震鼓竹茶笋、坎酒醋鱼盐猪、艮狗石瓷瓜叶、坤牛马田土布帛锅；子池荡大豆珠玉……亥猪伞笠笔墨）。
rule.en: In collecting a debt, Wealth hidden under the Self line means the debtor has goods to offer instead; tell what they are from the palace and branch of that Wealth (Qian horses, gold and silver, mirrors, jade; Dui sheep, metalware, jars; Li silks, paintings, screens; Zhen drums, bamboo, tea; Kan wine, vinegar, fish, salt, pigs; Gen dogs, stone, porcelain; Kun oxen, land, cloth, pots; Zi ponds, soybeans, jewels ... Hai pigs, umbrellas, brushes and ink).

zh: 蜀市日记曰，凡世下伏财者，彼先有物，欲抵此债。
以八卦与十二支神，推其何物也。
如庚寅年辛巳月丙午日，卜得小畜卦。世下伏辛丑土为财，
巽为长女，为鸡，为竹木器，为花果菜园。
丑为牛，为坟地，菜圃，随本刊之多少断之知他欲卖何物来偿债也。
若财在乾则为马，金银杯盘镜冠玉环珠也。财在兑则为羊，少女，五金器缸坛有口物也。
财在离则为中女，罗段丝绵书画簾屏盘盒赤色中虚之物也。财在震则为长男，鼓竹本茶笋也。
财在坎则为次男，池荡酒醋鱼盐豕有核物也。财在艮则为少男，狗山石磁器瓜叶土中物也。
财在坤则为牛牝马田土五谷布帛釜也。
财属子池荡大荳衣饰珠玉也。财属寅，山林树木棺猫也。财属卯，草木竹舟车盘盒也。
财属辰，缸瓷碓碾磁器坟地田园也。财属巳，花果书画砖瓦磁器也。财属午，马书画甑衣架也。
财属未，山(此处之字是寐字下面的左边)羊女衣也。财属申，刀剑五金器大麦碓猿也。
财属酉，鸡酒小麦金银钗钏五金物也。财属戌，坟地穴坑砖瓦碓磨旧衣狗也。
财必属亥，猪伞笠笔墨发酱酢盛水物也。(出六三金口诀)
yi: 《蜀市日记》说：凡是世爻下伏着财，对方先有东西，想拿来抵债。
用八卦和十二地支来推是什么东西。
比如庚寅年辛巳月丙午日，卜得小畜卦，世爻下伏着辛丑土为财；
（小畜属巽宫）巽为长女、为鸡、为竹木器、为花果菜园；
丑为牛、为坟地、为菜圃，按债本的多少来断，就知道他想卖什么东西来还债。
财在乾是马、金银、杯盘、镜子、冠、玉环、珠；财在兑是羊、少女、五金器、缸坛等有口的东西；
财在离是中女、绫罗绸缎、丝绵、书画、帘子屏风、盘盒、红色中空之物；财在震是长男、鼓、竹木（原文作「竹本」）、茶、笋；
财在坎是次子、池塘、酒醋、鱼盐、猪、有核之物；财在艮是少男、狗、山石、瓷器、瓜叶、土里的东西；
财在坤是牛、母马、田土、五谷、布帛、锅。
财属子是池塘、大豆、衣饰、珠玉；属寅是山林树木、棺材、猫；属卯是草木竹、船车、盘盒；
属辰是缸、瓷、碓碾、瓷器、坟地、田园；属巳是花果、书画、砖瓦、瓷器；属午是马、书画、蒸笼、衣架；
属未是山中之物（原文此处缺字，注字形）、羊、女人衣服；属申是刀剑、五金器、大麦、碓、猿；
属酉是鸡、酒、小麦、金银、钗钏、五金之物；属戌是坟地、坑穴、砖瓦、碓磨、旧衣、狗；
属亥是猪、伞、斗笠、笔墨、头发、酱醋、盛水的东西（出自《六三金口诀》）。
en: The Shushi Diary says: whenever Wealth lies hidden under the Self line, the debtor has goods already and means to settle the debt with them.
Use the eight trigrams and the twelve branches to tell what the goods are.
For instance, Gengyin year, Xinsi month, Bingwu day, the hexagram Xiaoxu: under the Self line lay a hidden Xinchou Earth Wealth;
Xun (Xiaoxu's palace) stands for the eldest daughter, chickens, bamboo and wooden ware, fruit and vegetable gardens;
Chou stands for oxen, graves and vegetable plots; judge by the size of the debt and you know what he will sell to repay it.
Wealth in Qian: horses, gold and silver, cups and plates, mirrors, caps, jade rings, pearls; in Dui: sheep, a young girl, metalware, jars and anything with a mouth;

in Li: a middle daughter, silks and satins, silk floss, paintings and calligraphy, screens and blinds, trays and boxes, red and hollow things; in Zhen: an eldest son, drums, bamboo and wood (the text has a slip), tea, bamboo shoots;
in Kan: a second son, ponds, wine and vinegar, fish and salt, pigs, things with stones; in Gen: a youngest son, dogs, rocks, porcelain, melons and leaves, things from the earth;
in Kun: oxen, mares, land, grain, cloth, cooking pots.
Wealth on Zi: ponds, soybeans, clothes and ornaments, pearls and jade; on Yin: forests, trees, coffins, cats; on Mao: plants and bamboo, boats and carts, trays and boxes;
on Chen: jars, porcelain, mortars and mills, graves, fields; on Si: flowers and fruit, paintings, bricks and tiles, porcelain; on Wu: horses, paintings, steamers, clothes racks;
on Wei: things from the hills (a character is missing, with a note on its shape), sheep, women's clothes; on Shen: knives and swords, metalware, barley, pestles, apes;
on You: chickens, wine, wheat, gold and silver, hairpins and bracelets, metal goods; on Xu: graves, pits, bricks and tiles, mills, old clothes, dogs;
on Hai: pigs, umbrellas, rain hats, brushes and ink, hair, soy sauce and vinegar, things that hold water (from the Liusan Jinkou Jue).

title: 贸易占大略：先问时价，再问牙行，后问脱货；六爻各管一事

rule.yi: 买卖要问三件事：现在的价钱是贵是贱、以后是涨是落；牙行（中间人）是好是坏；货好不好脱手。六爻各管一事（鬼谷分爻）：上爻店舍，五爻道路，四爻舟车马，三爻行李，二爻伴侣，初爻己身。哪一爻旺相、带财福龙德贵禄、又扶着卦身和世爻，那件事就顺；哪一爻带鬼、伏鬼、化鬼来刑冲克害卦身和世爻，或落在空死墓绝胎、被四直和动爻冲伤，疏漏就出在那件事上。
rule.en: A trade question asks three things: is the price now dear or cheap, and will it later rise or fall; is the broker honest or crooked; and will the goods sell easily. The six lines each govern one matter (Guigu's assignment): top, the lodging; fifth, the road; fourth, carts, boats and horses; third, baggage; second, companions; first, oneself. A line that is strong, carries Wealth, Output, the Azure Dragon, Virtue, Noble or Emolument, and supports the Body and Self lines means that matter goes well; a line that holds, hides or turns into Pressure and punishes, clashes with, controls or harms the Body and Self lines, or falls in void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, or is clashed and hurt by the four rulers and moving lines, is where things go wrong.

note.yi: 鬼谷分爻的表原文只列了名目，没写各是哪一爻；从上到下的读法，本书自己有旁证：捕鱼占里《管公口诀》写明「初爻船主，二爻伴侣，三爻行李雨具，四爻网，五爻道路，六爻渔所」。「舟车马行李」在原书里连着排、中间没有断开，这里读作四爻舟车马、三爻行李。
note.en: The source lists the items without naming their lines. Reading them from the top down is supported by the same book's fishing chapter, where Guan Gong's rhymes say: first line the boat's master, second companions, third baggage and rain gear, fourth the net, fifth the road, sixth the fishing ground. Here the source runs 'carts, boats and horses' and 'baggage' together with no break; they are read as the fourth and third lines.

zh: 游南子曰，凡买卖者，
先占时价之贵贱，
与后价之旺衰，
次考牙行之淑慝，
并究脱货之难易，
此其大略也。
yi: 游南子说：凡是做买卖的，
先占现在的价钱是贵是贱，
和以后的价钱是涨是落；
再看牙行（中间人）是好是坏，
并查货好不好脱手，
这就是大概的次序。
en: Master Younan says: in any buying and selling,
first divine whether the price now is dear or cheap,
and whether the later price will rise or fall;
then examine whether the broker is honest or crooked,
and look into how easily the goods can be sold off;
that is the outline.

zh: 鬼谷分爻
店舍道路舟车马行李伴侣己身
yi: 鬼谷分爻（六爻各管一件事）：
从上爻到初爻依次是：店舍、道路、舟车马、行李、伴侣、己身。
en: Guigu's assignment of the lines:
from the top line down to the first: the lodging, the road, carts, boats and horses, baggage, companions, oneself.

zh: 凡分爻生旺，
带财福龙德贵禄，
临扶身世爻，
便知吉祥如意也。
又看何爻持鬼，
伏鬼，
化鬼，
刑冲克害身世爻，
更看何爻临空死墓绝胎，
受四直动爻冲伤，
便知疏虞处也。
yi: 凡是哪一爻生旺，
带着财、福、青龙、德星、贵人、禄，
又靠近并扶助卦身和世爻，
就知道那件事吉祥如意。
还要看哪一爻带着官鬼，
或伏着官鬼，
或变出官鬼，
去刑、冲、克、害卦身和世爻；
再看哪一爻落在空、死、墓、绝、胎上，
又被四直和动爻冲伤，
就知道那件事的疏漏在哪里。
en: Whichever line is strong and thriving,
and carries Wealth, Output, the Azure Dragon, Virtue, Noble or Emolument,
and stands by and supports the Body and Self lines,
you know that matter will go as you wish.
Then see which line holds Pressure,
hides Pressure,
or turns into Pressure,
to punish, clash with, control or harm the Body and Self lines;
and see which line falls in void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage,
or is clashed and hurt by the four rulers and moving lines:
there you know where the neglect lies.

title: 买卖：官鬼旺静兄弟弱为吉；按买卖的季节配财爻五行；财旺价贵，财死价贱

rule.yi: 买卖看价：官鬼旺相安静、兄弟无气，吉。财爻旺相有生助，价贵；死败，价贱；财属火价一天天涨，属水一天天落。按季节看财爻的五行：冬收夏卖看火财，春收秋卖看金财，秋收春卖看木财，夏收冬卖看水财。财变兄弟或官鬼、子孙变父母，先贵后贱；财化子孙、官鬼化财，先贱后贵。内卦财旺外卦财衰，别处贱；外卦财旺内卦财衰，以后贵。本卦有财而变卦无，晚买便宜；本卦财旺而变卦财衰，先卖的卖得贵。内卦财空可卖，外卦财空难买；外卦的财生合世易买，应爻合内卦的财易卖，世爻落在财的墓上难卖。
rule.en: Reading the price in a trade: Pressure strong and still, with Peer lacking strength, is auspicious. Wealth strong and fed means dear; Wealth dead or spent means cheap; Wealth on Fire, the price climbs day by day; on Water, it falls. By season, look at the element of Wealth: goods bought in winter and sold in summer want a Fire Wealth, spring to autumn Metal, autumn to spring Wood, summer to winter Water. Wealth turning into Peer or Pressure, or Output turning into Resource: dear first, cheap later; Wealth turning into Output, or Pressure into Wealth: cheap first, dear later. Wealth strong inside and weak outside: cheap elsewhere; strong outside and weak inside: dear later. Wealth in the main hexagram but not in the changed one: buy late and it is cheaper; strong in the main and weak in the change: whoever sells first gets the dear price. Inner Wealth void: it can be sold; outer Wealth void: hard to buy; outer Wealth generating or combining with the Self: easy to buy; the Other combining with the inner Wealth: easy to sell; the Self standing on the tomb of Wealth: hard to sell.

note.yi: 「收四季所卖之货」一句很省，「四季」「时」都还有别的读法；这里按四季月就是辰戌丑未这四个季末月读。另外，这一节用买进卖出的季节去配财爻的五行；《增删卜易》野鹤的取法不同：财旺宜卖、财衰宜囤，有固定旺季的货凭时令断，没有固定时节的货要单独占，并说古人按五行推货类屡试不验。
note.en: The sentence 'goods bought to be sold in the four seasons' is terse; both 'four seasons' and 'times' have other readings, and here the four seasons are read as the four season-end months Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei. Also, this passage pairs the season of buying and selling with the element of Wealth; the Old Man of Yehe in the Zengshan Buyi works differently: sell when Wealth is strong and stock up when it is weak, judge goods with a fixed season by the season, cast separately for goods without one, and he says the old element-by-goods method never held up in his trials.

zh: 官鬼旺静，兄弟无气者，吉也。
冬收夏化货，火财者吉。
春收秋货，金财者吉。
秋收春货，木财者吉。
夏收冬货，水财者吉。
收四季所卖之货，各从辰戌丑未之时者，吉也。
旺财生克世者贵，衰财世克之者贱。
财旺生者贵，财死败者贱，
财值火者价日增。
财值水者价日减。
财变兄官子变父者，先贵后贱。
财化子孙鬼化财者，先贱后贵。
内财旺而外财衰，他乡贱也。
外财旺而内财衰，后价贵也。
正卦有财后卦无，迟买者贱。
正卦财旺，变财衰，先卖者贵也。
内财空者，可卖。
外财空者，难买。
外财生合世者，易买。
应合内财者易卖。
世临财墓者，难卖也。
yi: 官鬼旺相而安静，兄弟没有气的，吉。
冬天收进、夏天脱手的货，财爻是火的，吉；
春天收进、秋天脱手的，财爻是金的，吉；
秋天收进、春天脱手的，财爻是木的，吉；
夏天收进、冬天脱手的，财爻是水的，吉。
收进的货要在四季（辰、戌、丑、未这几个季末月）里卖的，各自顺着辰、戌、丑、未的时候来，吉。
旺相的财生世、克世的，价贵；衰弱的财，被世克的，价贱。
财旺而有生助的，价贵；财死败的，价贱。
财属火的，价钱一天天涨；
财属水的，价钱一天天落。
财变成兄弟或官鬼、子孙变成父母的，先贵后贱。
财化成子孙、官鬼化成财的，先贱后贵。
内卦的财旺、外卦的财衰，别处的价钱贱。
外卦的财旺、内卦的财衰，以后的价钱贵。
本卦有财、变卦没有，晚买的便宜。
本卦财旺、变出来的财衰，先卖的卖得贵。
内卦的财落空，可以卖；
外卦的财落空，难买；
外卦的财生合世，容易买；
应合内卦的财，容易卖；
世落在财的墓上，难卖。
en: Pressure strong and still, with Peer lacking strength: auspicious.
Goods bought in winter and turned into money in summer: a Fire Wealth is auspicious;
bought in spring, sold in autumn: a Metal Wealth is auspicious;
bought in autumn, sold in spring: a Wood Wealth is auspicious;
bought in summer, sold in winter: a Water Wealth is auspicious.
For goods bought to be sold in the four season-ends (the Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei months), going with the times of Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, each in its own turn, is auspicious.
A strong Wealth that generates or controls the Self means dear; a weak Wealth controlled by the Self means cheap.
Wealth strong and fed is dear; Wealth dead or spent is cheap.
Wealth on Fire: the price climbs day by day;
Wealth on Water: the price drops day by day.
Wealth turning into Peer or Pressure, or Output turning into Resource: dear first, cheap later.
Wealth turning into Output, or Pressure turning into Wealth: cheap first, dear later.
Wealth strong inside and weak outside: cheap in other places.
Wealth strong outside and weak inside: dear later.
Wealth in the main hexagram but not in the changed one: whoever buys late gets it cheap.
Wealth strong in the main hexagram and weak in the change: whoever sells first gets the dear price.
Inner Wealth void: it can be sold;
outer Wealth void: hard to buy;
outer Wealth generating or combining with the Self: easy to buy;
the Other combining with the inner Wealth: easy to sell;
the Self standing on the tomb of Wealth: hard to sell.

title: 牙行：应爻、官爻旺相生合世，千金可托；休空冲伤世，百货难依

rule.yi: 找牙行（中间人）：应爻、官爻旺相，又生合世爻，千金也可托付；休囚落空、或冲伤世，各样货物都难托付。应爻发动克世，或应上的财化成兄弟，难免被侵吞；应上的财发动生合世、或化成子孙，或应上的官鬼化成财，办事肯替你周旋。
rule.en: Choosing a broker: the Other and Pressure lines strong and generating or combining with the Self, and a thousand gold can be entrusted to him; resting or void, or clashing with and hurting the Self, and no goods can be relied upon to him. The Other moving to control the Self, or the Other's Wealth turning into Peer: you cannot escape being fleeced. The Other's Wealth moving to generate or combine with the Self, or turning into Output, or the Other's Pressure turning into Wealth: he handles matters with care and works on your behalf.

zh: 应爻官爻旺相生合世者，千金可托也。
休空冲伤世者，百货难依也。
应爻动克世，与应财化兄者，侵渔不免也。
应财动来生合世，与应财化子，应鬼化财者，作事周旋也。
yi: 应爻和官爻旺相，又生合世爻的，千金也可以托付。
衰弱落空、或冲伤世的，各样货物都难以托付。
应爻发动克世，以及应上的财化成兄弟的，难免被侵吞。
应上的财发动来生合世、或化成子孙，或者应上的官鬼化成财的，办事肯替你周旋。
en: The Other and Pressure lines strong and generating or combining with the Self line: a thousand gold can be entrusted to him.
Resting or void, or clashing with and hurting the Self: no goods can be relied upon to him.
The Other line moving to control the Self, or the Other's Wealth turning into Peer: you cannot escape being fleeced.
The Other's Wealth moving to generate or combine with the Self, or turning into Output, or the Other's Pressure turning into Wealth: he handles matters with care and works on your behalf.

title: 脱货：以财爻生旺的月日为脱手之期；财化五行各防一样货损；应动合财易脱

rule.yi: 脱货：财爻生旺的月份、日子是脱手的日期。应发动合财、或财发动合应，易脱；应落空落破，一定没有买主；财临勾陈土，货难脱。财化水防漏和潮，化火防枯干和火灾，化木防微烂，化土防朽腐，化金又临螣蛇防生虫；财落在辰午酉亥自刑的地支上，货差难脱。世应相冲又带退悔杀发动，或应动合财却化成退神，多半中途作罢；应动合财而被日辰或动爻冲破，有人破坏；日辰合住动财，旁人把持；官鬼动伤世，牙人阻挠；卦里没有官鬼，买卖不成；财动生世生应而官鬼入墓，要等冲开墓的日子成交。书中例：需卦安静，申金子孙持世，人人说吉，作者断四月金空生不了财、又有四个兄弟互相冲脱，买主看了货就散了。
rule.en: Selling off goods: the month or day when the Wealth line is born or strong is the time to unload. The Other moving to combine with Wealth, or Wealth moving to combine with the Other: easy to sell; the Other void or broken: surely no buyer; Wealth on Hook Earth: hard to sell. Wealth turning into Water: beware leaks and damp; into Fire: drying out and fire; into Wood: slight rot; into Earth: decay; into Metal with the Coiling Snake: worms; Wealth on Chen, Wu, You or Hai, the self-punishing branches: poor goods, hard to sell. Self and Other clashing with the Regret star moving, or the Other moving to combine with Wealth but turning into a Retreating line: often broken off midway; the Other moving to combine with Wealth but clashed and broken by the Day or a moving line: someone wrecks it; the Day combining with a moving Wealth: a bystander holds it back; Pressure moving to hurt the Self: the broker obstructs; no Pressure in the hexagram: the trade does not close; Wealth moving to generate both Self and Other while Pressure has gone into its tomb: it closes on the day the tomb is clashed open. In the case from the book, hexagram Xu with no moving line looked auspicious because Output on Shen Metal held the Self line; the author judged that Metal was void in the fourth month and could not generate Wealth, and that four Peer lines clashed each other away, so the buyers left when they saw the goods.

note.yi: 需卦是第五卦，原文只说「安静」，没写哪一爻动，这里译成「没有动爻」。「用爻最怕立时空」一句，例里引作「经云」，《易隐》别处没有单独的出处。
note.en: Xu is the fifth hexagram; the source says only that it is 'still', which is rendered as 'no moving line'. The line 'the Subject fears being void at the moment of the cast' is quoted in the case as 'the classic says'; nothing else in the Yi Yin gives it a separate source.

zh: 以财爻生旺月日为脱卸之期。
应动合财，财动合应者，易脱。
应居空破，必无买主。
财持勾土，货必难脱。
财化水，防上漏下湿。
财化火，防枯干回禄，
财化木，防微烂。
财化土，防朽腐。
财化金加蛇，防生虫。
财持辰午酉亥自刑，货恶难脱也。
世应相冲，加退悔杀动，或应动合财，化退神者，多中止也。
应动合财，被日辰动爻冲破者，有人破也。
日合动财者，旁人把持也。
鬼动伤世者，牙人挠阻也。
卦无官鬼者，买卖不成也。
财动生世生应，而官鬼入墓者，待冲开墓日成交也。
yi: 以财爻生旺的月份、日子为脱手的日期。
应发动去合财，或财发动去合应，容易脱手。
应落在空、破上，一定没有买主。
财临勾陈土，货一定难脱手。
财化成水，要防上面漏、下面潮。
财化成火，要防枯干和火灾；
财化成木，要防微烂；
财化成土，要防朽腐。
财化成金又临螣蛇，要防生虫。
财落在辰、午、酉、亥这几个自刑的地支上，货色差，难脱手。
世应相冲，又带退悔杀发动，或者应发动去合财、却化成退神，多半中途作罢。
应发动去合财，却被日辰或动爻冲破，有人从中破坏。
日合住发动的财，旁人把持着不放。
官鬼发动伤世，牙人从中阻挠。
卦里没有官鬼，买卖成不了。
财发动，既生世又生应，而官鬼入了墓，要等冲开墓的那天才成交。
en: The month or day when the Wealth line is born or strong is the time to unload.
The Other moving to combine with Wealth, or Wealth moving to combine with the Other: easy to sell.
The Other in void or broken: there will surely be no buyer.
Wealth on Hook Earth: the goods will surely be hard to sell.
Wealth turning into Water: guard against leaks above and damp below.
Wealth turning into Fire: guard against drying out and fire;
turning into Wood: guard against slight rot;
Wealth turning into Earth: guard against decay.
Wealth turning into Metal with the Coiling Snake: guard against worms.
Wealth on Chen, Wu, You or Hai, the self-punishing branches: the goods are poor and hard to sell.
Self and Other clashing with the Regret star moving, or the Other moving to combine with Wealth but turning into a Retreating line: it is often broken off midway.
The Other moving to combine with Wealth but clashed and broken by the Day or a moving line: someone wrecks it.
The Day combining with a moving Wealth: a bystander holds it back.
Pressure moving to hurt the Self: the broker obstructs.
No Pressure in the hexagram: the trade will not go through.
Wealth moving to generate both the Self and the Other, while Pressure has gone into its tomb: the deal closes on the day the tomb is clashed open.

zh: 庚寅年辛巳月甲辰日，占脱货，得需卦安静。
申金子孙持世，人皆云吉。
岂知四月金空，不能生财。
经云，用爻最怕立时空也。
本宫亥财，伏辰土兄下，
本宫世应俱持兄弟，日辰又是兄弟，必有对主承买。
但因亥财自刑，其货必背时不佳，买主见货散去也。
盖兄弟绝于月建巳中，墓于日建辰中，
又飞伏辰戌丑未，四位兄弟，
自相冲脱，故不买而去也。
yi: 庚寅年辛巳月甲辰日，占脱货，得需卦，没有动爻。
申金子孙持世，人人都说吉。
哪知道四月里金落空，生不了财。
经上说，用爻最怕起卦那一刻就落空。
本宫的亥水财，伏在辰土兄弟下面，
本宫里世爻、应爻都带兄弟，日辰又是兄弟，一定有买主来接货。
只是亥水的财自刑，那批货一定不合时、不好，买主看了货就散了。
因为兄弟在月建巳里是绝、在日建辰里是墓，
又飞神伏神都在辰戌丑未上，四个兄弟，
自己互相冲开、把货脱散了，所以不买就走了。
en: In a Gengyin year, Xinsi month, Jiachen day, he divined about selling off goods and got Xu (Waiting) with no moving line.
Output on Shen Metal held the Self line, and everyone called it auspicious.
But in the fourth month Metal is void, and cannot generate Wealth.
The classic says the Subject line most fears being void at the moment of the cast.
The home palace's Hai Wealth is hidden under the Chen-Earth Peer,
and in the home palace both Self and Other carry Peer, and the Day is also Peer, so a buyer will surely come to take the goods.
But because the Hai Wealth punishes itself, the goods are surely out of season and poor, and the buyers left when they saw the goods.
For Peer is in extinction in the Month's Si and in its tomb in the Day's Chen,
and the flying and hidden lines are all Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, four Peers,
clashing among themselves and scattering the goods, so they left without buying.

title: 开店占大略：先问可开否，再问本利、合伙、店面、货物、收放

rule.yi: 开店要依次问六件事：能不能开成；本钱多少、利润厚薄；合伙人好不好；店面大小；店里的货物；能不能放账收账。管辂分爻（六爻各管一件事）：上爻财路，五爻主人，四爻店屋，三爻基业，二爻伴侣，初爻心事。
rule.en: Opening a shop asks six things in order: can it be opened; how much capital and how thick the profit; is the partner worthy; how big is the shopfront; what of the goods in the shop; and may credit be given and collected. Guan Lu's assignment of the lines: top, the money road; fifth, the master; fourth, the shop building; third, the foundation of the business; second, companions; first, the mind's intent.

note.yi: 这一表和贸易占的「鬼谷分爻」一样，原文没写各是哪一爻，这里照同一套次序从上爻读到初爻（依据见 LY.WEALTH.YY.18 的说明）。
note.en: As with Guigu's list in the trade chapter, the source does not name the lines; they are read from the top down in the same order (see the note on LY.WEALTH.YY.18).

zh: 游南子曰，凡开张店业者，
先问可开否，
次论本之多少，利之厚薄，
合伙之贤否，
店面之大小，
更看店中之货物，
复推收放之可否，
此其大略也。
yi: 游南子说：凡是开张店铺、做买卖的，
先问开不开得成，
再论本钱多少、利润厚薄，
合伙人好不好，
店面大小，
再看店里的货物，
又推能不能放账收账；
这就是大概的次序。
en: Master Younan says: whoever opens a shop or business
first asks whether it can be opened at all,
then weighs how much capital and how thick or thin the profit,
whether the partner is worthy,
how big the shopfront,
then the goods in the shop,
and last whether credit may be extended and collected:
that is the outline.

zh: 管辂分爻
财路主人店屋基业伴侣心事
yi: 管辂分爻（六爻各管一件事）：
从上爻到初爻依次是：财路、主人、店屋、基业、伴侣、心事。
en: Guan Lu's assignment of the lines:
from the top line down to the first: the money road, the master, the shop building, the foundation of the business, companions, the mind's intent.

title: 可开否：本宫、世爻、财爻带福禄龙喜旺相可开；死墓绝胎空破刑害不可开；六冲开不成

rule.yi: 能不能开：本宫、世爻、财爻带福、禄、龙、喜而旺相，财或子孙持世旺相且不犯刑害克破，应上的财旺而发动生合世，或四直临财生合世，可开。本宫、世爻、财爻逢死墓绝胎、空破刑害，或四直和应爻带兄弟官鬼、旺而发动克世，不可开；四直全是兄弟而世爻旺相，兄弟受制，开张安稳。六冲卦开不成，开成也不久；太岁生合世而有动爻冲太岁，开不满一年；月生合世而有动爻冲月，开不满一月。财化子孙，宜守老本行。
rule.en: Whether it can be opened: if the home palace, the Self line and the Wealth line carry Output, Emolument, the Dragon or Joy and are strong, or Wealth or Output on the Self is strong and free of punishment, harm, control and breaking, or the Other's Wealth is strong and moving to generate or combine with the Self, or the four rulers on Wealth generate or combine with the Self, it can be opened. If the home palace, the Self and the Wealth line meet death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, void, broken, punished or harmed, or the four rulers and the Other carry Peer or Pressure, strong and moving to control the Self, it cannot; but if the four rulers are all Peer while the Self is strong, Peer is held in check and the opening is safe. A Six-Clash hexagram cannot be opened, or if opened will not last; the Tai Sui generating or combining with the Self but a moving line clashing the Tai Sui: it will not last a year; the Month generating or combining with the Self but a moving line clashing the Month: not a month. Wealth turning into Output: keep to the old business.

zh: 本宫，与世爻财爻带福禄龙喜旺相者，
财子持世旺相，不犯刑害克破者，
应财旺动生合世，与四直临财生合世者，
可开也。
本宫与世爻，财爻逢死墓绝胎，空破刑害者，
四直与应爻，临兄鬼旺动克世者，
不可开也。
若四直皆兄，则兄弟受制，
倘世持旺相，开张安稳无破也。
卦六冲者，开不成，成亦不久也。
太岁生合世，逢动爻冲太岁者，开不及年也。
月生合世，而动冲月者，开不逾月也。
财化子者，宜守旧也。
yi: 本宫，加上世爻、财爻带着福、禄、龙、喜而且旺相的，
财或子孙持世而旺相，又不犯刑、害、克、破的，
应上的财旺而发动、生合世，或者四直临财、生合世的，
这家店可以开成。
本宫、世爻、财爻碰上死、墓、绝、胎，或者空、破、刑、害的，
四直和应爻带着兄弟、官鬼，旺而发动、克世的，
不可以开。
如果四直全是兄弟，兄弟就被制住了，
只要世旺相，开张就安稳，不会破败。
卦是六冲的，开不成，开成了也不长久。
太岁生合世，却有动爻冲太岁，开不满一年。
月生合世，却有动爻冲月，开不满一个月。
财化成子孙的，宜守老本行。
en: the home palace, with the Self line and the Wealth line carrying Output, Emolument, the Dragon or Joy and strong,
Wealth or Output on the Self, strong, and free of punishment, harm, control or breaking,
the Other's Wealth strong and moving to generate or combine with the Self, or the four rulers on Wealth generating or combining with the Self,
the shop can be opened.
The home palace, the Self line and the Wealth line meeting death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, or void, broken, punished or harmed,
or the four rulers and the Other line carrying Peer or Pressure, strong and moving to control the Self:
it cannot be opened.
If the four rulers are all Peer, Peer is held in check,
and if the Self is strong, the opening is safe and nothing breaks.
A Six-Clash hexagram: it cannot be opened, and if opened it will not last.
The Tai Sui generating or combining with the Self, but a moving line clashing the Tai Sui: it will not last a year.
The Month generating or combining with the Self, but a moving line clashing the Month: it will not last a month.
Wealth turning into Output: better to keep to the old business.

title: 本利：卦旺财旺本多，卦衰财衰本少；财旺生扶得利；财不上卦、空破死绝，或兄劫动克世，折本

rule.yi: 本钱和利润：卦旺财旺，本钱多；卦衰财衰，本钱少；财落在胎、墓，本钱少；财落空、绝，缺本钱。得利：世带旺财，财得生而库旺，财在绝地逢生，外卦的财生合内卦的世，财落在三爻或四爻（门户）旺而发动，三传临财发动生合世，财伏在世爻或子孙下得生得旺，财发动化成子孙、化长生、化旺，子孙发动化成财、化长生、化旺。折本：财不上卦，财空破死绝，三传临兄弟或劫煞发动，兄弟旺动克世，父母发动帮兄弟克世，应爻刑害克破世。财伏在父母下，失一半；伏在官鬼下，耗损多；伏在兄弟下，谨防口舌。
rule.en: Capital and profit: hexagram and Wealth both strong, much capital; both weak, little; Wealth in the womb or tomb stage, little; Wealth void or extinct, no capital. Profit comes when: the Self carries a strong Wealth; Wealth is generated and its store strong; Wealth in extinction meets Birth; outer Wealth generates or combines with the inner Self; Wealth on the Gate or Door line (the third and fourth), strong and moving; the three rulers on Wealth, moving to generate or combine with the Self; Wealth hidden under the Self or under Output and generated or strong; Wealth moving into Output, into Birth or into strength; Output moving into Wealth, into Birth or into strength. Capital is lost when: Wealth is absent from the hexagram, or void, broken, dead or extinct; the three rulers on Peer or the Robbery star, moving; Peer strong and moving to control the Self; Resource moving to help Peer control the Self; or the Other line punishes, harms, controls or breaks the Self. Wealth hidden under Resource: half is lost; under Pressure: heavy losses; under Peer: beware of quarrels.

note.yi: 「财持旺雀」在别的书里没有这一句，按字面译成财带着旺相的朱雀；朱雀通常主口舌，这里却算得利的一项，可能是字有误，没有别本可对，不改。「财生库旺」《阐奥歌章》也有（「财生库旺聚钱财」），这里读作「财得生、库又旺」。「化生」译成化出长生，「化旺」译成化出旺相，是照字面取的读法。
note.en: 'Wealth carrying a strong Vermilion Bird' appears in no other book here and is translated literally; the Vermilion Bird usually means quarrels yet is counted as a gain, so a wrong character is possible, but there is no other copy to check against and it is left as it is. 'Wealth generated and its store strong' also appears in the Chan'ao Gezhang verse 'Wealth generated and its store strong gathers money' and is read as Wealth being generated while its store is strong. 'Turning into Birth' and 'turning into strength' follow the literal words.

zh: 卦旺财旺本多也，卦衰财衰本少也。
财胎墓，本少。
财空绝，乏本也。
世持旺财，
或财持旺雀，
或财生库旺，
或财绝逢生，
或外财生合内世，
或财临门户旺动(三爻门，四爻户)，
或三传临财，动生合世，
或财伏世下，财伏子下，生旺，
或财动化子，化生，化旺，
子动化财，化生，化旺，
皆得利也。
若财不上卦，
或财逢空破死绝，
或三传临兄劫动，
或兄旺动克世，
或父动助兄克世，
或应爻刑害克破世者，折本也。
财伏父下，一半失也。
财伏鬼下，多耗失也。
财伏兄下，谨口舌也。
yi: 卦旺、财旺，本钱多；卦衰、财衰，本钱少。
财落在胎、墓，本钱少。
财落空、绝，缺本钱。
世爻带着旺相的财，
或者财带着旺相的朱雀，
或者财得生、库又旺，
或者财在绝地逢生，
或者外卦的财生合内卦的世，
或者财落在门户上、旺而发动（三爻是门，四爻是户），
或者三传临财，发动来生合世，
或者财伏在世下，或伏在子孙下，得生得旺，
或者财发动化成子孙，化成长生，化成旺，
或者子孙发动化成财，化成长生，化成旺，
都能得利。
如果财不上卦，
或者财逢空、破、死、绝，
或者三传临兄弟、劫煞而发动，
或者兄弟旺而发动、克世，
或者父母发动去帮兄弟克世，
或者应爻刑、害、克、破世的，都要折本。
财伏在父母下，失去一半。
财伏在官鬼下，耗损很多。
财伏在兄弟下，要谨防口舌。
en: Hexagram and Wealth both strong: much capital; both weak: little capital.
Wealth in the womb or tomb stage: little capital.
Wealth void or extinct: no capital.
The Self line carrying a strong Wealth,
or Wealth carrying a strong Vermilion Bird,
or Wealth generated and its store strong,
or Wealth in extinction meeting Birth,
or the outer Wealth generating or combining with the inner Self,
or Wealth on the Gate or Door line, strong and moving (the third line is the Gate, the fourth the Door),
or the three rulers on Wealth, moving to generate or combine with the Self,
or Wealth hidden under the Self or under Output, and generated or strong,
or Wealth moving into Output, into Birth, or into strength,
or Output moving into Wealth, into Birth, or into strength,
all of these bring profit.
If Wealth is absent from the hexagram,
or Wealth is void, broken, dead or extinct,
or the three rulers are on Peer or the Robbery star, moving,
or Peer, strong and moving, controls the Self,
or Resource moves to help Peer control the Self,
or the Other line punishes, harms, controls or breaks the Self: you lose your capital.
Wealth hidden under Resource: half is lost.
Wealth hidden under Pressure: heavy losses.
Wealth hidden under Peer: beware of quarrels.

title: 合伙：应生合世益我，刑冲克害世损我；世应比和同心，六冲不协；兄弟旺静为吉

rule.yi: 合伙：应生合世，对我有益；应刑冲克害世，对我有损。世生应、内生外，是成全别人；世克应、内克外，是借别人的力。世应比和，两人同心；世应六冲，两情不协；世应六合，两意相投；应静而逢冲，心意多变；世空，自己心疏懒；应空，对方心松弛；世应俱空，两家都要退悔；应遭刑害克破，对方多灾病。应带龙喜，交易和气；应临白虎兄弟刻傲，螣蛇兄弟琐碎，玄武兄弟欺诈，勾陈兄弟拙钝，朱雀兄弟多是非。应上的财伏在官鬼下、或应上的财发动化兄弟，必被侵占。游魂卦应临驿马发动，人不守店；归魂卦应临驿马发动，常在家。福神带朱雀加咸池发动，爱吹爱喝；应合财加咸池，有私情。离宫火应带月盲杀克金财，分不出银子成色。应旺，勤俭多能；应衰，疲弱无才；应先合后化冲，有始无终。卦无兄弟，店里没人掌管；兄弟以旺相安静为吉。与内外亲属合伙，以用爻为凭。
rule.en: Partnership: the Other generating or combining with the Self helps me; the Other punishing, clashing with, controlling or harming the Self costs me. The Self generating the Other, inner generating outer: helping another succeed; the Self controlling the Other, inner controlling outer: drawing on another's strength. Self and Other in harmony: two of one mind; in a Six-Clash: feelings do not agree; in a Six-Combine: minds meet; the Other still but clashed: his mind keeps changing; the Self void: my heart is slack; the Other void: his intent is loose; both void: both sides withdraw and regret; the Other punished, harmed, controlled or broken: he has many mishaps and illnesses. The Other with the Dragon and Joy stars: dealings are gracious; on the White Tiger as Peer: sharp and arrogant; Coiling Snake as Peer: petty; Dark Tortoise as Peer: deceitful; Hook Earth as Peer: clumsy and dull; Vermilion Bird as Peer: many quarrels. The Other's Wealth hidden under Pressure, or moving into Peer: he will surely take your share. A Wandering-Soul hexagram with the Other on the Post Horse, moving: he does not stay in the shop; a Returning-Soul hexagram: he is often at home. Output on the Vermilion Bird with the Salt Pool star, moving: fond of boasting and drinking; the Other combining with Wealth and carrying the Salt Pool star: a private affair. In the Li palace, the Other on Fire with the Moon-Blind star, controlling Metal Wealth: cannot tell the fineness of silver. The Other strong: diligent, thrifty and capable; weak: feeble and without talent; combining then turning into a clash: a start with no finish. No Peer in the hexagram: the shop has no one in charge; Peer is auspicious when strong and still. For a partnership with relatives, inside or outside the family, take the Subject line as your guide.

note.yi: 兄弟在这一段里出现两回，说的不是同一个位置：卦里有旺静的兄弟是好事（店里有人掌管）；应爻自己是兄弟并带某个六神时，是对方的毛病。「应衰则□弱无才」里那个字，原书没有印出来，只写了「此处之字上艹下爾」，这里照原文保留，译文里注明是「薾」。
note.en: Peer appears twice in this passage and not in the same place: a strong, still Peer in the hexagram is good (someone runs the shop), while the Other itself being Peer under a given spirit is a fault of the other party. The character in 'the Other weak ... feeble' is not printed in the source; only its description 'grass on top, er below' is, and it is kept as written.

zh: 应生合世者，益我。
应刑冲克害世者，损我。
世生应，内生外，成人之美。
世克应，内克外，得人之力。
世应比和，二人同心。
世应六冲，两情不协。
世应六合，两意相投。
应静逢冲，心多变更。
世空己心疏懒，应空他意懒弛。
世应俱空，两家退悔也。
应遭刑害克破者，多灾病也。
应持龙喜，交易和雅也。
应临虎兄，交易刻傲也。
蛇兄琐屑，
武兄欺诈，
勾兄拙钝，
雀兄多招是非也。
应财伏鬼下，与应财动化兄者，必侵牟也。
游魂应临马动，不守店也。
归魂应临马动，常顾家也。
福雀加咸池动，好吹好饮也。
应合财，加咸池，有私情也。
离宫火应，带月盲杀，
克金财者，不辨银色也。
应旺，则勤俭多能。
应衰，则(此处之字上艹下爾)弱无才也。
应合化冲，有始无终也。
卦无兄弟，店无掌管也。
兄以旺静为吉也。
又凡与内外亲属合本者，以用爻为凭也。
yi: 应生合世的，对我有益。
应刑、冲、克、害世的，对我有损。
世生应、内卦生外卦，是成全别人。
世克应、内卦克外卦，是借到别人的力。
世应比和，两人同心。
世应六冲，两人情意不合。
世应六合，两人心意相投。
应静而遇冲，心意多变。
世空，自己心里疏懒；应空，对方心意松弛。
世应都空，两家都要退悔。
应遭刑、害、克、破的，对方多灾病。
应带龙、喜，交易和气文雅。
应临白虎又是兄弟，交易时刻薄傲慢。
螣蛇兄弟，琐碎；
玄武兄弟，欺诈；
勾陈兄弟，拙钝；
朱雀兄弟，多惹是非。
应上的财伏在官鬼下，或应上的财发动化成兄弟，必被侵占牟利。
游魂卦，应临驿马发动，人不守在店里。
归魂卦，应临驿马发动，常在家里。
福神带朱雀、加咸池而发动，爱吹牛爱喝酒。
应爻去合财，又带着咸池星，会有私情。
离宫，应是火，带月盲杀，
又克金的财，分不清银子的成色。
应旺，就勤俭、多才能。
应衰，就疲弱无才。（原书这个字只写了「上艹下爾」，即「薾」字。）
应先合、后来变成冲，有始无终。
卦里没有兄弟，店里没人掌管。
兄弟以旺相而安静为吉。
还有，凡是和内外亲属合伙出本的，以用爻为凭。
en: The Other generating or combining with the Self: he benefits me.
The Other punishing, clashing with, controlling or harming the Self: he costs me.
The Self generating the Other, inner generating outer: helping another succeed.
The Self controlling the Other, inner controlling outer: drawing on another's strength.
Self and Other in harmony: two of one mind.
Self and Other in a Six-Clash: their feelings do not agree.
Self and Other in a Six-Combine: their minds meet.
The Other still but clashed: his mind keeps changing.
The Self void: my own heart is slack; the Other void: his intent is loose.
Both Self and Other void: both sides withdraw and regret.
The Other meeting punishment, harm, control or breaking: he has many mishaps and illnesses.
The Other carrying the Dragon and Joy stars: dealings are gracious.
The Other on the White Tiger as Peer: sharp and arrogant in dealings.
Coiling Snake as Peer: petty;
Dark Tortoise as Peer: deceitful;
Hook Earth as Peer: clumsy and dull;
Vermilion Bird as Peer: brings many quarrels.
The Other's Wealth hidden under Pressure, or the Other's Wealth moving into Peer: he will surely take your share.
A Wandering-Soul hexagram, the Other on the Post Horse and moving: he does not stay in the shop.
A Returning-Soul hexagram, the Other on the Post Horse and moving: he is often at home.
Output on the Vermilion Bird with the Salt Pool star, moving: fond of boasting and drinking.
The Other combining with Wealth and carrying the Salt Pool star: a private affair.
In the Li palace, the Other on Fire, carrying the Moon-Blind star
and controlling a Metal Wealth: he cannot tell the fineness of the silver.
The Other strong: diligent, thrifty and capable.
The Other weak: then feeble (the source gives the first character only as a description: grass on top, 'er' below) and without talent.
The Other combining, then turning into a clash: a start with no finish.
No Peer in the hexagram: the shop has no one in charge.
Peer is auspicious when strong and still.
Again, for going into partnership with relatives, inside or outside the family, take the Subject line as your guide.

title: 店面货物：父母为店，妻财为货；父旺店大，财旺货流；书纸店以父为用，宝珠古董店以财为用

rule.yi: 看店和货：父母代表店，妻财代表货。父旺而静，店里热闹平安；财旺而动，货物畅销。父旺是大店，父衰是小店；父逢冲开不长，父遇生合能长久。有财无父是有货无店，有父无财是有店无货；父旺财衰，店大利薄；父衰财旺，店小利厚。两个财：内卦被冲、外卦旺，本少利多；内卦旺、外卦被冲，本多利少。卦身和世爻跟官鬼入墓，白费力，利归别人。财爻遇冲暗动，带龙喜暗中得利，带玄武劫煞被骗失财。官鬼临财库发动，不是官司就是灾祸。父母带杀刃亡劫发动，或日雀会月雀发动，招争讼。珠宝古董杂货店以财为用，书纸巾帽衣服店以父为用，酒肴牲畜店以子为用；用神旺、财衰，货多利薄。另有郭雍说：开书籍纸货古董店，财旺而父母被克，吉；开当铺，父母旺而财被克，吉。
rule.en: Reading the shop and its goods: Resource stands for the shop, Wealth for the goods. Resource strong and still: the shop is busy and peaceful; Wealth strong and moving: the goods circulate. Resource strong is a big shop, weak a small one; Resource clashed will not stay open long, generated or combined it stays open for good. Wealth without Resource is goods without a shop; Resource without Wealth is a shop without goods; Resource strong and Wealth weak: a big shop, thin profit; the reverse: a small shop, thick profit. Two Wealth lines, the inner clashed and the outer strong: little capital, much profit; the inner strong and the outer clashed: much capital, little profit. The Body and Self lines following Pressure into the tomb: labor in vain, the profit goes to others. A Wealth line clashed into hidden motion profits in secret with the Dragon and Joy stars, and is cheated of money with the Dark Tortoise or the Robbery star. Pressure moving on the tomb-store of Wealth: a lawsuit or a disaster. Resource moving with the killing stars, the Goat Blade, the Loss or the Robbery star, or the Day's Vermilion Bird meeting the Month's Vermilion Bird, moving: it invites lawsuits. Jewel, antique and sundry shops take Wealth as the Subject; shops of books, paper, scarves, hats and clothes take Resource; wine, food and livestock shops take Output; the Subject strong but Wealth weak: many goods, thin profit. Guo Yong adds: for a shop of books, paper goods and antiques, Wealth strong while Resource is controlled is auspicious; for a pawnshop, Resource strong while Wealth is controlled is auspicious.

dispute.yi: 书籍纸张店该看谁，同一段里有两个说法：前面说书、纸、巾、帽、衣服店以父母为用神，父母旺才好；郭雍却说开书籍纸货古董店，要财旺、父母被克才吉；当铺则反过来，父母旺、财被克才吉。原文并列，没有分出高下。
dispute.en: For a bookshop the same paragraph gives two readings: first, shops of books, paper, scarves, hats and clothes take Resource as the Subject, so Resource should be strong; Guo Yong says a shop of books, paper goods and antiques does well when Wealth is strong and Resource controlled, while a pawnshop is the other way round, Resource strong and Wealth controlled. The source sets them side by side and does not rank them.

note.yi: 「日雀会月雀」只见于《易隐》这一处，按字面译成日的朱雀会月的朱雀。「纸贴」译成纸货。
note.en: 'The Day's Bird meeting the Month's Bird' occurs only here in the Yi Yin and is translated literally. 'Paper and sheets' is rendered as 'paper goods'.

zh: 父母为店，妻财为货。
父旺静者，闹热平安。
财旺动者，货物流行也。
父旺大店，父衰小店。
父逢冲开不久，
父遇生合，开张永远也。
有财无父，有货无店，
有父无财，有店无货。
父旺财衰，店大利微。
父衰财旺，店小利厚。
卦有两财，内冲外旺者，本少利多。
内旺外冲者，本多利少也。
身世随官入墓者，徒劳而利归他人也。
财爻逢冲暗动者，带龙喜，则暗中得利。
带武劫，则被骗失财也。
官临财库动者，非讼即灾也。
父临杀刃亡劫动，
或日雀会月雀动者，主招争讼也。
又宝珠古董杂货店，以财为用。
书纸巾帽衣服店，以父为用。
酒肴牲畜店，以子为用。
用旺财衰者，货多利薄也。
yi: 父母代表店，妻财代表货。
父母旺而安静，店里热闹平安。
财旺而发动，货物畅销。
父母旺是大店，父母衰是小店。
父母逢冲，开不长久；
父母遇生合，开张能长久。
有财而没有父母，是有货没有店；
有父母而没有财，是有店没有货。
父母旺、财衰，店大利薄。
父母衰、财旺，店小利厚。
卦里有两个财，内卦被冲、外卦旺的，本钱少利润多；
内卦旺、外卦被冲的，本钱多利润少。
卦身和世爻跟着官鬼入墓的，白费力气，利润归了别人。
财爻遇冲而暗动，若带龙、喜，就在暗地里得利；
带玄武、劫煞，就被骗失财。
官鬼落在财库上发动，不是官司就是灾祸。
父母带着杀、刃、亡、劫而发动，
或者日的朱雀与月的朱雀相会而发动，主招来争讼。
还有，卖珠宝、古董、杂货的店，以财为用神。
卖书、纸、头巾、帽子、衣服的店，以父母为用神。
卖酒菜、牲畜的店，以子孙为用神。
用神旺、财衰，货多利薄。
en: Resource stands for the shop; Wealth for the goods.
Resource strong and still: the shop is busy and peaceful.
Wealth strong and moving: the goods circulate freely.
Resource strong: a big shop; Resource weak: a small shop.
Resource clashed: it will not stay open long;
Resource generated or combined: it will stay open for good.
Wealth without Resource: goods without a shop;
Resource without Wealth: a shop without goods.
Resource strong and Wealth weak: a big shop with thin profit.
Resource weak and Wealth strong: a small shop with thick profit.
Two Wealth lines in the hexagram, the inner clashed and the outer strong: little capital, much profit;
the inner strong and the outer clashed: much capital, little profit.
The Body and Self lines following Pressure into the tomb: labor in vain, and the profit goes to others.
A Wealth line clashed into hidden motion: with the Dragon and Joy stars, it profits in secret;
with the Dark Tortoise or the Robbery star, you are cheated of your money.
Pressure moving on the tomb-store of Wealth: a lawsuit or a disaster.
Resource moving with the killing stars, the Goat Blade, the Loss star or the Robbery star,
or the Day's Vermilion Bird meeting the Month's Vermilion Bird, moving: it invites lawsuits.
Again, for jewel, antique and sundry shops, Wealth is the Subject.
For shops of books, paper, scarves, hats and clothes, Resource is the Subject.
For shops of wine, food and livestock, Output is the Subject.
The Subject strong but Wealth weak: many goods, thin profit.

zh: 又郭雍曰，开书籍纸贴古董店，
财旺而父母受克者，吉也。
开当铺者，父旺而财受克者，吉也。
yi: 又郭雍说：开书籍、纸货、古董店，
财旺而父母被克，吉。
开当铺的，父母旺而财被克，吉。
en: Guo Yong also says: for a shop of books, paper goods and antiques,
Wealth strong while Resource is controlled: auspicious.
For a pawnshop: Resource strong while Wealth is controlled: auspicious.

title: 收放：哪一爻生合世可放账；临空破死绝或动来刑害克冲世，有放无收

rule.yi: 放账收账：《管公口诀》说，六爻是钱财往来的路；哪一爻生合世爻，可以放账；如果它落在空、破、死、绝上，或者发动来刑、害、克、冲世爻，放出去收不回来。
rule.en: Extending and collecting credit: Guan Gong's rhymes say the six lines are the roads by which money comes and goes; a line that generates or combines with the Self, you may lend on credit; if it falls in void, break, death or extinction, or moves to punish, harm, control or clash the Self, you lend and never collect.

note.yi: 「东西财路」的「东西」原文没有解释，这里按字面译成东来西往。
note.en: The source does not explain 'east and west money roads'; it is translated literally.

zh: 管公口诀曰，
六爻为东西财路，
生合世者，可放帐。
若临空破死绝，及动来刑害克冲世者，
主有放无收也。
yi: 管公口诀说：
六爻是钱财东来西往的路，
哪一爻生合世爻，就可以放账。
如果它落在空、破、死、绝上，或者发动来刑、害、克、冲世爻，
主放出去收不回来。
en: Guan Gong's rhymes say:
the six lines are the roads by which money comes and goes, east and west;
a line that generates or combines with the Self: you may lend on credit.
But if it falls in void, break, death or extinction, or moves to punish, harm, control or clash the Self,
you lend and never collect.

title: 寄物：卦六合、财旺静可寄；财衰动、空破、应动带凶神则有失

rule.yi: 把东西寄放在别人那里：先要托给可托的人，因为人心难测，有见物起欺心的，有收藏不严招盗的，有安放不当弄坏东西的。卦六合可寄，六冲不可寄；月日和动爻合财、合世应可寄，冲财、冲世应不可寄。财旺静，或财动化子孙、化长生、化旺，无失；财衰动，或动化兄弟、官鬼、空破绝，有失。财化土朽腐，化木微黷，化火遭火灾，化水受潮漏，化金封识被拆开。世应空破、随官鬼入墓、被兄弟官鬼动伤，应爻动化兄鬼空破绝，都有失。应爻动，他心变；应动助鬼伤身世财，他与人合谋劫骗。应临玄武动偷窃，临朱雀动口舌，临勾陈动牵连，临螣蛇动惊恐，临白虎动吞没，临青龙动则善加保护。
rule.en: Leaving goods with someone: first choose a person who can be trusted, for hearts are hard to fathom: some see the goods and turn deceitful, some store them carelessly and invite thieves, some put them in the wrong place and let them spoil. A Six-Combine hexagram: you may leave things; a Six-Clash: you may not. The Month, the Day and moving lines combining with Wealth, the Self or the Other: you may; clashing with them: you may not. Wealth strong and still, or Wealth moving into Output, into Birth or into strength: nothing is lost; Wealth weak and moving, or moving into Peer, Pressure, void, break or extinction: loss. Wealth turning into Earth: rot and decay; into Wood: slightly soiled; into Fire: fire; into Water: damp and leaks; into Metal: the seals broken open. Self and Other void or broken, following Pressure into the tomb, hurt by moving Peer or Pressure, or the Other moving into Peer, Pressure, void, break or extinction: loss. The Other moving: his mind has changed; the Other moving to help Pressure hurt the Body, the Self and the Wealth line: he plots with others to rob and cheat you. The Other moving on the Dark Tortoise: theft; on the Vermilion Bird: quarrels; on Hook Earth: entanglement; on the Coiling Snake: fright; on the White Tiger: devouring; on the Azure Dragon: good safekeeping.

note.yi: 原文是一整段，「游南子曰」之后没有另外标出说话人的分界；「故」字以下这里按本文（未标说话人）放，如果它其实也是游南子的话，归属会不同。「微黷」译成略有污损。
note.en: The source is one paragraph with no marked change of speaker after 'Master Younan says'; from 'so' onward it is placed as the base text, and if it is also Master Younan's, the attribution would differ. 'Slightly soiled' translates a two-character phrase whose first character means 'slight'.

zh: 游南子曰，
吾之寄物，必托其人之可托，
而后以物付之也，
然而人情叵测，
睹物怀欺者有之，
谩藏诲盗者有之，
安置失所，致物败坏者有之，
是不可以不慎厥始也。
yi: 游南子说：
我把东西寄放出去，一定要托给可以托付的人，
然后才把东西交给他。
可是人心难测：
有看见东西就起欺心的，
有收藏不严、招来盗贼的，
有安放不当、把东西弄坏的，
所以一开始就不能不谨慎。
en: Master Younan says:
when I leave my goods with someone, I must choose a person who can be trusted,
and only then hand the goods over.
But human hearts are hard to fathom:
some see the goods and turn deceitful;
some store them carelessly and so invite thieves;
some put them in the wrong place and let them spoil;
so one cannot but be careful from the very start.

zh: 故卦六合者，可寄。
六冲者，不可寄也。
月日与动爻合财合世应者，可寄。
冲财冲世应者，不可寄也。
财旺静，与财动化子，化生化旺者，无失。
财衰动，与动化兄鬼空破绝者，有失也。
财化土者朽腐。
财化木者微黷。
财化火者回禄。
财化水者湿漏。
财化金者，封识拆开也。
世应空破者失，
世应随鬼入墓者失，
兄鬼动伤应爻者失，
应爻动化兄鬼空破绝者失也。
应爻动者，他心变也。
应动助鬼伤身世财爻者，与人合计劫骗也。
应临武动者偷窃。
应临雀动者口舌。
应临勾动者牵连。
应临蛇动者惊恐。
应临虎动者吞噬。
应临龙动者，善保护也。
yi: 所以卦是六合的，可以寄放。
六冲的，不可以寄放。
月建、日辰和动爻合财、合世、合应的，可以寄放；
冲财、冲世、冲应的，不可以寄放。
财旺而静，或财发动化成子孙、化长生、化旺的，不会有失。
财衰而动，或发动化成兄弟、官鬼、空、破、绝的，会有损失。
财化成土的，朽烂腐坏。
财化成木的，略有污损。
财化成火的，遭火灾。
财化成水的，受潮渗漏。
财化成金的，封条印记被拆开。
世、应落空或破的，有失；
世、应跟着官鬼入墓的，有失；
兄弟、官鬼发动伤应爻的，有失；
应爻发动化成兄弟、官鬼、空、破、绝的，有失。
应爻发动，对方变了心。
应发动去帮官鬼、伤害卦身、世爻和财爻，是他和别人合谋劫骗你。
应临玄武而发动，偷窃。
应临朱雀而发动，口舌是非。
应临勾陈而发动，牵连不清。
应临螣蛇而发动，惊恐。
应临白虎而发动，被吞没。
应临青龙而发动，能好好保护。
en: So a Six-Combine hexagram: you may leave things.
A Six-Clash hexagram: you may not.
The Month, the Day and moving lines combining with Wealth, the Self or the Other: you may leave things;
clashing with Wealth, the Self or the Other: you may not.
Wealth strong and still, or Wealth moving into Output, into Birth or into strength: nothing is lost.
Wealth weak and moving, or moving into Peer, Pressure, void, break or extinction: something is lost.
Wealth turning into Earth: rot and decay.
Wealth turning into Wood: slightly soiled.
Wealth turning into Fire: fire strikes.
Wealth turning into Water: damp and leaks.
Wealth turning into Metal: the seals are broken open.
Self and Other void or broken: loss;
Self and Other following Pressure into the tomb: loss;
Peer or Pressure moving to hurt the Other line: loss;
the Other line moving into Peer, Pressure, void, break or extinction: loss.
The Other line moving: his mind has changed.
The Other moving to help Pressure hurt the Body, the Self and the Wealth line: he is plotting with others to rob and cheat you.
The Other moving on the Dark Tortoise: theft.
On the Vermilion Bird: quarrels.
On Hook Earth: entanglement.
On the Coiling Snake: fright.
On the White Tiger: devouring.
On the Azure Dragon: he guards it well.

title: 世克官，官生世，须宜谒见

rule.yi: 谒贵求财：世爻克官鬼或官鬼生世，宜去拜见；财临月破、官鬼克世，白跑。野鹤：求名以官鬼为用，求利以妻财为用，用神持世或生合世爻为吉；逢空破墓绝、动而变凶，徒劳；世爻化鬼、化回头克，或随鬼入墓、助鬼伤身，不宜去，去则到彼或途中遇祸。
rule.en: Calling on the great for money: the Self line controlling Pressure, or Pressure generating the Self line, go; Wealth under a Month-break or Pressure controlling the Self line, a wasted journey. Yehe: for a post take Pressure, for gain take Wealth; the Subject on or generating or combining with the Self line is good; void, broken, entombed, extinguished, or turning harmful, the trip is for nothing; the Self line turning into Pressure or into its own control, following the ghost into the tomb or feeding the ghost that harms it, do not go, or trouble meets you there or on the way.

zh: 世克官，官生世，须宜谒见；
财临破，鬼克世，枉费奔驰。
yi: 世爻克官鬼、官鬼生世爻，应当去拜见；
财爻逢月破、官鬼克世爻，白白奔走。
en: The Self line controlling Pressure, or Pressure generating the Self line: go and call on them;
Wealth under a Month-break, or Pressure controlling the Self line: the running about is wasted.

zh: 野鹤曰：见贵有两问，为名者用官，为利者用财。
皆宜持世及生合世爻为吉，
如逢空破墓绝，及动而变凶者，徒劳奔驰耳。
倘若世爻化鬼化克，及随墓助伤者，更不宜行，
若非到彼逢凶，定在中途遇祸。
占谒贵者，亦同此断。
yi: 野鹤说：拜见贵人有两种问法：为求名，以官鬼为用神；为求利，以妻财为用神。
都以用神持世或生合世爻为吉；
如果用神逢空、破、墓、绝，或动而变凶，只是白跑一趟。
如果世爻化出官鬼、化出回头克，以及随鬼入墓、助鬼伤身，更不宜去；
不是到了那里遇凶，就是半路遇祸。
占拜见贵人的，也这样断。
en: Yehe says: calling on a person of rank can be asked two ways; for a post, take Pressure; for gain, take Wealth.
In both, the Subject sitting on or generating or combining with the Self line is good;
if it is void, broken, entombed or extinguished, or turns harmful when it moves, the journey is for nothing.
If the Self line turns into Pressure or into something that controls it, or follows the ghost into the tomb, or feeds the ghost that harms it, all the more do not go;
if trouble does not meet you there, it will on the way.
Questions about calling on the great are judged the same way.

title: 世动遇空，身兴遇破

rule.yi: 谒贵：世爻动而化空、化破，不作凶论，是应期——应在到达那里的月日（书中例：官星持世而空，出空之日见到，财利如意）。
rule.en: Calling on the great: the Self line moving into the void or into a Month-break is not bad; it marks the month or day you arrive (case in the book: Pressure on the Self line was void, and the meeting came on the day it left the void, with the money as wished).

zh: 世动遇空，身兴遇破。
世动化空破者，勿曰不吉，乃应到彼之月日也。
yi: 世爻动而逢空，世身动而逢破。
世爻动而化空、化破，不要说不吉，那是应在到达那里的月日。
en: The Self line moving into the void; the Self stirring into a Month-break.
If the Self line moves and turns void or broken, do not call it unlucky: it marks the month or day you arrive there.

zh: 如：申月丁卯日(旬空：戌亥)，占出行谒见贵人，得“天火同人”
yi: 例：申月丁卯日（旬空戌、亥），占出门拜见贵人，得天火同人卦。
en: Case: Shen month, Dingmao day (void: Xu and Hai); the question was travelling to call on a person of rank; the hexagram Tianhuo Tongren.

zh: 断曰：官星持世而空，亥日出空得见，财利如心。
果于出空之日见官，财利得意。
乃月建财爻生世之故也。
yi: 断语：官鬼持世而落空，到亥日出空时能见到，财利如意。
果然在出空的那天见到官员，财利得意。
这是因为月建是财爻、来生世爻。
en: Judgment: Pressure sat on the Self line but was void; on the Hai day it would leave the void and the meeting would happen, with the money as wished.
He did meet the official on the day it left the void, and did well by it.
That was because the Month was the Wealth line and generated the Self line.

title: 官持世财动相生，财持世官无缺陷

rule.yi: 谒贵求财：官鬼持世而财爻动来生它，或财持世而官鬼完好无损，再得日月生世生财（或世、财临日月），双方投缘，吉。
rule.en: Calling on the great for money: Pressure on the Self line with a moving Wealth generating it, or Wealth on the Self line with Pressure sound, and the Day and Month generating the Self or Wealth (or the Self or Wealth line being the Day or Month branch): the two sides take to each other; good.

zh: 官持世，财动相生；
财持世，官无缺陷；
再得日月照临，彼此缘投有幸。
日月照临者，乃日月生世、生财，或世爻、财爻而临日月是也。
yi: 官鬼持世，而财爻发动来生它；
财爻持世，而官鬼完好无损（不空不破）；
再有日月照临，双方投缘，有幸运。
「日月照临」，是指日辰月建生世爻、生财爻，或世爻、财爻本身就是日辰月建。
en: Pressure on the Self line with a moving Wealth generating it;
Wealth on the Self line with the Pressure line sound (neither void nor broken);
and the Day and Month shining on it: the two sides take to each other, and fortune smiles.
'The Day and Month shining on it' means the Day and Month generate the Self line or the Wealth, or the Self line or Wealth line is itself the Day or Month branch.

title: 为名宜父动，因利忌兄兴

rule.yi: 问的是什么就看什么：谒贵能否见到，看世爻与官鬼相生相合；能否得名、得利要另起一卦（名看父母、官鬼两旺，利看妻财、子孙两旺）。为求名而起的卦里财爻持世，是破文书的忌神，不能读作「不成名也得利」。
rule.en: Read what was asked: whether you will be received depends on the Self line and Pressure generating or combining; whether it brings a post or gain needs a separate casting (a post wants Resource and Pressure strong, gain wants Wealth and Output). In a hexagram cast for a post, Wealth on the Self line is the Adversary that breaks the documents; do not read it as 'no post, but money'.

zh: 为名宜父动，因利忌兄兴。
凡占谒贵，既得世与官星相生相合，必然得见。
若为名利，须宜另占，不可即以此卦断之。
盖为名者，宜父官两旺；为利者，宜财福两旺也。
yi: 为求名，宜父母发动；为求利，忌兄弟兴动。
凡是占拜见贵人，只要世爻和官鬼相生相合，一定能见到。
至于能否得名得利，要另外起卦，不能就用这一卦来断。
因为求名要父母、官鬼两旺，求利要妻财、子孙两旺。
en: For a post, a moving Resource is welcome; for gain, a stirring Peer is feared.
When asking about calling on the great, if the Self line and Pressure generate or combine with each other, you will be received.
Whether it brings a post or gain must be asked in a separate casting; do not judge it from this one.
For a post, Resource and Pressure should both be strong; for gain, Wealth and Output.

zh: 如：申月甲辰日(旬空：寅卯)，占谒贵求题荐，得“火雷噬嗑”
yi: 例：申月甲辰日（旬空寅、卯），占拜见贵人求推荐，得火雷噬嗑卦。
en: Case: Shen month, Jiachen day (void: Yin and Mao); the question was calling on a person of rank to ask for a recommendation; the hexagram Huolei Shihe.

zh: 求题荐全仗文书，卦中财爻持世，父母受克，难许如心。
彼曰：如果得财，亦不负此一行。
余曰：非此论也，汝来意原为求名，此持世之财，乃破文书之忌神也。非许汝以求财也。
yi: 求推荐全靠文书（父母），卦里财爻持世，父母受克，难以如愿。
他说：如果能得到钱财，也不枉走这一趟。
我说：不是这样论的。你来的本意是求名，这个持世的财，是破文书的忌神，并不是许你求财。
en: A recommendation depends wholly on documents (Resource); here the Wealth line sat on the Self line and Resource was controlled, so success could not be promised.
He said: if I get money out of it, the trip will still be worth it.
I said: that is not how it reads. You came to seek a post; this Wealth on the Self line is the Adversary that breaks the documents. It does not promise you money.

zh: 觉子曰：每见人断如此之卦，竟以此财爻决为有财，
殊不知财爻持世破文书，求荐举而不得也，
误作虽不成名必得其利者，岂不大谬。
yi: 觉子说：常见人断这样的卦，竟然凭这个财爻断定有财，
却不知道财爻持世是破文书，求推荐而得不到；
错断成「虽然成不了名，一定得利」，岂不是大错。
en: Juezi says: I often see people read such a hexagram and conclude from this Wealth line that there is money,
not realising that the Wealth line on the Self line breaks the documents, and the recommendation will not come;
to read it as 'no post, but certainly gain' is a grave mistake.

title: 六合六冲须看用，反吟化退枉奔劳

rule.yi: 六合、六冲不能单独定吉凶：六合要用神旺相，或世与财、官相合，才吉；六冲要用神受克失陷，才凶。反吟、世动化退：难以成行，勉强去也空手回。
rule.en: Six-Combine and Six-Clash do not decide the matter by themselves: a Six-Combine is good only with the Subject strong or the Self line combining with Wealth or Pressure; a Six-Clash is bad only if the Subject is controlled and falls. Reversed Chant, or the Self line moving into Retreating: hard to set out, and back empty-handed if you force it.

zh: 六合六冲须看用，反吟化退枉奔劳。
爻逢六合，亦要用神旺相，或世与财官相合，乃为吉兆。
卦遇六冲，必须用神受克失陷，始作凶征。
卦得反吟，及世动化退，多见难于行动，勉强而去，素手空归。
yi: 六合、六冲都要看用神，反吟、化退是白白奔劳。
爻逢六合，也要用神旺相，或世爻与财、官相合，才是吉兆。
卦逢六冲，一定要用神受克、失陷，才算凶兆。
卦得反吟，以及世爻动而化退，多半难以成行，勉强去了，也空手而归。
en: Six-Combine and Six-Clash both depend on the Subject; Reversed Chant or turning Retreating means toil for nothing.
Even with Six-Combine lines, the Subject must be strong, or the Self line must combine with Wealth or Pressure, before it is a good sign.
With a Six-Clash hexagram, only if the Subject is controlled and falls does it become a bad sign.
A Reversed Chant hexagram, or the Self line moving into Retreating, usually means the trip is hard to make; go anyway and you come back empty-handed.

title: 贵人谒贵宜世应相生，平人见贵宜官贵相合

rule.yi: 谒贵分身份：贵人见贵人看世应相生相合；平民见贵人看官鬼与世爻相生相合，或官鬼持世。问能否得见，官鬼生合世即见；问功名，官鬼持世、生世才得名（觉子：勿把所见贵人之官当功名）。世应冲克、财伏而空，去无益；官鬼克世、世化鬼化克，凶，平人勿去；财官生世、持世吉。
rule.en: It depends on who is calling: rank calling on rank reads Self and Other generating or combining; a commoner calling on the great reads Pressure generating or combining with the Self line, or sitting on it. If the question is only whether you will be received, Pressure generating or combining with the Self line says yes; if it is office, Pressure must sit on or generate the Self line (Juezi: do not take the great man's Pressure line for office). Self and Other clashing or controlling with Wealth hidden and void, no use going; Pressure controlling the Self line, or the Self turning into Pressure or into its own control, bad, and a commoner should not go; Wealth or Pressure generating or sitting on the Self line is good.

zh: 贵人谒贵，宜世应以相生；平人见贵，宜官贵而相合。
贵人谒贵人，宜世应相合相生；平人见贵人，宜官贵相合相生及官星持世。
yi: 有身份的人拜见贵人，宜世应相生；平民拜见贵人，宜官鬼（贵人）与世相合。
贵人见贵人，宜世应相合相生；平民见贵人，宜官鬼与世相合相生，以及官鬼持世。
en: A person of rank calling on another: Self and Other should generate each other; a commoner calling on the great: Pressure (the great man) should combine with him.
Rank to rank: Self and Other should combine or generate; commoner to the great: Pressure should combine with or generate the Self line, or sit on it.

zh: 觉子曰：有心而问见贵求名者，官星持世、生世，必得功名。
有心问谒贵人者，官星生世、合世而得见也，
切勿以此所见贵人之官星，误作成名而断也。
yi: 觉子说：如果心里问的是见贵人求功名，官鬼持世、生世，一定得功名。
如果心里问的是能否见到贵人，官鬼生世、合世，就能见到；
千万不要把代表所见贵人的官鬼，误当成功名来断。
en: Juezi says: if the question in your mind is seeking office through a great man, Pressure on or generating the Self line means office will come.
If the question is only whether you will be received, Pressure generating or combining with the Self line means you will;
never take the Pressure line that stands for the great man as a sign of office.

zh: 野鹤曰：贵人谒贵，世应若相冲克，财伏而空，去之何益？
官鬼克世、世变鬼变克，更凶。
平人见贵，官克世、世变鬼变克，勿去，去则须防不测。
财官生世、持世为吉。
yi: 野鹤说：贵人拜见贵人，世应如果相冲相克，财又伏藏落空，去了有什么用？
官鬼克世、世爻化鬼或化回头克，更凶。
平民拜见贵人，官鬼克世、世爻化鬼或化回头克，不要去，去了要防意外。
财、官生世或持世为吉。
en: Yehe says: when a person of rank calls on another, if Self and Other clash or control each other and Wealth is hidden and void, what is the use of going?
Pressure controlling the Self line, or the Self line turning into Pressure or into something that controls it, is worse.
For a commoner calling on the great: Pressure controlling the Self line, or the Self line turning into Pressure or into its own control, means do not go; if you go, beware of the unexpected.
Wealth or Pressure generating or sitting on the Self line is good.

chapter: 为贵人奔走效力求财章
title: 最重财官两旺，不宜世应皆空

rule.yi: 替贵人奔走效力求财：财、官两旺为要，世应俱空不宜；世临财、应临福，我得益；应临官、世逢破，他得益；兄弟持世，不如不去；应克世，防对方反目。
rule.en: Earning by serving a great man: Wealth and Pressure both strong is what matters; Self and Other both void is bad. Wealth on the Self line and Output on the Other, I gain; Pressure on the Other and the Self line broken, he gains; Peer on the Self line, better not to go; the Other controlling the Self, beware of him turning on you.

zh: 最重财官两旺，不宜世应皆空。
世遇财、应临福，我益他损；
应临官、世逢破，他益我损。
兄持世，不如闲处安身；
应克世，防虑他人反目。
yi: 最看重财、官两旺，不宜世、应都空。
世爻临财、应爻临子孙，我得益、他受损；
应爻临官鬼、世爻逢月破，他得益、我受损。
兄弟持世，不如闲着安身；
应克世，要防对方翻脸。
en: What matters most is Wealth and Pressure both strong; Self and Other both void is bad.
Wealth on the Self line and Output on the Other: I gain, he loses;
Pressure on the Other and the Self line broken: he gains, I lose.
Peer on the Self line: better to stay idle and safe;
the Other controlling the Self: beware of him turning against you.

chapter: 开行开店及各项铺面章
title: 世为己，应为人，大宜相合；财为本，福为基，最喜同兴

rule.yi: 开行开店：世为自己、应为对方，宜相合；财为本、福为基，宜同旺。觉子：应爻代表谁，看问者本意——问伙计，应为伙计（世应生合同心；应生世他益我，世生应我益他；冲克生变，应克世我被瞒，世克应他从我；应临玄武兄爻暗中盗骗，应临官鬼克世明降灾非；世财应兄受累，世财应子得力；世应空合彼此虚诈）；问买卖，应为顾客（应生合世，生客成熟客；世应冲克，熟人成仇）。
rule.en: Opening a shop: the Self line is oneself, the Other the other party, and they should combine; Wealth is the capital, Output the foundation, and both should flourish. Juezi: who the Other line stands for depends on what is asked. Asking about a partner, it is the partner (generating or combining, of one mind; Other generating Self, he benefits me; Self generating Other, I benefit him; clashing or controlling, goodwill changes; Other controlling Self, he deceives me; Self controlling Other, he goes along; Other on the Dark Tortoise and Peer, secret fraud; Other on Pressure controlling Self, open trouble; Wealth on Self and Peer on Other, he drags me down; Wealth on Self and Output on Other, he helps; both void yet combining, both insincere). Asking about the trade, it is the customer (generating or combining with the Self line, strangers become regulars; clashing or controlling, old friends become enemies).

note.yi: 「世为已」的「已」当是「己」，两个本子都作「已」，原文照录。
note.en: The text writes yi (already) where ji (oneself) is meant; both editions have it, and we quote it as it stands.

zh: 世为已，应为人，大宜相合；
财为本，福为基，最喜同兴。
yi: 世爻是自己，应爻是别人，最好相合；
财是本钱，子孙是根基，最喜欢一起兴旺。
en: The Self line is oneself, the Other line the other party; they should combine;
Wealth is the capital, Output the foundation; best if both flourish together.

hits.text: 世为己，应为人，大宜契合
世为己应为人，大宜契合
世为己应为人，大宜契合
世为己，应为人，大宜契合

zh: 觉子曰：古法，应为伙计，又为下顾之客。
《黄金策》曰：开行定主有人投，余以为须在占者之念。
彼若一意而问伙计，则应为伙计。
若得世应相生相合，彼此同心；应生世，他益于我；世生应，我益于他。
相克相冲，两情有变，应克世，我被他瞒；世克应，他从我愿。
应临玄武兄爻，暗中盗骗；应临官鬼克世，明降灾非。
世财应兄，受他之累；世财应子，得他之力；世应空合，彼此有虚诈之心。
如一意而重在买卖者，则以应爻为下顾之客。
应爻生世、合世，生客来交成故旧；
世应相冲相克，熟人终久变成仇。
yi: 觉子说：古法把应爻当作伙计，又当作上门的顾客。
《黄金策》说「开行定主有人投」，我认为要看占的人心里问的是什么。
他如果一心问的是伙计，应爻就是伙计。
世应相生相合，彼此同心；应生世，他对我有益；世生应，我对他有益。
相克相冲，两人的情分会变；应克世，我被他瞒；世克应，他顺我的意。
应爻临玄武、兄弟，暗中偷骗；应爻临官鬼来克世，公开带来灾祸是非。
世临财、应临兄弟，受他连累；世临财、应临子孙，得他的力；世应空而相合，彼此都有虚假欺诈之心。
如果一心问的是买卖，就以应爻为上门的顾客。
应爻生世、合世，生客也会成为老主顾；
世应相冲相克，熟人最终也会变成仇人。
en: Juezi says: the old method takes the Other line as the partner, and also as the customer who calls.
The Golden Strategy says 'a brokerage that opens will draw clients'; I hold that it depends on what the asker has in mind.
If he is asking only about a partner, the Other line is the partner.
Self and Other generating or combining: of one mind; Other generating Self: he benefits me; Self generating Other: I benefit him.
Controlling or clashing: their goodwill will change; Other controlling Self: he deceives me; Self controlling Other: he does as I wish.
The Other line on the Dark Tortoise and the Peer line: secret theft and fraud; the Other line on Pressure controlling the Self line: open trouble and disputes.
Wealth on Self and Peer on Other: he drags me down; Wealth on Self and Output on Other: he helps me; Self and Other void yet combining: both sides are insincere.
If his mind is on the trade itself, the Other line is the customer.
The Other line generating or combining with the Self line: strangers become regular customers;
Self and Other clashing or controlling: even old acquaintances become enemies in the end.

chapter: 开行开店及各项铺面章
title: 鬼作灾非须忌动，财为活计畏刑冲

rule.yi: 开店：官鬼发动招是非，克世最忌（鬼现爻中是非日有，鬼摇克世灾祸连绵）；财为资本，忌衰墓空破、动而变凶、日月刑冲克害；世爻与财爻落空，开不成。
rule.en: Opening a shop: a moving Pressure invites disputes, and controlling the Self line is worst (Pressure present, disputes daily; Pressure moving against the Self, one disaster after another); Wealth is the capital and fears being weak, entombed, void or broken, turning harmful, or being punished, clashed or controlled by the Day or Month; the Self line and Wealth void, the shop will not open.

zh: 鬼作灾非须忌动，财为活计畏刑冲。
鬼动招非，克世最忌。
法云：鬼现爻中，是非日有；鬼摇克世，灾祸连绵。
须看鬼值何神克世，当于家宅章内详之。
财为资本，忌衰墓空破，及动而变凶，或日月刑冲克害，
更忌世与财空，俱开不成。
yi: 官鬼主灾祸是非，最忌发动；财是营生，最怕刑冲。
官鬼动就招是非，来克世最忌。
古法说：官鬼出现在卦中，天天有是非；官鬼发动克世，灾祸连绵。
要看官鬼临什么六神来克世，详见家宅章。
财是资本，忌衰、墓、空、破，以及动而变凶，或被日月刑冲克害；
更忌世爻和财爻落空，那样都开不成。
en: Pressure brings trouble and disputes, so its moving is feared; Wealth is the livelihood, so punishment and clash are feared.
A moving Pressure invites disputes; controlling the Self line is the worst.
The rule says: Pressure present in the lines, disputes every day; Pressure moving to control the Self line, one disaster after another.
See which spirit the Pressure line carries when it controls the Self line; details in the chapter on the household.
Wealth is the capital; it fears being weak, entombed, void or broken, turning harmful when it moves, or being punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by the Day or Month;
above all it fears the Self line and Wealth being void: then the shop will not open.

chapter: 开行开店及各项铺面章
title: 鬼兄发动，有制何妨；随墓助伤，多凶少吉

rule.yi: 兄弟、官鬼发动，有制则无妨（子孙制鬼，或日月冲克鬼爻）；兄、鬼同动时，官鬼反能制兄、护财（觉子）。忌世随鬼入墓、世动变凶；做买卖虽宜财动，官鬼克世时财动反成「助鬼伤身」。
rule.en: Peer and Pressure moving do no harm if restrained (Output holding Pressure down, or the Day or Month clashing or controlling it); when Peer and Pressure move together, Pressure actually restrains Peer and shields the money (Juezi). Beware of the Self line following the ghost into the tomb or moving into harm; in trade a moving Wealth is welcome, but with Pressure controlling the Self line it only 'feeds the ghost that harms you'.

zh: 鬼兄发动，有制何妨；
随墓助伤，多凶少吉。
鬼动招非，若得子孙制鬼，或日月冲克鬼爻，谓之有制。
yi: 官鬼、兄弟发动，有制就不妨；
随鬼入墓、助鬼伤身，多凶少吉。
官鬼动招是非，如果有子孙克制官鬼，或日月冲克官鬼，叫作有制。
en: Pressure and Peer moving: no harm if they are restrained;
following the ghost into the tomb, or feeding the ghost that harms you: mostly bad, seldom good.
A moving Pressure invites disputes; if Output restrains it, or the Day or Month clashes with or controls the Pressure line, that is called restrained.

zh: 觉子曰：凡遇兄鬼同动者，不可概曰鬼动招非，盖鬼动能制兄爻不劫财也。
兄弟又为阻隔破耗之小人，得此鬼动可以制服。
独不宜世随鬼入墓，或世动而变凶，皆凶兆也。
yi: 觉子说：凡是兄弟、官鬼同时发动，不能一概说官鬼动招是非，因为官鬼动能制住兄弟，使它不劫财。
兄弟又是阻隔、破耗的小人，有官鬼发动就能制服它。
只是不宜世爻随官鬼入墓，或世爻动而变凶，这些都是凶兆。
en: Juezi says: when Peer and Pressure move together, do not simply say the moving Pressure invites disputes, for it holds the Peer line down so that it cannot rob the money.
Peer is also the petty person who obstructs and wastes; a moving Pressure can subdue it.
Only the Self line following the ghost into the tomb, or moving into something harmful, is a bad sign.

zh: 凡占贸易，虽宜财动，若遇鬼爻克世，又不相宜，乃为助鬼以伤身也。
yi: 凡是占做买卖，虽然宜财爻发动，如果遇到官鬼克世，又不合适，这叫「助鬼伤身」（财生鬼，鬼伤世）。
en: In trade, a moving Wealth is welcome, but if the Pressure line controls the Self line it is not, for that is 'feeding the ghost that harms you' (Wealth feeds Pressure, and Pressure hurts the Self).

chapter: 开行开店及各项铺面章
title: 卦得反吟多反复，冲中变合再重兴

rule.yi: 开店：卦得反吟，反复不定，已开久的店主迁移变更；六冲变六合、爻逢六合，或世与财、子成三合，关后重兴；六合变六冲，眼前热闹，终久萧条。
rule.en: Opening a shop: a Reversed Chant hexagram means back and forth, and a long-established shop will move or change hands; Six-Clash changing into Six-Combine, combining lines, or the Self line in a three-harmony frame with Wealth and Output, it will close and flourish again; Six-Combine changing into Six-Clash, busy now and deserted in the end.

zh: 卦得反吟多反复。
卦得反吟，欲行不行，行而又止，或开而又闭，闭而又开，
倘店已开久，遇此一定更迁。
冲中变合再重兴。
爻逢六合，及六冲卦变六合，或世与财爻、子孙共成三合，定是闭后重兴。
惟六合变冲，则不宜也，眼前热闹，终久萧条。
yi: 卦得反吟，多反复。
卦得反吟，想做又不做，做了又停，或开了又关，关了又开；
如果店已经开了很久，遇到反吟一定要搬迁变更。
六冲变六合，会重新兴旺。
爻逢六合，以及六冲卦变成六合卦，或世爻和财爻、子孙一起成三合，一定是关张之后重新兴起。
只有六合变六冲不好，眼前热闹，终究冷清。
en: A Reversed Chant hexagram means going back and forth.
With Reversed Chant, you mean to act and do not, start and stop again, open and close, close and open;
if the shop has long been open, this means it will move or change hands.
Clash changing into combination: it will flourish again.
Six-Combine lines, a Six-Clash hexagram changing into a Six-Combine one, or the Self line forming a three-harmony frame with the Wealth line and Output: it will close and then flourish again.
Only combination changing into clash is bad: busy now, deserted in the end.

title: 官若兴隆，行主可千金之托；应如空破，牙人无毫忽之能

rule.yi: 委托牙行（投行）：官鬼（行主）、应爻（牙人）旺而生合世爻，可托千金；官、应静衰空破，是奸险之人，交财必被骗。
rule.en: Placing goods with a brokerage: Pressure (the house) and the Other line (the broker) strong and generating or combining with the Self line, you can trust them with a fortune; still, weak, void or broken, they are crooks and your money will be taken.

zh: 官若兴隆，行主可千金之托；
应如空破，牙人无毫忽之能。
官旺应旺，生合世爻者，其人可托。
如静衰空破，即是奸险小人，若交财，定遭欺骗。
yi: 官鬼兴旺，牙行的主人可以托付千金；
应爻如果空破，经纪人一点本事都没有。
官鬼旺、应爻旺，又生合世爻，这个人可以托付。
如果（官、应）安静衰弱、空破，就是奸险小人，把钱交给他，一定被骗。
en: If Pressure flourishes, the brokerage owner can be trusted with a fortune;
if the Other line is void or broken, the broker has no ability at all.
Pressure strong and the Other strong, generating or combining with the Self line: the man can be trusted.
If they are still, weak, void or broken, he is a treacherous man; hand him money and you will be cheated.

hits.text: 应如空陷，牙人无毫忽之能

title: 世被应伤，遭他陷害；财逢兄克，虑彼相瞒

rule.yi: 投行交易：应伤世遭陷害，应克世账目不清；兄克财已入圈套、防隐瞒；兄动货难脱卸；子孙兴、财旺，交易顺利、利息丰厚。
rule.en: Trading through a broker: the Other hurting the Self line, you will be framed; the Other controlling the Self, the accounts will never be clear; Peer controlling Wealth, you are already in the trap and should beware of concealment; Peer moving, the goods are hard to sell; Output stirring and Wealth strong, the deal goes well and the interest is rich.

zh: 世被应伤，遭他陷害；财逢兄克，虑彼相瞒。
应克世，帐目难清；兄克财，已入局套。
兄动，货难脱卸；子兴，物宜交关。
兄动阻隔，货难尽脱，子与财旺，利息丰隆。
yi: 世爻被应爻所伤，会遭他陷害；财爻被兄弟所克，要防他隐瞒。
应克世，账目难算清；兄弟克财，已经落入圈套。
兄弟动，货难卖掉；子孙兴动，货物好成交。
兄弟动主阻隔，货难全部卖出；子孙和财旺，利息丰厚。
en: The Self line hurt by the Other: you will be framed; Wealth controlled by Peer: beware of him hiding things.
Other controlling Self: the accounts will never be clear; Peer controlling Wealth: you are already in the trap.
Peer moving: the goods are hard to sell off; Output stirring: the goods change hands well.
Peer moving means obstruction and the goods do not all sell; Output and Wealth strong means rich interest.

hits.text: 兄动则货难脱卸，子兴则物易交关

title: 兄雀并摇，难逃口舌；武鬼同发，须虑穿窃

rule.yi: 投行交易：朱雀临兄弟而官鬼动来克世，有口舌官灾；玄武临兄弟而官鬼动来克世，防盗窃。
rule.en: Trading through a broker: the Vermilion Bird on Peer with Pressure moving to control the Self line, quarrels and trouble with officials; the Dark Tortoise on Peer with Pressure moving to control the Self line, beware of theft.

zh: 兄雀并摇，难逃口舌；武鬼同发，须虑穿窃。
雀临兄，鬼动而克世者，口舌官灾；
武临兄，鬼动而克世者，须防窃盗。
yi: 兄弟和朱雀一起动，免不了口舌；玄武和官鬼一起发动，要防穿墙偷盗。
朱雀临兄弟，官鬼动来克世，有口舌官灾；
玄武临兄弟，官鬼动来克世，要防盗窃。
en: Peer and the Vermilion Bird both stirring: quarrels cannot be escaped; the Dark Tortoise and Pressure moving together: beware of burglary.
The Vermilion Bird on Peer, with Pressure moving to control the Self line: quarrels and trouble with officials;
the Dark Tortoise on Peer, with Pressure moving to control the Self line: beware of theft.

hits.text: 兄雀并摇，难逃口舌，武官同发不免穿

title: 财爻衰者宜停脱，妻位当时可脱之

rule.yi: 囤货卖货看财爻四时旺衰：财衰宜囤，财旺宜卖（如春天木财旺宜速卖，金水土财宜囤，火财为相也不宜囤）；忌财空破、动而变回头克。觉子：财衰可买，但要查它有没有根——有根将来再涨，无根终难卖出。
rule.en: Stockpiling or selling goes by the seasonal strength of the Wealth line: weak Wealth, stockpile; strong Wealth, sell (in spring Wood Wealth is thriving, sell fast; Metal, Water or Earth Wealth, stockpile; Fire is strong in spring, do not stockpile). Void or broken Wealth, or Wealth turning into its own control, is bad. Juezi: weak Wealth can be bought, but check its root; rooted, it will rise again; rootless, it will never sell.

zh: 财爻衰者宜停脱，妻位当时可脱之。
积货卖货，皆忌财逢空破，及动而变克。
财衰宜囤，财旺宜脱。
如春时占得财爻属木，谓之旺，宜速发卖；
若临金水土者，宜堆积也；临火为相，亦不宜堆积。
此论四时之衰旺也。
yi: 财爻衰弱的，宜停下不卖；财爻当令的，可以卖出。
囤货、卖货，都忌财爻逢空、破，以及动而变出回头克。
财衰宜囤积，财旺宜卖出。
比如春天占得财爻属木，叫作旺，宜赶快卖；
如果财属金、水、土，宜囤积；属火，春天是相，也不宜囤积。
这是按四季的旺衰来论。
en: A weak Wealth line: hold off selling; a Wealth in season: sell.
Stockpiling or selling, both fear Wealth being void or broken, or moving into something that controls it.
Weak Wealth: stockpile; strong Wealth: sell.
For instance, in spring a Wood Wealth line is called thriving: sell quickly;
if it is Metal, Water or Earth, stockpile; Fire is strong (xiang) in spring, so do not stockpile that either.
This goes by the strength of the four seasons.

zh: 觉子曰：衰虽可买，须要查其根蒂。
衰若有根，则将来再发；如无根蒂，到底难于出脱。
断卦者所当知也。
yi: 觉子说：财衰虽然可以买进，还要查它有没有根。
衰而有根，将来还会涨；如果没有根，终究难卖出去。
断卦的人应当知道这一点。
en: Juezi says: a weak Wealth may be bought, but check its root.
Weak but rooted, it will rise again; with no root, it will never sell.
A reader must know this.

title: 货有定时，须凭时令；物无定者，指利而占

rule.yi: 有固定旺季的货（麻葛夏、棉花冬）凭时令断价；没有固定时节的货（木料、绸缎）要指明求利单独占。
rule.en: Goods with a set season (hemp and linen in summer, cotton in winter) are priced by the season; goods without one (timber, silk) need a casting that asks specifically about the profit.

zh: 货有定时，须凭时令；物无定者，指利而占。
定时者，有贵贱之时也，如麻葛得价于夏令，花棉得价于冬天。
又如木料、绸缎之类无定时也。
yi: 有固定时节的货，要凭时令来断；没有固定时节的货，就指明求利来占。
有固定时节，是说有贵有贱的时候，比如麻葛在夏天卖得上价，棉花在冬天卖得上价。
又比如木料、绸缎这一类，没有固定时节。
en: Goods with a fixed season are judged by the season; goods without one, ask specifically about the profit.
A fixed season means a time when it is dear and a time when it is cheap: hemp and linen fetch a price in summer, cotton in winter.
Timber, silk and the like have no fixed season.

title: 财化进神，其价正涨；兄爻持世，破败之端

rule.yi: 财化进神：价正在涨，不可收购囤积；财化退：价将落，有货速卖。兄弟持世或兄弟发动：破财之兆。
rule.en: Wealth turning Advancing: the price is rising, do not buy to store; turning Retreating: the price will fall, sell what you hold at once. Peer on the Self line or Peer moving: a sign of losing money.

zh: 财化进神，其价正涨；兄爻持世，破败之端；
财化进神，价正涨，不可收积；
化退者，价将落，有货速宜脱卸。
兄爻持世，及兄动卦中，破财之兆。
yi: 财化进神，价格正在上涨；兄弟持世，是破败的开端；
财化进神，价正在涨，不可收购囤积；
财化退神，价格将要下跌，有货赶快卖掉。
兄弟持世，或兄弟在卦中发动，是破财之兆。
en: Wealth turning Advancing: the price is rising; Peer on the Self line: the beginning of ruin;
Wealth turning Advancing: the price is rising, so do not buy in to store;
turning Retreating: the price will fall, so sell what you hold at once.
Peer on the Self line, or Peer moving anywhere in the hexagram, is a sign of losing money.

title: 算甚命？问甚卜？亏人是祸，饶人是福

rule.yi: 义取之财神告显然，不义之财神不告：品行不端的人占财，卦卦兄弟持世、发动，只示破财，不示利与不利（觉子的例子：亏待伙计的人占卖货，占了又占都是兄弟持世，终于折本流落）。
rule.en: For money honestly sought the spirits answer plainly; for ill-gotten money they do not: a man of bad conduct asking about money gets Peer on the Self line and moving every time, showing only loss and saying nothing of profit (Juezi's example: a man who cheated his partners asked about selling, got Peer on the Self line again and again, and ended ruined and adrift).

zh: 觉子曰：算甚命？问甚卜？亏人是祸，饶人是福。
财将义取者，神告显然。财之不义者，神不告矣。
昔有一人亏损伙计，独得其利，人人知而詈骂，
因占货当卖否，卦得兄爻持世，又占不卖何如，又是兄爻持世，占过又占，不离兄动，
余亦知其此人亏损伙计，而得货抑买，素行不端。
余悟兄动者破财之兆也，有利无利，神不告之，
后此人不卖者，其价一日贱似一日，不得不卖，及至急急卖毕，其价大长，
折本漂流，难回故里，所以丧心之人何须占卜！
yi: 觉子说：算什么命？问什么卜？亏待别人就是祸，宽待别人就是福。
以正当手段求财的，神明会清楚地告诉；不义之财，神明不告诉。
从前有个人亏待伙计，独吞利益，人人都知道、都骂他；
他占货该不该卖，卦得兄弟持世；又占不卖怎样，又是兄弟持世；占了又占，总离不开兄弟发动。
我也知道这个人亏待伙计，货是压价强买来的，平素品行不端。
我明白了：兄弟动是破财之兆，至于有利无利，神明不告诉他。
后来这人不卖，价格一天比一天便宜，不得不卖；等他急急忙忙卖完，价格却大涨；
他亏了本钱，流落在外，回不了家乡。所以丧尽良心的人何必占卜！
en: Juezi says: why tell fortunes? Why divine? To wrong others is misfortune; to spare them is fortune.
For money sought honestly, the spirits answer plainly; for money sought unjustly, they do not answer.
There was once a man who cheated his partners and kept the profit for himself; everyone knew and cursed him.
He asked whether to sell the goods: the Peer line on the Self line; he asked what if he did not sell: the Peer line on the Self line again; ask as he might, Peer kept moving.
I too knew he had cheated his partners and got the goods by forced buying, a man of bad conduct.
I understood: the moving Peer was the sign of losing money, and whether there would be profit the spirits would not tell him.
Afterwards he held on and the price fell day by day until he had to sell; as soon as he had hurriedly sold out, the price shot up;
he lost his capital and drifted, unable to go home. So what need has a heartless man of divination!

title: 财值旺衰墓绝，自有得令之秋；妻逢破克伏空，岂无乘除之日

rule.yi: 货物何时得价：财太旺→墓库之月；休囚→生旺之时；入墓→冲开；逢绝→生旺；月破→填实；被克→冲去克神之时；伏藏→出现之时；旬空→冲空、实空之月；被合→冲开。觉子：财受克要分有根无根——有根者冲去克神即得价，无根者财命两伤（书中例：归妹之兑、复之颐、家人之小畜）。
rule.en: When goods fetch a price: over-strong Wealth, its tomb month; resting or trapped, its time of birth and strength; entombed, when clashed open; extinguished, at birth and strength; under a Month-break, when filled in; controlled, when the controller is clashed away; hidden, when it appears; void, in the month that clashes or fills the void; combined, when clashed open. Juezi: a controlled Wealth must be judged by its root; rooted, it gains once the controller is clashed away; rootless, both money and life may be lost (cases: Guimei to Dui, Fu to Yi, Jiaren to Xiaoxu).

zh: 财值旺衰墓绝，自有得令之秋；妻逢破克伏空，岂无乘除之日。
财太旺者，得利于墓库之月；休囚者，出脱于生旺之时。
入墓必待冲开，遇绝宜逢生旺。
月破者，填实之候；被克者，冲去克神之秋；
伏藏者，得价于出现之时；旬空者，冲空、实空之月。
财逢合住，亦待冲开。
yi: 财爻无论旺、衰、墓、绝，自有它得时的时候；妻财逢破、受克、伏藏、落空，哪会没有消长转机的日子。
财太旺的，在墓库之月得利；休囚的，在生旺之时卖出。
入墓的一定要等冲开，逢绝的宜等生旺。
月破的，等填实之时；受克的，等冲去克神的时候；
伏藏的，在出现之时得价；旬空的，在冲空、实空的月份。
财被合住，也要等冲开。
en: Whether Wealth is strong, weak, entombed or extinguished, it has its season; whether it is broken, controlled, hidden or void, it has its day of reckoning.
Over-strong Wealth profits in its tomb month; resting or trapped Wealth sells in its time of birth and strength.
Entombed, wait for the clash that opens it; extinguished, wait for birth and strength.
Under a Month-break: when it is filled in; controlled: when the controlling line is clashed away;
hidden: it fetches its price when it appears; void: in the month that clashes or fills the void.
Wealth held by a combination also waits to be clashed open.

zh: 如：子月己丑日(旬空：午未)，占货何时得价？得“归妹之兑”
yi: 例：子月己丑日（旬空午、未），占货物什么时候得价，得归妹卦变兑卦。
en: Case: Zi month, Jichou day (void: Wu and Wei); when would the goods fetch a price? The hexagram Guimei changing to Dui.

zh: 断曰：卯木财爻，子月生之，财有根蒂，
目下不得价者，被申金动而克制之故也，
待寅月冲去申金，其价必涨。
果于正月勃然大涨，此乃财爻被克，冲去克神之月也。
yi: 断语：卯木财爻，子月生它，财有根；
眼下卖不上价，是因为申金发动克制它；
等到寅月冲去申金，价格一定上涨。
